ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_account_dict, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights\\n\\n# Four admitted factors, with directions preserved from the screener ensemble.\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nFACTOR_WEIGHTS = {\\"clv\\": 0.3395, \\"peer\\": 0.2612, \\"reversal\\": 0.2012, \\"momentum\\": 0.1981}\\nMIN_W, MAX_W = 0.015, 0.16\\nREBALANCE_EVERY = 10\\nsessions = 0\\n\\n\\ndef cross_rank(values):\\n    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))\\n    if len(valid) > 1:\\n        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):\\n            out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(valid)\\n    return out\\n\\n\\ndef project_weights(raw):\\n    # Iterative box/simplex projection: complete, long-only, and diversified.\\n    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-9) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    fixed = set()\\n    for _ in range(40):\\n        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in fixed]\\n        scale = (1.0 - sum(w[s] for s in fixed)) / max(sum(w[s] for s in free), 1e-12)\\n        trial = {s: w[s] * scale for s in free}\\n        viol = [s for s in free if trial[s] < MIN_W or trial[s] > MAX_W]\\n        if not viol:\\n            for s in free:\\n                w[s] = trial[s]\\n            break\\n        for s in viol:\\n            w[s] = MIN_W if trial[s] < MIN_W else MAX_W\\n            fixed.add(s)\\n    total = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: w[s] / total for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global sessions\\n    sessions += 1\\n    if sessions > 1 and (sessions - 1) % REBALANCE_EVERY != 0:\\n        return\\n\\n    # The data API exposes only completed observations at each decision.\\n    market = {}\\n    for symbol in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=85)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 25:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        close = np.asarray(df[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)\\n        high = np.asarray(df[\\"high\\"], dtype=float)\\n        low = np.asarray(df[\\"low\\"], dtype=float)\\n        ret = close[1:] / np.maximum(close[:-1], 1e-12) - 1.0\\n        if len(close) >= 22:\\n            market[symbol] = (close, high, low, ret)\\n    if len(market) < 12:\\n        return\\n\\n    clv, peer, reversal, momentum, invvol, five_day = ({}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {})\\n    for symbol, (close, high, low, ret) in market.items():\\n        # The admitted CLV factor is negative close-location value (reversal).\\n        loc = (2.0 * close - high - low) / np.maximum(high - low, 1e-12)\\n        clv[symbol] = -float(np.mean(loc[-3:]))\\n        reversal[symbol] = -float(np.mean(ret[-5:]))\\n        vol = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.008)\\n        invvol[symbol] = 1.0 / vol\\n        momentum[symbol] = float((close[-1] / max(close[-21], 1e-12) - 1.0) / (vol + 0.01))\\n        five_day[symbol] = float(close[-1] / max(close[-6], 1e-12) - 1.0)\\n\\n    median_5d = float(np.median(list(five_day.values())))\\n    peer = {s: value - median_5d for s, value in five_day.items()}\\n    ranked = {name: cross_rank(values) for name, values in (\\n        (\\"clv\\", clv), (\\"peer\\", peer), (\\"reversal\\", reversal), (\\"momentum\\", momentum))}\\n    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[k] * ranked[k][s] for k in ranked) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n    # Bullish/sideways stays fully invested in the scored blend. In a confirmed\\n    # SPX downtrend, rotate toward tradable defensives rather than cash.\\n    if \\"SPX\\" in market:\\n        spx = market[\\"SPX\\"][0]\\n        if spx[-1] < spx[-21] and spx[-1] < spx[-6]:\\n            for symbol in (\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"):\\n                score[symbol] += 0.18\\n            for symbol in (\\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"WTI\\"):\\n                score[symbol] = max(0.05, score[symbol] - 0.10)\\n\\n    mean_invvol = max(float(np.mean(list(invvol.values()))), 1e-12)\\n    raw = {s: max(score[s], 0.01) * (0.78 + 0.22 * invvol.get(s, mean_invvol) / mean_invvol)\\n           for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    weights = project_weights(raw)\\n    # Atomic full-investment rebalance; quantities remain fractional in the API.\\n    rebalance_to_weights(weights)\\n","file_path":"strategy.py"}', call_id='call_HM0UlBnQMxi8UngvECsWiMSw', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_0394cb0883c79ded016a784d5ceb34819ba1e261c0f8af268b', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

sum(fixed.values())\\n        scale = left / max(sum(w[s] for s in free), 1e-12)\\n        clipped = []\\n        for s in tuple(free):\\n            x = w[s] * scale\\n            if x < MIN_WEIGHT:\\n                fixed[s] = MIN_WEIGHT\\n                clipped.append(s)\\n            elif x > MAX_WEIGHT:\\n                fixed[s] = MAX_WEIGHT\\n                clipped.append(s)\\n            else:\\n                w[s] = x\\n        if not clipped:\\n            break\\n        free -= set(clipped)\\n    if free:\\n        left = 1.0 - sum(fixed.values())\\n        z = sum(w[s] for s in free)\\n        for s in free:\\n            w[s] = left * w[s] / max(z, 1e-12)\\n    w.update(fixed)\\n    total = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: float(w[s] / total) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _call\\n    _call += 1\\n    if _call > 1 and (_call - 1) % REBALANCE_EVERY:\\n        return\\n\\n    prices, clv, rev, mom, ret20, vol = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=90)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 26:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        c = np.asarray(df[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)\\n        h = np.asarray(df[\\"high\\"], dtype=float)\\n        l = np.asarray(df[\\"low\\"], dtype=float)\\n        if not np.all(np.isfinite(c[-26:])):\\n            continue\\n        r = c[1:] / np.maximum(c[:-1], 1e-12) - 1.0\\n        sigma = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.008)\\n        prices[s] = c\\n        clv[s] = (c[-1] - l[-1]) / max(h[-1] - l[-1], abs(c[-1]) * 1e-8)\\n        rev[s] = -float(np.mean(r[-5:]))\\n        ret20[s] = c[-1] / max(c[-21], 1e-12) - float(np.median(others)) if others else 0.0\\n    ranks = {\\"clv\\": percentile(clv), \\"peer\\": percentile(peer),\\n             \\"reversal\\": percentile(rev), \\"momentum\\": percentile(mom)}\\n    score = {s: sum(FACTORS[k] * ranks[k][s] for k in FACTORS) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n    # Regime overlay: bullish breadth retains risk assets; weak breadth shifts toward\\n    # tradable defensives while remaining fully invested and long-only.\\n    breadth = np.mean([ret20[s] > 0 for s in ret20])\\n    risk_assets = {\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\"}\\n    defensives = {\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\n    overlay = {s: 1.0 for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    if breadth < 0.40:\\n        for s in risk_assets: overlay[s] = 0.82\\n        for s in defensives: overlay[s] = 1.55\\n    elif breadth < 0.55:\\n        for s in risk_assets: overlay[s] = 0.93\\n        for s in defensives: overlay[s] = 1.20\\n\\n    inv_average = float(np.mean([1.0 / vol[s] for s in vol]))\\n    raw = {s: max(score[s], 0.05) * overlay[s] *\\n           (0.85 + 0.15 * (1.0 / vol[s]) / max(inv_average, 1e-12)) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    rebalance_to_weights(bounded(raw))\\n","file_path":"strategy.py"}', call_id='call_0GGt9XzgTsvBYuDbWRG1X3YA', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_03cbb243e4734216016a7a89d163bc8194887c67bc5af7f284', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

sum(fixed.values())\\n        scale = remaining / max(sum(w[s] for s in free), 1e-12)\\n        clipped = []\\n        for s in list(free):\\n            q = w[s] * scale\\n            if q < MIN_WEIGHT:\\n                fixed[s] = MIN_WEIGHT; clipped.append(s)\\n            elif q > MAX_WEIGHT:\\n                fixed[s] = MAX_WEIGHT; clipped.append(s)\\n            else:\\n                w[s] = q\\n        if not clipped:\\n            break\\n        free -= set(clipped)\\n    if free:\\n        left = 1.0 - sum(fixed.values())\\n        z = sum(w[s] for s in free)\\n        for s in free:\\n            w[s] = left * w[s] / max(z, 1e-12)\\n    w.update(fixed)\\n    z = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: w[s] / z for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _calls\\n    _calls += 1\\n    if _calls > 1 and (_calls - 1) % REBALANCE_EVERY != 0:\\n        return\\n    returns, clv, reversal, momentum, volatility = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}\\n    for symbol in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=90)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 26:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        close = np.asarray(df[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)\\n        high = np.asarray(df[\\"high\\"], dtype=float)\\n        low = np.asarray(df[\\"low\\"], dtype=float)\\n        if not np.all(np.isfinite(close[-26:])) or close[-1] <= 0:\\n            continue\\n        daily = close[1:] / np.maximum(close[:-1], 1e-12) - Screener agent output from current cycle: ## Market Assessment
- **Trend:** Bullish but not strongly confirmed across all asset classes.
- **Trend strength:** Moderate; momentum is positive, while cross-asset breadth and asynchronous series introduce uncertainty.
- **Risk level:** Medium-high, reflecting crypto and commodity volatility, synthetic yield-series behavior, and execution sensitivity.
- **Volatility/liquidity:** Favor diversified, lower-turnover signals. Daily intraday reversal variants remain costly for the 10-trading-day rebalance cadence.

## Available Factors

- **Momentum:** `miner_2_risk_adjusted_momentum_20d`
- **Reversal:** `short_term_reversal_5d`, `miner_2_short_reversal_3d`, `miner_3_20260716_reversal_5d`, `miner_1_20260730_volscaled_reversal_3d`, `miner_2_20260730_volscaled_reversal_5d`, intraday reversal variants

1. **`miner_3_clv_1d` — weight 0.3395**
   - Highest reported quality: IC 0.0680, ICIR 0.1871.
   - Maximum reported library correlation is only 0.3297.
   - Strong short-horizon signal, though coverage is 70.56% and turnover is relatively high.

2. **`peer_median_leadlag_5d` — weight 0.2612**
   - IC 0.0564, ICIR 0.1734, coverage 95.78%.
   - Lower turnover of 0.2259 and useful cross-asset diversification.
   - Effect decays at longer horizons, matching the short-horizon implementation.

3. **`short_term_reversal_5d` — weight 0.2012**
   - IC 0.0589, ICIR 0.1281.
   - Provides robust reversal exposure with moderate turnover.
   - Weight is capped due to overlap with CLV and other reversal signals.

4. **`miner_2_risk_adjusted_momentum_20d` — weight 0.1981**
   - IC 0.0498, ICIR 0.1490.
   - Lowest reported turnover among selected factors, at 0.0811.
   - Serves as the primary trend and reversal-cluster diversifier.

| Factor | Weight | Direction | Transformation hint |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `miner_3_clv_1d` | 0.3395 | +1 | Cross-sectional rank/z-score; winsorize |
| `peer_median_leadlag_5d` | 0.2612 | +1 | Leave-one-out peer rank |

| `miner_2_risk_adjusted_momentum_20d` | 0.1981 | +1 | Volatility-scaled cross-sectional rank |

Weights are non-negative and sum to 1.0.

- **Crowding:** CLV and short-term reversal form the main reversal cluster. The ensemble retains both but limits the combined reversal concentration.
- **Turnover:** Intraday reversal factors and the newly admitted volatility-scaled five-day reversal are excluded due to high turnover and unresolved overlap audits.
- **Correlation:** `miner_2_volscaled_intraday_reversal_1d` is excluded because its reported library correlation is 0.7869.
- **Coverage:** CLV has lower coverage than the other selected factors; missing exposures should receive neutral treatment.
- **Execution:** Synthetic yield, crypto, commodity, and sparse-volume series remain susceptible to stale marks and adverse slippage.

- `memory.txt` reports no realized online PnL, holdings, turnover, slippage, or factor attribution.
- Recent backtests and trading steps were blocked by the stale AC migration contract: expected `ac-worldline-v2-migration-gate`, received `None`.
- No empirical factor demotions are warranted; the existing four-factor ensemble is retained.

- The newly persisted volatility-scaled five-day reversal passed pooled admission gates but has deteriorating recent ICIR and likely overlaps the existing reversal family; it remains excluded pending deterministic correlation auditing.
- Lower-turnover held reversal variants failed the ICIR gate, so turnover reduction should not be achieved by simply extending signal holding periods.
- The ensemble remains appropriate for the 15-asset long-only universe with defensive asset rotation rather than a cash sleeve.

changed = True\\n            elif q > MAX_WEIGHT:\\n                fixed[s] = MAX_WEIGHT; changed = True\\n        if not changed:\\n            out = dict(fixed); out.update(trial)\\n            z = sum(out.values())\\n            return {s: out[s] / z for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    out = {s: fixed.get(s, MIN_WEIGHT) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    z = sum(out.values())\\n    return {s: v / z for s, v in out.items()}\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _calls\\n    _calls += 1\\n    if _calls != 1 and (_calls - 1) % REBALANCE_EVERY:\\n        return\\n    f = {k: {} for k in FACTORS}\\n    vol, r1, mom = {}, {}, {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=90)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 26:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        c = np.asarray(df.close, dtype=float); h = np.asarray(df.high, dtype=float); l = np.asarray(df.low, dtype=float)\\n        if not np.all(np.isfinite(c[-26:])) or np.any(c[-26:] <= 0):\\n            continue\\n        ret = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0\\n        sig = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.008)\\n        vol[s] = sig; 1) % REBALANCE_EVERY != 0:\\n        return\\n    factors = {k: {} for k in FACTORS}\\n    vols, mom = {}, {}\\n    for symbol in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=90)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 30:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        c = np.asarray(df[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)\\n        o = np.asarray(df[\\"open\\"], dtype=float)\\n        h = np.asarray(df[\\"high\\"], dtype=float)\\n        l = np.asarray(df[\\"low\\"], dtype=float)\\n        if np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-30:])) or np.any(c[-30:] <= 0):\\n            continue\\n        daily = c[1:] / c[:-1] - active.remove(s); clipped = True\\n            elif x > MAX_WEIGHT:\\n                fixed[s] = MAX_WEIGHT; active.remove(s); clipped = True\\n        if not clipped:\\n            fixed.update(trial); break\\n    if active:\\n        left = 1.0 - sum(fixed.values())\\n        den = sum(w[s] for s in active)\\n        fixed.update({s: left * w[s] / den for s in active})\\n    total = sum(fixed.values())\\n    return {s: fixed[s] / total for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _calls\\n    _calls += 1\\n    if _calls != 1 and (_calls - 1) % REBALANCE_EVERY != 0:\\n        return\\n\\n    raw = {k: {} for k in FACTORS}\\n    vol, ret1, ret5, mom = {}, {}, {}, {}\\n    for symbol in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=90)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 30:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        c = np.asarray(df[\\"close\\"], float); o = np.asarray(df[\\"open\\"], float)\\n        h = np.asarray(df[\\"high\\"], float); l = np.asarray(df[\\"low\\"], float)\\n        if np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-30:])) or np.any(c[-30:] <= 0):\\n            continue\\n        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0\\n        sig = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.008)\\n        vol[symbol] = sig; ret1[symbol] = r[-1]\\n        ret5[symbol] = c[-1] / c[-6] - 1.0\\n        raw[\\"lowvol\\"][symbol] = -r[-1] / sig\\n        raw[\\"momentum\\"][symbol] = (c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0) / (sig + 0.01)\\n        span = h[-1] - l[-1]\\n        raw[\\"clv\\"][symbol] = -(c[-1] - o[-1]) / span if np.isfinite(span) and span > 0 else 0.0\\n        if \\"volume\\" in df.columns:\\n            v = np.asarray(df[\\"volume\\"], float)\\n            med = np.nanmedian(v[-21:])\\n            amp = min(max(v[-1] / med, 0.25), 2.0) if np.isfinite(v[-1]) and v[-1] > 0 and med > 0 else 1.0\\n            raw[\\"volume\\"][symbol] = (-r[-1] / sig) * (0.75 + 0.25 * amp)\\n        else:\\n            raw[\\"volume\\"][symbol] = 0.0\\n    if len(vol) < 8:\\n        return\\n    peer_med = float(np.median(list(ret5.values())))\\n    day_med = float(np.median(list(ret1.values())))\\n    for s in vol:\\n        raw[\\"peer\\"][s] = ret5[s] - peer_med\\n        raw[\\"residual\\"][s] = -(ret1[s] - day_med) / vol[s]\\n    rr = {k: ranks(v) for k, v in raw.items()}\\n    score = {s: sum(FACTORS[k] * rr[k][s] for k in FACTORS) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    breadth = np.mean([mom[s] > 0 for s in mom]) if mom else 0.5\\n    # In a weak, choppy regime, modestly favor tradable defensive assets.\\n    defensive = {\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\n    inv_mean = np.mean([1.0 / x for x in vol.values()])\\n    target_raw = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        inv_tilt = min((1.0 / vol[s]) / inv_mean, 1.6)\\n        posture = 1.12 if breadth < 0.45 and s in defensive else (0.96 if breadth < 0.45 else 1.0)\\n        target_raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.05) * (0.96 + 0.04 * inv_tilt) * posture\\n    rebalance_to_weights(bounded(target_raw))\\n","file_path":"strategy.py"}', call_id='call_nJMLqZLK5GKHX64dQQUgwsJC', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_02aba9a350879b3b016a7aa0d373cc8191bf798e88cf2519f6', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

break\\n    if active:\\n        left = 1.0 - sum(fixed.values())\\n        den = sum(w[s] for s in active)\\n        fixed.update({s: left * w[s] / den for s in active})\\n    z = sum(fixed.values())\\n    return {s: fixed[s] / z for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _calls\\n    _calls += 1\\n    if _calls != 1 and (_calls - 1) % REBALANCE_EVERY != 0:\\n        return\\n    raw = {k: {} for k in FACTORS}\\n    vol, r1, r5, r20 = {}, {}, {}, {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=100)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 35:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        c = np.asarray(df.close, float); ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\n# Current Screener ensemble; all directions are positive as supplied.\\nFACTORS = {\\"peer5\\": .20, \\"mom20\\": .16, \\"clv\\": .15, \\"lowvol1\\": .14,\\n           \\"stress\\": .09, \\"beta5\\": .09, \\"rev3\\": .07, \\"lagmix\\": .05, \\"beta2\\": .05}\\nMIN_W, MAX_W, CADENCE = .02, .14, 10\\n_day = 0\\n\\ndef rank(x):\\n    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in x.items() if np.isfinite(v))\\n    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):\\n        out[s] = (i + 1.) / len(good)\\n    return out\\n\\ndef bounded(raw):\\n    # Iterative water filling enforces a complete, finite, long-only vector.\\n    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    fixed, active = {}, set(UNIVERSE)\\n    for _ in range(30):\\n        left = 1 - sum(fixed.values()); den = sum(w[s] for s in active)\\n        trial = {s: left*w[s]/den for s in active}\\n        clipped = False\\n        for s, q in list(trial.items()):\\n            if q < MIN_W: fixed[s] = MIN_W; active.remove(s); clipped = True\\n            elif q > MAX_W: fixed[s] = MAX_W; active.remove(s); clipped = True\\n        if not clipped:\\n            fixed.update(trial); break\\n    z = sum(fixed.values())\\n    return {s: fixed.get(s, 0.)/z for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _day\\n    _day += 1\\n    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:\\n        return\\n    series, vol, mom = {}, {}, {}\\n    raw = {k: {} for k in FACTORS}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        d = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=135)\\n        if d is None or len(d) < 35: continue\\n        d = d.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        c, o, h, l = [np.asarray(d[k], dtype=float) for k in (\\"close\\", \\"open\\", \\"high\\", \\"low\\")]\\n        r = c[1:]/c[:-1]-1\\n        if len(r) < 30 or not np.all(np.isfinite(c[-35:])) or np.any(c[-35:] <= 0): continue\\n        v = max(float(np.nanstd(r[-20:])), .008)\\n        series[s], vol[s] = r, v; mom[s] = c[-1]/c[-21]-1\\n        span = h[-1]-l[-1]\\n        raw[\\"clv\\"][s] = -(c[-1]-o[-1])/span if np.isfinite(span) and span > 0 else 0\\n        raw[\\"lowvol1\\"][s] = -r[-1]/v\\n        shock = np.clip(abs(r[-1])/v, .5, 2.)\\n        raw[\\"stress\\"][s] = -r[-1]/v * shock\\n        raw[\\"mom20\\"][s] = mom[s]/(v*np.sqrt(20)+.01)\\n    if len(series) < 8: return\\n    def cum(r, n): return float(np.prod(1+r[-n:])-1)\\n    for s, r in series.items():\\n        peers = [cum(series[t], 5) for t in series if t != s]\\n        med5 = np.median(peers); Simple bounded simplex projection; preserves a complete 15-asset target.\\n    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 0.1)), 1e-12) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    fixed = {}\\n    active = set(UNIVERSE)\\n    for _ in range(30):\\n        remain = 1.0 - sum(fixed.values())\\n        z = sum(w[s] for s in active)\\n        trial = {s: remain*w[s]/z for s in active}\\n        clipped = False\\n        for s, x in list(trial.items()):\\n            if x < MIN_W:\\n                fixed[s] = MIN_W; active.remove(s); clipped = True\\n            elif x > MAX_W:\\n                fixed[s] = MAX_W; active.remove(s); clipped = True\\n        if not clipped:\\n            fixed.update(trial); break\\n    total = sum(fixed.values())\\n    return {s: fixed.get(s, 0.0)/total for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _day\\n    _day += 1\\n    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return\\n    returns, vol, raw = {}, {}, {k: {} for k in FACTORS}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=150)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 35: continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        try:\\n            c = np.asarray(df.close, float); o = np.asarray(df.open, float)\\n            h = np.asarray(df.high, float); l = np.asarray(df.low, float)\\n            volume = np.asarray(df.volume, float)\\n        except Exception: continue\\n        if len(c) < 35 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-35:])) or np.any(c[-35:] <= 0): continue\\n        r = c[1:]/c[:-1]-1\\n        sig = max(float(np.nanstd(r[-20:])), .008)\\n        returns[s], vol[s] = r, sig\\n        # Positive CLV is buying pressure; use the Screener direction (+1).\\n        span = h[-1]-l[-1]\\n        raw[\\"clv\\"][s] = (2*c[-1]-h[-1]-l[-1])/span if span > 0 else 0.\\n        raw[\\"mom\\"][s] = (c[-1]/c[-21]-1)/(sig*np.sqrt(20)+.01)\\n        med = np.nanmedian(volume[-21:-1])\\n        boost = np.clip(volume[-1]/med, .75, 1.75) if np.isfinite(med) and med > 0 else 1.\\n        raw[\\"volume\\"][s] = (-r[-1]/sig)*(1+.35*max(boost-1, 0))\\n        raw[\\"rev3\\"][s] = -(np.prod(1+r[-3:])-1)/(sig*np.sqrt(3)+.005)\\n        raw[\\"rev5\\"][s] = -(np.prod(1+r[-5:])-1)/(sig*np.sqrt(5)+.005)\\n    if len(returns) < 8: return\\n    def cum(x, n): return float(np.prod(1+x[-n:])-1)\\n    med5 = float(np.median([cum(x, 5) for x in returns.values()]))\\n    for s, r in returns.items():\\n        others = [cum(returns[t], 5) for t in returns if t != s]\\n        # Lead-lag proxy: assets outperforming their leave-one-out peer median.\\n        raw[\\"peer\\"][s] = cum(r, 5)-float(np.median(others))\\n        # Conditional blend: reversal in stress, momentum in calm conditions.\\n        raw[\\"blend\\"][s] = raw[\\"rev3\\"][s] if med5 < 0 else raw[\\"mom\\"][s]\\n    rr = {k: ranks(v) for k, v in raw.items()}\\n    score = {s: sum(FACTORS[k]*rr[k][s] for k in FACTORS) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    medvol = float(np.median(list(vol.values())))\\n    breadth = float(np.mean([cum(r, 20) > 0 for r in returns.values()]))\\n    stress = medvol > .018 or breadth < .45\\n    invavg = float(np.mean([1/x for x in vol.values()]))\\n    defensives = {\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\n    raw_target = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        damp = min((1/vol.get(s, medvol))/invavg, 1.5)\\n        raw_target[s] = max(score[s], .05)*(.85+.15*damp)\\n        if stress and s in defensives: raw_target[s] *= 1.15\\n    rebalance_to_weights(bounded(raw_target))\\n","file_path":"strategy.py"}', call_id='call_z5yrjrAZs56KqxgCFvY8Exh9', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_0c21d8c2961fab39016a7aadf6759c819ab6b8c857370b1d8a', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

sum(fixed.values())\\n        z = sum(w[s] for s in active)\\n        trial = {s: left * w[s] / z for s in active}\\n        clipped = False\\n        for s, x in list(trial.items()):\\n            if x < MIN_W:\\n                fixed[s] = MIN_W; active.remove(s); clipped = True\\n            elif x > MAX_W:\\n                fixed[s] = MAX_W; active.remove(s); clipped = True\\n        if not clipped:\\n            fixed.update(trial); break\\n    total = sum(fixed.values())\\n    return {s: fixed.get(s, 0.0) / total for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\ndef cum(r, n):\\n    return float(np.prod(1.0 + r[-n:]) - 1.0)\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _day\\n    _day += 1\\n    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:\\n        return\\n    returns, vols, sig = {}, {}, {k: {} for k in FACTORS}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=160)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 45:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        c = np.asarray(df[\\"close\\"], float)\\n        o = np.asarray(df[\\"open\\"], float)\\n        h = np.asarray(df[\\"high\\"], float)\\n        l = np.asarray(df[\\"low\\"], float)\\n        q = np.asarray(df[\\"volume\\"], float)\\n        if np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-45:])) or np.any(c[-45:] <= 0):\\n            continue\\n        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - sum(fixed.values())\\n        denom = sum(result[s] for s in active)\\n        trial = {s: remaining * result[s] / denom for s in active}\\n        clipped = False\\n        for s, x in list(trial.items()):\\n            if x < MIN_W:\\n                fixed[s] = MIN_W; active.remove(s); clipped = True\\n            elif x > MAX_W:\\n                fixed[s] = MAX_W; active.remove(s); clipped = True\\n        if not clipped:\\n            fixed.update(trial)\\n            break\\n    total = sum(fixed.values())\\n    return {s: fixed.get(s, 0.0) / total for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n\\ndef compound(r, n):\\n    return float(np.prod(1.0 + r[-n:]) - 1.0) if len(r) >= n else np.nan\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _day\\n    _day += 1\\n    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % REBALANCE_DAYS != 0:\\n        return\\n\\n    returns, volatility, signal = {}, {}, {f: {} for f in FACTORS}\\n    for symbol in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=160)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 45:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        close = np.asarray(df[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)\\n        high = np.asarray(df[\\"high\\"], dtype=float)\\n        low = np.asarray(df[\\"low\\"], dtype=float)\\n        volume = np.asarray(df[\\"volume\\"], dtype=float)\\n        if np.any(~np.isfinite(close[-45:])) or np.any(close[-45:] <= 0):\\n            continue\\n        r = close[1:] / close[:-1] - ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\n# Screener ensemble (2026-08-27), capped at five active factors.\\nFACTOR_W = {\\"mom20\\": .25, \\"peer5\\": .22, \\"resid40\\": .20, \\"conditional\\": .18, \\"volume_rev\\": .15}\\nREBALANCE_DAYS = 10\\nMIN_W, MAX_W = .03, .15\\n_day = 0\\n_last_score = None\\n\\n\\ndef rank_cs(x):\\n    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in x.items() if np.isfinite(v))\\n    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    n = len(good)\\n    if n:\\n        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):\\n            out[s] = (i + 1.) / n\\n    return out\\n\\n\\ndef ret(r, n):\\n    return float(np.prod(1. + r[-n:]) - 1.) if len(r) >= n else np.nan\\n\\n\\ndef bounded_weights(raw):\\n    # Iterative capped-simplex projection; preserves full investment and all assets.\\n    active = set(UNIVERSE); fixed = {}; base = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, .1)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    for _ in range(30):\\n        left = 1. - sum(fixed.values()); den = sum(base[s] for s in active)\\n        trial = {s: left * base[s] / den for s in active}\\n        clipped = False\\n        for s, v in list(trial.items()):\\n            if v < MIN_W: fixed[s] = MIN_W; active.remove(s); clipped = True\\n            elif v > MAX_W: fixed[s] = MAX_W; active.remove(s); clipped = True\\n        if not clipped:\\n            fixed.update(trial); break\\n    z = sum(fixed.values())\\n    return {s: fixed.get(s, 0.) / z for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _day, _last_score\\n    _day += 1\\n    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % REBALANCE_DAYS:\\n        return\\n\\n    data, rets, vols = {}, {}, {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=230)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 70:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\")\\n        c = np.asarray(df[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)\\n        if np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-70:])) or np.any(c[-70:] <= 0):\\n            continue\\n        data[s] = df; rets[s] = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.\\n        vols[s] = max(float(np.std(rets[s][-20:])), .006)\\n    if len(rets) < 10:\\n        return\\n\\n    r5 = {s: ret(r, 5) for s, r in rets.items()}\\n    r20 = {s: ret(r, 20) for s, r in rets.items()}\\n    r40 = {s: ret(r, 40) for s, r in rets.items()}\\n    equity = {s for s in UNIVERSE[:8] if s in rets}\\n    med5 = float(np.median(list(r5.values())))\\n    med40eq = float(np.median([r40[s] for s in equity])) if equity else float(np.median(list(r40.values())))\\n    breadth = float(np.mean([v > 0 for v in r5.values()]))\\n    stress = med5 < 0 or breadth < .45 or float(np.median(list(vols.values()))) > .018\\n\\n    f = {k: {} for k in FACTOR_W}\\n    for s, r in rets.items():\\n        v = vols[s]\\n        # Risk-adjusted 20-day momentum, volatility window is the available trailing 60 days.\\n        f[\\"mom20\\"][s] = r20[s] / (max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006) * np.sqrt(20.) + .01)\\n        # Leave-one-out peer-median five-day lead/lag signal.\\n        peers = [r5[t] for t in rets if t != s]\\n        f[\\"peer5\\"][s] = float(np.median(peers)) if peers else r5[s]\\n        # Slow equity-relative residual proxy.\\n        f[\\"resid40\\"][s] = (r40[s] - med40eq) / (v * np.sqrt(40.) + .02)\\n        r3 = ret(r, 3)\\n        med3 = float(np.median([ret(rets[t], 3) for t in rets]))\\n        f[\\"conditional\\"][s] = (-(r3 - med3) if stress else r3) / (v * np.sqrt(3.) + .012)\\n        vol = np.asarray(data[s][\\"volume\\"], dtype=float) if \\"volume\\" in data[s] else np.array([])\\n        vz = 0.\\n        if len(vol) >= 20 and np.all(np.isfinite(vol[-20:])) and np.all(vol[-20:] > 0):\\n            lv = np.log(vol[-20:]); vz = np.clip((lv[-1] - np.mean(lv)) / (np.std(lv) + 1e-9), -1., 2.)\\n        f[\\"volume_rev\\"][s] = -r[-1] * (1. + .5 * vz)\\n\\n    ranked = {k: rank_cs(v) for k, v in f.items()}\\n    scores = {s: sum(FACTOR_W[k] * ranked[k].get(s, .5) for k in FACTOR_W) for s in rets}\\n    if _last_score is not None:\\n        for s in scores:\\n            scores[s] = .65 * scores[s] + .35 * _last_score.get(s, scores[s])\\n    _last_score = scores.copy()\\n\\n    mean_inv = np.mean([1. / v for v in vols.values()])\\n    defensive = {\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\n    raw = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        inv = min((1. / vols.get(s, .02)) / mean_inv, 1.25)\\n        raw[s] = max(scores.get(s, .5), .05) * (.88 + .12 * inv)\\n        if stress and s in defensive:\\n            raw[s] *= 1.35\\n    target = bounded_weights(raw)\\n    if set(target) == set(UNIVERSE) and all(np.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in target.values()) and abs(sum(target.values()) - 1.) < 1e-8:\\n        rebalance_to_weights(target)\\n","file_path":"strategy.py"}', call_id='call_MtLZE2z0JRDI24aiuC0cMDcU', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_0e475eafbe58183a016a7ac2df14648197902456aec991d5ef', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
# Screener ensemble, capped at eight active factors.
FACTORS = {"mom120": .25, "disp_rev": .14, "rev5": .15, "volume_rev": .12,
           "stress_rev": .12, "rev10": .12, "intraday_rev": .05, "vol_rev10": .05}
CADENCE = 10
MIN_W, MAX_W = .035, .16
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(x):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in x.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.) / len(good)
    return out


def project(raw):
    # Simple capped proportional projection; guarantees a complete long-only vector.
    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, .1)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE}
    for _ in range(20):
        total = sum(w.values())
        w = {s: x / total for s, x in w.items()}
        low = [s for s in UNIVERSE if w[s] < MIN_W]
        high = [s for s in UNIVERSE if w[s] > MAX_W]
        if not low and not high:
            break
        for s in low: w[s] = MIN_W
        for s in high: w[s] = MAX_W
        fixed = sum(w[s] for s in low + high)
        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in set(low + high)]
        if free:
            rem = max(1. - fixed, 1e-8)
            base = sum(max(raw.get(s, .1), 1e-8) for s in free)
            for s in free: w[s] = rem * max(raw.get(s, .1), 1e-8) / base
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s] / z for s in UNIVERSE}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 145: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c, o = np.asarray(df.close, float), np.asarray(df.open, float)
        if np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.
        v = np.asarray(df.volume, float) if "volume" in df else np.ones(len(c))
        vol = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), .006)
        down = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(r[-40:], 0.))), .004)
        data[s] = dict(r=r, vol=vol, down=down,
            h5=float(np.prod(1+r[-5:])-1), h10=float(np.prod(1+r[-10:])-1),
            h20=float(np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1), h120=float(np.prod(1+r[-120:])-1),
            intra=float(np.nanmean((c[-5:]-o[-5:]) / np.maximum(o[-5:], 1e-12))),
            vr=float(np.mean(v[-5:]) / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-9)),
            vd=float(np.std(v[-20:]) / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-9)))
    if len(data) < 10: return
    syms = list(data); med5 = np.median([data[s]['h5'] for s in syms]); med10 = np.median([data[s]['h10'] for s in syms]); med20 = np.median([data[s]['h20'] for s in syms])
    f = {k: {} for k in FACTORS}
    for s in syms:
        d = data[s]; scale5=d['vol']*np.sqrt(5)+.01; scale10=d['vol']*np.sqrt(10)+.01
        f['mom120'][s] = d['h120']/(d['vol']*np.sqrt(120)+.03)
        f['rev5'][s] = (med5-d['h5'])/scale5
        f['rev10'][s] = (med10-d['h10'])/scale10
        # Relative dispersion and stress overlays are deliberately damped.
        f['disp_rev'][s] = (med20-d['h20'])/(d['vol']*np.sqrt(20)+.015)
        f['stress_rev'][s] = .65*(med20-d['h20'])/(d['down']*np.sqrt(20)+.02)
        f['volume_rev'][s] = f['rev5'][s] * (.75 + .25*np.clip(d['vr'], .5, 1.5))
        f['intraday_rev'][s] = -d['intra']/(d['vol']+.01)
        f['vol_rev10'][s] = f['rev10'][s]/(1+8*d['vol'])
    rr = {k: rank(x) for k,x in f.items()}
    score = {s: sum(FACTORS[k]*rr[k].get(s,.5) for k in FACTORS) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s:.35*score[s]+.65*_previous.get(s,.5) for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()
    breadth = np.mean([data[s]['h120'] > 0 for s in syms]); medvol=np.median([data[s]['vol'] for s in syms])
    high_risk = breadth < .50 or medvol > .018
    invmean=np.mean([1/data[s]['vol'] for s in syms]); raw={}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        d=data.get(s, {'vol':.02,'h120':0.})
        inv=(1/d['vol'])/max(invmean,1e-9)
        raw[s]=max(score[s],.10)*(.88+.12*min(inv,1.25))
        if high_risk and s in DEFENSIVE: raw[s]*=3.0
        elif high_risk and d['h120'] < -.10: raw[s]*=.60
    target=project(raw)
    if abs(sum(target.values())-1.) < 1e-8 and all(np.isfinite(x) and x>=0 for x in target.values()): rebalance_to_weights(target)

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
# Screener ensemble, capped at eight active factors.
FACTORS = {"mom120": .25, "disp_rev": .14, "rev5": .15, "volume_rev": .12,
           "stress_rev": .12, "rev10": .12, "intraday_rev": .05, "vol_rev10": .05}
CADENCE = 10
MIN_W, MAX_W = .035, .16
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(x):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in x.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.) / len(good)
    return out


def project(raw):
    # Simple capped proportional projection; guarantees a complete long-only vector.
    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, .1)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE}
    for _ in range(20):
        total = sum(w.values())
        w = {s: x / total for s, x in w.items()}
        low = [s for s in UNIVERSE if w[s] < MIN_W]
        high = [s for s in UNIVERSE if w[s] > MAX_W]
        if not low and not high:
            break
        for s in low: w[s] = MIN_W
        for s in high: w[s] = MAX_W
        fixed = sum(w[s] for s in low + high)
        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in set(low + high)]
        if free:
            rem = max(1. - fixed, 1e-8)
            base = sum(max(raw.get(s, .1), 1e-8) for s in free)
            for s in free: w[s] = rem * max(raw.get(s, .1), 1e-8) / base
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s] / z for s in UNIVERSE}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 145: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c, o = np.asarray(df.close, float), np.asarray(df.open, float)
        if np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.
        v = np.asarray(df.volume, float) if "volume" in df else np.ones(len(c))
        vol = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), .006)
        down = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(r[-40:], 0.))), .004)
        data[s] = dict(r=r, vol=vol, down=down,
            h5=float(np.prod(1+r[-5:])-1), h10=float(np.prod(1+r[-10:])-1),
            h20=float(np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1), h120=float(np.prod(1+r[-120:])-1),
            intra=float(np.nanmean((c[-5:]-o[-5:]) / np.maximum(o[-5:], 1e-12))),
            vr=float(np.mean(v[-5:]) / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-9)),
            vd=float(np.std(v[-20:]) / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-9)))
    if len(data) < 10: return
    syms = list(data); med5 = np.median([data[s]['h5'] for s in syms]); med10 = np.median([data[s]['h10'] for s in syms]); med20 = np.median([data[s]['h20'] for s in syms])
    f = {k: {} for k in FACTORS}
    for s in syms:
        d = data[s]; scale5=d['vol']*np.sqrt(5)+.01; scale10=d['vol']*np.sqrt(10)+.01
        f['mom120'][s] = d['h120']/(d['vol']*np.sqrt(120)+.03)
        f['rev5'][s] = (med5-d['h5'])/scale5
        f['rev10'][s] = (med10-d['h10'])/scale10
        # Relative dispersion and stress overlays are deliberately damped.
        f['disp_rev'][s] = (med20-d['h20'])/(d['vol']*np.sqrt(20)+.015)
        f['stress_rev'][s] = .65*(med20-d['h20'])/(d['down']*np.sqrt(20)+.02)
        f['volume_rev'][s] = f['rev5'][s] * (.75 + .25*np.clip(d['vr'], .5, 1.5))
        f['intraday_rev'][s] = -d['intra']/(d['vol']+.01)
        f['vol_rev10'][s] = f['rev10'][s]/(1+8*d['vol'])
    rr = {k: rank(x) for k,x in f.items()}
    score = {s: sum(FACTORS[k]*rr[k].get(s,.5) for k in FACTORS) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s:.35*score[s]+.65*_previous.get(s,.5) for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()
    breadth = np.mean([data[s]['h120'] > 0 for s in syms]); medvol=np.median([data[s]['vol'] for s in syms])
    high_risk = breadth < .50 or medvol > .018
    invmean=np.mean([1/data[s]['vol'] for s in syms]); raw={}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        d=data.get(s, {'vol':.02,'h120':0.})
        inv=(1/d['vol'])/max(invmean,1e-9)
        raw[s]=max(score[s],.10)*(.88+.12*min(inv,1.25))
        if high_risk and s in DEFENSIVE: raw[s]*=3.0
        elif high_risk and d['h120'] < -.10: raw[s]*=.60
    target=project(raw)
    if abs(sum(target.values())-1.) < 1e-8 and all(np.isfinite(x) and x>=0 for x in target.values()): rebalance_to_weights(target)
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
CADENCE = 10
MIN_W, MAX_W = 0.025, 0.18
# Screener 2028-05-18 ensemble; directions are all positive.
FACTOR_W = (0.50, 0.22, 0.13, 0.15)
_day = 0
_previous = None

def ranks(vals):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / n
    return out

def bounded(raw):
    # Iterative capped-simplex projection, preserving the complete portfolio.
    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 1.0)), 1e-10) for s in UNIVERSE}
    fixed = set()
    for _ in range(50):
        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in fixed]
        rem = 1.0 - sum(w[s] for s in fixed)
        z = sum(w[s] for s in free)
        for s in free: w[s] = rem * w[s] / max(z, 1e-12)
        hit = [s for s in free if w[s] < MIN_W or w[s] > MAX_W]
        if not hit: break
        for s in hit: w[s] = MIN_W if w[s] < MIN_W else MAX_W
        fixed.update(hit)
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s] / z for s in UNIVERSE}

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return
    d = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 80: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
        if len(c) < 80 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        vol = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        dn = max(float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.minimum(r[-20:], 0.0)**2))), 0.006)
        prior = c[-61:-1] if len(c) >= 61 else c[:-1]
        d[s] = {
            "vol": vol,
            # downside-adjusted 20-session momentum
            "dm": (np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1.0) / dn,
            # volatility-normalized distance above/below prior 60d high
            "bo": (c[-1]/max(np.max(prior),1e-12)-1.0) / max(vol*np.sqrt(60), .01),
            # up-day dominance, mildly smoothed by the 30d window
            "up": float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)),
            # additional medium horizon risk-adjusted momentum
            "m60": (np.prod(1+r[-60:])-1.0) / max(vol*np.sqrt(60), .01),
        }
    if len(d) < 10: return
    rr = [ranks({s:x[k] for s,x in d.items()}) for k in ("dm","bo","up","m60")]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_W[j]*rr[j][s] for j in range(4)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .70*score[s] + .30*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()
    medvol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in d.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m60"] > 0 for x in d.values()]))
    high_risk = medvol > .018 or breadth < .45
    invmean = float(np.mean([1.0/x["vol"] for x in d.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = d.get(s, {"vol":medvol, "m60":0.0})
        damp = np.clip((1/x["vol"])/max(invmean,1e-12), .65, 1.35)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .08) * (.86 + .14*damp)
        # In a high-risk sideways regime, express defense with tradable assets.
        if high_risk and s in DEFENSIVE: raw[s] *= 1.8
        if high_risk and s not in DEFENSIVE and x["m60"] < -.08: raw[s] *= .80
    rebalance_to_weights(bounded(raw))

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
CADENCE = 10
MIN_W, MAX_W = 0.025, 0.18
# Screener 2028-05-18 ensemble; directions are all positive.
FACTOR_W = (0.50, 0.22, 0.13, 0.15)
_day = 0
_previous = None

def ranks(vals):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / n
    return out

def bounded(raw):
    # Iterative capped-simplex projection, preserving the complete portfolio.
    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 1.0)), 1e-10) for s in UNIVERSE}
    fixed = set()
    for _ in range(50):
        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in fixed]
        rem = 1.0 - sum(w[s] for s in fixed)
        z = sum(w[s] for s in free)
        for s in free: w[s] = rem * w[s] / max(z, 1e-12)
        hit = [s for s in free if w[s] < MIN_W or w[s] > MAX_W]
        if not hit: break
        for s in hit: w[s] = MIN_W if w[s] < MIN_W else MAX_W
        fixed.update(hit)
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s] / z for s in UNIVERSE}

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return
    d = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 80: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
        if len(c) < 80 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        vol = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        dn = max(float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.minimum(r[-20:], 0.0)**2))), 0.006)
        prior = c[-61:-1] if len(c) >= 61 else c[:-1]
        d[s] = {
            "vol": vol,
            # downside-adjusted 20-session momentum
            "dm": (np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1.0) / dn,
            # volatility-normalized distance above/below prior 60d high
            "bo": (c[-1]/max(np.max(prior),1e-12)-1.0) / max(vol*np.sqrt(60), .01),
            # up-day dominance, mildly smoothed by the 30d window
            "up": float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)),
            # additional medium horizon risk-adjusted momentum
            "m60": (np.prod(1+r[-60:])-1.0) / max(vol*np.sqrt(60), .01),
        }
    if len(d) < 10: return
    rr = [ranks({s:x[k] for s,x in d.items()}) for k in ("dm","bo","up","m60")]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_W[j]*rr[j][s] for j in range(4)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .70*score[s] + .30*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()
    medvol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in d.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m60"] > 0 for x in d.values()]))
    high_risk = medvol > .018 or breadth < .45
    invmean = float(np.mean([1.0/x["vol"] for x in d.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = d.get(s, {"vol":medvol, "m60":0.0})
        damp = np.clip((1/x["vol"])/max(invmean,1e-12), .65, 1.35)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .08) * (.86 + .14*damp)
        # In a high-risk sideways regime, express defense with tradable assets.
        if high_risk and s in DEFENSIVE: raw[s] *= 1.8
        if high_risk and s not in DEFENSIVE and x["m60"] < -.08: raw[s] *= .80
    rebalance_to_weights(bounded(raw))

sum(w[s] for s in fixed)\\n        den = sum(w[s] for s in free)\\n        for s in free:\\n            w[s] = rem * w[s] / max(den, 1e-12)\\n        hit = [s for s in free if w[s] < MIN_W or w[s] > MAX_W]\\n        if not hit:\\n            break\\n        for s in hit:\\n            w[s] = MIN_W if w[s] < MIN_W else MAX_W\\n        fixed.update(hit)\\n    total = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: w[s] / total for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _day, _previous\\n    _day += 1\\n    if _day != 1 and (_day - import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
CADENCE = 10
MIN_W, MAX_W = 0.04, 0.20
# Current screener ensemble, capped at six active factors.
FACTORS = ("failure", "residual", "consistency", "short_breakout", "breakout120", "downside")
FACTOR_W = (0.24, 0.20, 0.18, 0.16, 0.12, 0.10)
_day = 0
_previous = None


def cs_rank(values):
    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    n = len(valid)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(n, 1)
    return out


def bounded_weights(raw):
    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 1.0)), 1e-10) for s in UNIVERSE}
    fixed = set()
    for _ in range(50):
        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in fixed]
        rem = 1.0 - sum(w[s] for s in fixed)
        den = sum(w[s] for s in free)
        for s in free:
            w[s] = rem * w[s] / max(den, 1e-12)
        hit = [s for s in free if w[s] < MIN_W or w[s] > MAX_W]
        if not hit:
            break
        for s in hit:
            w[s] = MIN_W if w[s] < MIN_W else MAX_W
        fixed.update(hit)
    total = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s] / total for s in UNIVERSE}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    feats, returns = {}, {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=190)
        if df is None or len(df) < 130:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
        if np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        r = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        vol = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        r5 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-5:]) - 1)
        r20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1)
        r30 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1)
        r60 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-60:]) - 1)
        h20 = max(np.max(close[-21:-1]), 1e-12)
        h120 = max(np.max(close[-121:-1]), 1e-12)
        downside = max(float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.minimum(r[-20:], 0) ** 2))), 0.006)
        # Breakout-failure reversal: prefer failed recent breakouts, but only
        # when price has retreated from its prior high; this is rank-normalized.
        failure = (-r5) * max(0.0, close[-1] / h20 - 0.985) / vol
        feats[symbol] = {
            "vol": vol,
            "failure": failure,
            "short_breakout": (close[-1] / h20 - 1) / max(vol * np.sqrt(20), .01),
            "breakout120": (close[-1] / h120 - 1) / max(vol * np.sqrt(120), .01),
            "downside": r20 / downside,
            "consistency": (r30 / max(vol * np.sqrt(30), .01)) * (.5 + float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0))),
            "residual": r20 / max(vol * np.sqrt(20), .01),
        }
        returns[symbol] = r
    if len(feats) < 10:
        return
    market = returns.get("SPX")
    for s, r in returns.items():
        n = min(60, len(r), len(market) if market is not None else 0)
        if market is not None and n >= 30:
            a, b = r[-n:], market[-n:]
            beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(b, ddof=1), 1e-8))
            mkt20 = float(np.prod(1 + b[-20:]) - 1) / max(np.std(b[-20:]) * np.sqrt(20), .01)
            feats[s]["residual"] -= beta * mkt20
    ranks = [cs_rank({s: feats[s].get(f, 0.0) for s in feats}) for f in FACTORS]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_W[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(len(FACTORS))) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.75 * score[s] + 0.25 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()
    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in feats.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["breakout120"] > 0 for x in feats.values()]))
    high_risk = median_vol > 0.018 or breadth < 0.45
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol"] for x in feats.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = feats.get(s, {"vol": median_vol, "breakout120": 0.0})
        vol_damp = np.clip((1.0 / x["vol"]) / max(inv_mean, 1e-12), 0.65, 1.25)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.05) * (0.82 + 0.18 * vol_damp)
        if high_risk:

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]

_day = 0
_previous = None


def cs_rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def bounded_weights(raw):
    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 1.0)), 1e-12) for s in UNIVERSE}
    fixed = set()
    for _ in range(50):
        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in fixed]
        rem = 1.0 - sum(w[s] for s in fixed)
        den = sum(w[s] for s in free)
        for s in free:
            w[s] = rem * w[s] / max(den, 1e-12)
        hit = [s for s in free if w[s] < MIN_W or w[s] > MAX_W]
        if not hit:
            break
        for s in hit:
            w[s] = MIN_W if w[s] < MIN_W else MAX_W
        fixed.update(hit)
    total = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s] / total for s in UNIVERSE}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
CADENCE = 10
MIN_W, MAX_W = 0.04, 0.20
# Screener ensemble: failure reversal, residual momentum, consistency,
# short/long breakout and downside-adjusted momentum.
FACTORS = ("failure", "residual", "consistency", "short_breakout", "breakout120", "downside")
FACTOR_W = (0.26, 0.22, 0.20, 0.14, 0.10, 0.08)
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_cs(values):
    valid = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(valid), 1)
    return out


def bounded(raw):
    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 1.0)), 1e-12) for s in UNIVERSE}
    fixed = set()
    for _ in range(40):
        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in fixed]
        rem = 1.0 - sum(w[s] for s in fixed)
        den = sum(w[s] for s in free)
        for s in free:
            w[s] = rem * w[s] / max(den, 1e-12)
        hit = [s for s in free if w[s] < MIN_W or w[s] > MAX_W]
        if not hit:
            break
        for s in hit:
            w[s] = MIN_W if w[s] < MIN_W else MAX_W
        fixed.update(hit)
    total = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s] / total for s in UNIVERSE}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    feats, rets = {}, {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=190)
        if df is None or len(df) < 130:
            continue

        r20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1)
        r30 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1)
        h20 = max(float(np.max(close[-21:-1])), 1e-12)
        h120 = max(float(np.max(close[-121:-1])), 1e-12)

        feats[s] = {

            "short_breakout": (close[-1] / h20 - 1.0) / max(vol * np.sqrt(20), .01),
            "breakout120": (close[-1] / h120 - 1.0) / max(vol * np.sqrt(120), .01),
            "downside": r20 / downvol,
            "consistency": r30 / max(vol * np.sqrt(30), .01) * (.5 + np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)),
            "residual": r20 / max(vol * np.sqrt(20), .01),
        }
        rets[s] = r
    if len(feats) < 10:
        return

    # Remove broad-market beta from the residual signal.
    market = rets.get("SPX")
    if market is not None:
        for s, r in rets.items():
            n = min(60, len(r), len(market))

                a, b = r[-n:], market[-n:]
                beta = np.cov(a, b, ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(b, ddof=1), 1e-8)
                mkt_signal = np.prod(1 + b[-20:]) - 1
                feats[s]["residual"] -= beta * mkt_signal / max(np.std(b[-20:]) * np.sqrt(20), .01)

    ranks = [rank_cs({s: feats[s][f] for s in feats}) for f in FACTORS]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_W[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(6)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .75 * score[s] + .25 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in feats.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["breakout120"] > 0 for x in feats.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > .018 or breadth < .45
    mean_invvol = np.mean([1.0 / x["vol"] for x in feats.values()])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:

        if stressed:
            # Full investment is retained, but stress is expressed in the
            # tradable defensive assets rather than cash.
            raw[s] *= 5.0 if s in DEFENSIVE else (.55 if x["breakout120"] < -.10 else .78)
    target = bounded(raw)
    if np.isfinite(sum(target.values())) and abs(sum(target.values()) - 1.0) < 1e-8:
        rebalance_to_weights(target)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
CADENCE = 10
MIN_W, MAX_W = 0.04, 0.20
# Screener ensemble: all directions are positive and ranks are lagged.
FACTORS = ("failure", "volstate", "dispersion", "residual", "consistency", "short_breakout", "breakout120", "downside")
FACTOR_W = (0.24, 0.18, 0.14, 0.14, 0.11, 0.07, 0.06, 0.06)
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_cs(vals):
    valid = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(valid))
    return out


def bounded(raw):
    # Iterative projection onto the complete, long-only 4%-20% portfolio.
    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 1.0)), 1e-10) for s in UNIVERSE}
    fixed = set()
    for _ in range(50):
        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in fixed]
        rem = 1.0 - sum(w[s] for s in fixed)
        den = sum(w[s] for s in free)
        for s in free:
            w[s] = rem * w[s] / max(den, 1e-12)
        hit = [s for s in free if w[s] < MIN_W or w[s] > MAX_W]
        if not hit:
            break
        for s in hit:
            w[s] = MIN_W if w[s] < MIN_W else MAX_W
        fixed.update(hit)
    total = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s] / total for s in UNIVERSE}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    feats, rets = {}, {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=195)
        if df is None or len(df) < 135:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        r = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        vol = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        r3 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-3:]) - 1)
        r5 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-5:]) - 1)
        r20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1)
        r30 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1)
        h20, h60, h120 = max(close[-21:]), max(close[-61:]), max(close[-121:])
        downvol = max(float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.minimum(r[-20:], 0) ** 2))), 0.006)
        # Reversal and risk-state terms are deliberately bounded to avoid
        # extreme weights during the stressed regime.
        feats[symbol] = {
            "vol": vol,
            "failure": np.clip((-r5) * max(0., close[-1] / h20 - .985) / vol, -3, 3),
            "volstate": np.clip((-r3) / vol, -3, 3),
            "dispersion": np.clip((-r5) / max(vol * np.sqrt(5), .01), -3, 3),
            "residual": r20 / max(vol * np.sqrt(20), .01),
            "consistency": r30 / max(vol * np.sqrt(30), .01) * (.5 + np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)),
            "short_breakout": (close[-1] / h20 - 1.) / max(vol * np.sqrt(20), .01),
            "breakout120": (close[-1] / h120 - 1.) / max(vol * np.sqrt(120), .01),
            "downside": r20 / downvol,
        }
        rets[symbol] = r
    if len(feats) < 10:
        return

    # Remove broad market beta from the residual trend signal.
    market = rets.get("SPX")
    if market is not None:
        for s, r in rets.items():
            n = min(60, len(r), len(market))
            if n >= 30:
                beta = np.cov(r[-n:], market[-n:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(market[-n:], ddof=1), 1e-8)
                m20 = np.prod(1 + market[-20:]) - 1
                feats[s]["residual"] -= beta * m20 / max(np.std(market[-20:]) * np.sqrt(20), .01)

    ranks = [rank_cs({s: feats[s][f] for s in feats}) for f in FACTORS]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_W[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(len(FACTORS))) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .75 * score[s] + .25 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()

    vols = [x["vol"] for x in feats.values()]
    medvol = float(np.median(vols))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["breakout120"] > 0 for x in feats.values()]))
    stressed = medvol > .018 or breadth < .45
    invmean = float(np.mean([1. / x["vol"] for x in feats.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = feats.get(s, {"vol": medvol, "breakout120": 0.})
        risk_damp = np.clip((1. / x["vol"]) / max(invmean, 1e-12), .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .08) * (.84 + .16 * risk_damp)
        if stressed:
            # Defensive rotation, but less aggressive than the prior 5x tilt
            # so one correlated hedge cannot dominate the bounded portfolio.
            raw[s] *= 2.25 if s in DEFENSIVE else (.68 if x["breakout120"] < -.10 else .80)
    target = bounded(raw)
    if all(np.isfinite(target[s]) for s in UNIVERSE) and abs(sum(target.values()) - 1.) < 1e-8:
        rebalance_to_weights(target)

        for s in free:

ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nDEFENSIVE = {\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\nCADENCE = 10\\nMIN_W, MAX_W = 0.04, 0.18\\n# Screener ensemble (eight active factors, weights sum to one).\\nFACTORS = (\\"residual\\", \\"consistency\\", \\"short_breakout\\", \\"breakout120\\", \\"failure\\", \\"downside\\", \\"relative\\", \\"volstate\\")\\nFACTOR_W = (0.20, 0.20, 0.14, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.06)\\n_day = 0\\n_previous = None\\n\\ndef rank_values(values):\\n    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))\\n    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):\\n        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(valid))\\n    return out\\n\\ndef bounded(raw):\\n    # Iterative projection keeps every tradable asset invested and respects bounds.\\n    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    fixed = {}\\n    for _ in range(50):\\n        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in fixed]\\n        left = 1.0 - import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]

CADENCE = 10
MIN_W, MAX_W = 0.04, 0.18

# controlled failure reversal, downside-adjusted momentum, and vol-state reversal.
FACTORS = ("residual", "consistency", "short_breakout", "breakout120", "failure", "downside", "relative", "volstate")
FACTOR_W = (0.20, 0.18, 0.14, 0.12, 0.10, 0.10, 0.08, 0.08)
_day = 0
_previous = None

def ranks(vals):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.) / max(1, len(good))
    return out

def bounded(raw):
    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE}
    fixed = {}
    for _ in range(50):
        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in fixed]
        left = 1.0 - sum(fixed.values())
        total = sum(w[s] for s in free)
        for s in free: w[s] = left * w[s] / max(total, 1e-12)
        hit = [s for s in free if w[s] < MIN_W or w[s] > MAX_W]
        if not hit: break
        for s in hit:
            fixed[s] = MIN_W if w[s] < MIN_W else MAX_W
            w[s] = fixed[s]
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s] / max(z, 1e-12) for s in UNIVERSE}

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    feat, rets = {}, {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=210)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), v20, .006)

        r20 = np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1; r30 = np.prod(1+r[-30:])-1

        downside_vol = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) > 1 else v20, .006)

            "consistency": np.clip(r30/(v20*np.sqrt(30))*(.5+np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)), -3, 3),
            "short_breakout": np.clip(r20/(v20*np.sqrt(20)), -3, 3),
            "breakout120": np.clip(c[-1]/max(c[-121:])-1, -3, 3),
            "failure": np.clip(-r5/v20, -3, 3),
            "downside": np.clip(r20/(downside_vol*np.sqrt(20)), -3, 3),
            "relative": np.clip(r20/(v20*np.sqrt(20)), -3, 3),
            "volstate": np.clip(-r3/v20, -3, 3),
            "vol": v20}
        rets[s] = r
    if len(feat) < 10: return
    market = rets.get("SPX")
    if market is not None:
        for s, r in rets.items():
            n = min(60, len(r), len(market))
            if n >= 30:
                beta = np.cov(r[-n:], market[-n:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(market[-n:], ddof=1), 1e-8)
                feat[s]["residual"] = np.clip(feat[s]["residual"] - beta * np.prod(1+market[-20:])-1, -3, 3)
    rr = {f: ranks({s: feat[s][f] for s in feat}) for f in FACTORS}
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_W[i]*rr[FACTORS[i]][s] for i in range(8)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s: .70*score[s] + .30*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()
    medvol = np.median([x["vol"] for x in feat.values()])
    breadth = np.mean([x["breakout120"] > 0 for x in feat.values()])
    stressed = medvol > .018 or breadth < .40
    invmean = np.mean([1/x["vol"] for x in feat.values()])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = feat.get(s, {"vol": medvol, "breakout120": 0})
        damp = np.clip((1/x["vol"])/max(invmean, 1e-12), .80, 1.12)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .05) * (.90 + .10*damp)
        if stressed: raw[s] *= 1.22 if s in DEFENSIVE else (.88 if x["breakout120"] < 0 else .80)
    target = bounded(raw)
    if abs(sum(target.values())-1) < 1e-8 and all(np.isfinite(v) for v in target.values()):
        rebalance_to_weights(target)

ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nDEFENSIVE = {\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\nRISKY = {\\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"COPPER\\"}\\nCADENCE = 10\\nMIN_W, MAX_W = 0.04, 0.18\\n# Current six-factor screener ensemble, mapped to lagged price/volatility proxies.\\nFACTORS = (\\"cluster_reversal\\", \\"volstate\\", \\"failure\\", \\"lowvol_reversal\\", \\"consistency\\", \\"dispersion\\")\\nFACTOR_W = (0.22, 0.20, 0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.10)\\n_day = 0\\n_previous = None\\n\\n\\ndef ranks(values):\\n    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))\\n    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):\\n        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(valid))\\n    return out\\n\\n\\ndef bounded_weights(raw):\\n    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 0.05)), 1e-12) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    fixed = {}\\n    for _ in range(60):\\n        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in fixed]\\n        left = 1.0 - sum(fixed.values())\\n        z = sum(w[s] for s in free)\\n        for s in free:\\n            w[s] = left * w[s] / max(z, 1e-12)\\n        hits = [s for s in free if w[s] < MIN_W or w[s] > MAX_W]\\n        if not hits:\\n            break\\n        for s in hits:\\n            fixed[s] = MIN_W if w[s] < MIN_W else MAX_W\\n            w[s] = fixed[s]\\n    z = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: w[s] / max(z, 1e-12) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _day, _previous\\n    _day += 1\\n    if _day != 1 and (_day - sum(fixed.values())\\n        z = sum(base[s] for s in active)\\n        proposed = {s: remaining * base[s] / max(z, 1e-12) for s in active}\\n        low = [s for s in active if proposed[s] < MIN_W]\\n        high = [s for s in active if proposed[s] > MAX_W]\\n        if not low and not high:\\n            fixed.update(proposed)\\n            break\\n        for s in low:\\n            fixed[s] = MIN_W\\n            active.remove(s)\\n        for s in high:\\n            fixed[s] = MAX_W\\n            active.remove(s)\\n        if not active:\\n            break\\n    if active:\\n        rem = 1.0 - 1) / v20\\n        data[symbol][\\"failure\\"] = -float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1) / v20\\n        data[symbol][\\"dispersion\\"] = -float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1) / v60\\n        data[symbol][\\"consistency\\"] = float(np.mean(ret[-60:] > 0) - .5) / v60\\n        data[symbol][\\"breakout\\"] = float(close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-121:-1]), 1e-12) - 1) / v60\\n        data[symbol][\\"relative\\"] = float(close[-1] / max(close[-21], 1e-12) - 1) / v60\\n    if len(data) < 10:\\n        return\\n    market = data.get(\\"000300.SH\\", data.get(\\"SPX\\"))\\n    mr = market[\\"r\\"][-20:] if market else np.zeros(20)\\n    vm = max(float(np.var(mr)), 1e-8)\\n    for x in data.values():\\n        ar = x[\\"r\\"][-20:]\\n        beta = float(np.cov(ar, mr, ddof=0)[0, 1] / vm)\\n        x[\\"residual\\"] = float(np.mean(ar - ### Observations

- Regime alignment was favorable over this cycle, but the recovery remains insufficiently broad for an aggressive risk increase.

- Continue monitoring the correlation and recent efficacy of breakout and momentum factors.
- Keep reversal factors at restrained weights until sustained improvement is demonstrated.
- Continue evaluating defensive assets as stabilizers during medium-high-risk periods.

### Plans
- Retain the current 9-factor ensemble, 4%–18% bounds, inverse-volatility scaling, and 10-day cadence for the next cycle.
- Avoid increasing exposure to higher-volatility commodities and crypto assets without stronger breadth confirmation.
- Reassess after the next live block for evidence that the bullish recovery is becoming more persistent.
