ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nDEFENSIVE = {\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\nRISKY = {\\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"COPPER\\"}\\nFACTORS = (\\"consistency\\", \\"breakout120\\", \\"residual\\", \\"downside\\", \\"relative\\", \\"short_breakout\\", \\"failure\\", \\"volstate\\", \\"dispersion\\")\\nFACTOR_W = {\\"consistency\\": .22, \\"breakout120\\": .22, \\"residual\\": .18, \\"downside\\": .10,\\n            \\"relative\\": .08, \\"short_breakout\\": .08, \\"failure\\": .07,\\n            \\"volstate\\": .03, \\"dispersion\\": .02}\\nCADENCE, MIN_W, MAX_W = 10, .04, .18\\n_previous, _day = None, 0\\n\\ndef cs_rank(values):\\n    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))\\n    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):\\n        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)\\n    return out\\n\\ndef bounded_simplex(raw):\\n    # Iterative projection keeps every tradable asset invested, with no cash sleeve.\\n    active, fixed = set(UNIVERSE), {}\\n    base = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 1.0)), 1e-9) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    for _ in range(40):\\n        rem = 1.0 - sum(fixed.values())\\n        z = sum(base[s] for s in active)\\n        provisional = {s: rem * base[s] / max(z, 1e-12) for s in active}\\n        low = [s for s in active if provisional[s] < MIN_W]\\n        high = [s for s in active if provisional[s] > MAX_W]\\n        if not low and not high:\\n            fixed.update(provisional)\\n            break\\n        for s in low:\\n            fixed[s] = MIN_W\\n            active.remove(s)\\n        for s in high:\\n            fixed[s] = MAX_W\\n            active.remove(s)\\n    if active:\\n        rem = 1.0 - sum(fixed.values())\\n        z = sum(base[s] for s in active)\\n        fixed.update({s: rem * base[s] / max(z, 1e-12) for s in active})\\n    total = sum(fixed.values())\\n    return {s: max(0.0, fixed.get(s, 0.0)) / max(total, 1e-12) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _day, _previous\\n    _day += 1\\n    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:\\n        return\\n    data = {}\\n    for symbol in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=240)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 130:\\n            continue\\n        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values(\\"date\\")[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)[:-1]\\n        if len(close) < 121 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):\\n            continue\\n        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0\\n        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), .006)\\n        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), .006)\\n        recent = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-20:]) - 1.0)\\n        neg = ret[-60:][ret[-60:] < 0]\\n        downside = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else .006, .006)\\n        data[symbol] = {\\n            \\"r\\": ret, \\"v20\\": v20,\\n            \\"consistency\\": (float(np.mean(ret[-60:] > 0)) - .5) / v60,\\n            \\"breakout120\\": (float(close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-121:-1]), 1e-12)) - 1.0) / v60,\\n            \\"short_breakout\\": (float(close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-21:-1]), 1e-12)) - 1.0) / v20,\\n            \\"relative\\": recent / v60,\\n            \\"downside\\": recent / downside,\\n            # Reversal factors are deliberately small and turnover-controlled.\\n            \\"failure\\": -float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-5:]) - 1.0) / v20,\\n            \\"volstate\\": -float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-3:]) - 1.0) / v20,\\n        }\\n    if len(data) < 10:\\n        return\\n    market = data.get(\\"000300.SH\\", data.get(\\"SPX\\"))\\n    mr = market[\\"r\\"][-20:] if market else np.zeros(20)\\n    vm = max(float(np.var(mr)), 1e-8)\\n    for x in data.values():\\n        ar = x[\\"r\\"][-20:]\\n        beta = float(np.cov(ar, mr, ddof=0)[0, 1] / vm)\\n        x[\\"residual\\"] = float(np.mean(ar - beta * mr)) / max(x[\\"v20\\"], .006)\\n        x[\\"dispersion\\"] = -abs(float(np.std(ar) - np.std(mr))) / max(x[\\"v20\\"], .006)\\n    ranks = {f: cs_rank({s: x[f] for s, x in data.items()}) for f in FACTORS}\\n    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_W[f] * ranks[f][s] for f in FACTORS) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    if _previous is not None:\\n        score = {s: .70 * score[s] + .30 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    _previous = score.copy()\\n    median_v = float(np.median([x[\\"v20\\"] for x in data.values()]))\\n    breadth = float(np.mean([x[\\"consistency\\"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))\\n    m30 = float(np.prod(1.0 + market[\\"r\\"][-30:]) - 1.0) if market else 0.0\\n    stressed = median_v > .015 or m30 < -.06 or breadth < .40\\n    invmean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x[\\"v20\\"] for x in data.values()]))\\n    raw = {}\\n    for symbol in UNIVERSE:\\n        x = data.get(symbol)\\n        vol = x[\\"v20\\"] if x else median_v\\n        damp = np.clip((1.0 / max(vol, .006)) / max(invmean, 1e-9), .78, 1.10)\\n        raw[symbol] = max(score[symbol], .02) * (.88 + .12 * damp)\\n        if stressed:\\n            raw[symbol] *= 2.00 if symbol in DEFENSIVE else (.35 if symbol in RISKY else .82)\\n        elif symbol in DEFENSIVE:\\n            raw[symbol] *= 1.12\\n        elif symbol in RISKY:\\n            raw[symbol] *= .85\\n    target = bounded_simplex(raw)\\n    if set(target) == set(UNIVERSE) and all(np.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in target.values()):\\n        rebalance_to_weights(target)\\n","file_path":"strategy.py"}', call_id='call_LRXop7Wg2hGFJJJAeyPBGzkn', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_0ca5ea5f0ebbeb21016a7bf171f7cc81918008de43b7c13f1c', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

def bounded(raw):

    stressed = median_vol > .015 or market_return < -.06 or breadth < .40
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1. / max(x["v20"], .006) for x in data.values()]))

r20 = float(np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1)\\n        data[s] = {\\"r\\": r, \\"v20\\": v20,\\n                   \\"volstate\\": -r3 * v20 / v60,\\n                   \\"failure\\": -r20 / v60,\\n                   \\"dispersion\\": -r20 / v30,\\n                   \\"consistency\\": (float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0))-.5) / v30,\\n                   \\"relative\\": float(np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1) / v20}\\n    if len(data) < 10: return\\n    market = data.get(\\"000300.SH\\", data.get(\\"SPX\\"))\\n    if market is None: return\\n    mr = market[\\"r\\"][-20:]; var = max(float(np.var(mr)), 1e-8)\\n    for x in data.values():\\n        ar = x[\\"r\\"][-20:]\\n        beta = float(np.cov(ar, mr, ddof=0)[0,1] / var)\\n        x[\\"beta\\"] = float(np.mean(ar - beta * mr)) / x[\\"v20\\"]\\n    names = [\\"volstate\\", \\"failure\\", \\"consistency\\", \\"dispersion\\", \\"relative\\", \\"beta\\"]\\n    ranks = {n: rank({s: x[n] for s, x in data.items()}) for n in names}\\n    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[n].get(s, .5) for n, w in zip(names, FACTOR_WEIGHTS)) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    if _previous is not None: score = {s: .70*score[s] + .30*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    _previous = score.copy()\\n    medvol = float(np.median([x[\\"v20\\"] for x in data.values()]))\\n    breadth = float(np.mean([x[\\"consistency\\"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))\\n    stressed = medvol > .015 or float(np.prod(1+mr)-1) < -.06 or breadth < .40\\n    invmean = float(np.mean([1/max(x[\\"v20\\"], .006) for x in data.values()]))\\n    raw = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        x = data.get(s); ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nDEFENSIVE = {\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\nRISKY = {\\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"COPPER\\"}\\nFACTOR_IDS = [\\n    \\"miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30\\",\\n    \\"miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20\\",\\n    \\"miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20\\",\\n    \\"miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal\\",\\n    \\"miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d\\",\\n    \\"miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal\\",\\n]\\nFACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.22, 0.20, 0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.10]\\nCADENCE = 10\\n_day = 0\\n_previous = None\\n\\n\\ndef percentile(vals):\\n    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))\\n    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    n = max(len(good), 1)\\n    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):\\n        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / n\\n    return out\\n\\n\\ndef normalize(raw):\\n    # Smooth inverse-volatility allocation with explicit 15-asset full investment.\\n    lo, hi = 0.035, 0.17\\n    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 1e-10) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    fixed, free = {}, set(UNIVERSE)\\n    for _ in range(30):\\n        if not free: break\\n        rem = 1.0 - sum(fixed.values())\\n        z = sum(w[s] for s in free)\\n        p = {s: rem*w[s]/max(z, 1e-12) for s in free}\\n        low = [s for s in free if p[s] < lo]\\n        high = [s for s in free if p[s] > hi]\\n        if not low and not high:\\n            fixed.update(p); free.clear(); break\\n        for s in low: fixed[s] = lo; free.remove(s)\\n        for s in high: fixed[s] = hi; free.remove(s)\\n    if free:\\n        rem = 1.0 - sum(fixed.values())\\n        z = sum(w[s] for s in free)\\n        fixed.update({s: rem*w[s]/max(z, 1e-12) for s in free})\\n    z = sum(fixed.values())\\n    return {s: fixed.get(s, 0.0)/max(z, 1e-12) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _day, _previous\\n    _day += 1\\n    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:\\n        return\\n    data = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=270)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue\\n        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values(\\"date\\")[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)[:-1]\\n        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue\\n        r = c[1:]/c[:-1] - 1.0\\n        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006)\\n        v30 = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), .006)\\n        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)\\n        r1 = float(r[-1]); r20 = float(np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1)\\n        consistency = (float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0))-.5)/v30\\n        data[s] = {\\"r\\": r, \\"v20\\": v20, \\"consistency\\": consistency,\\n                   \\"relative\\": r20/v20, \\"failure\\": -r20/v60,\\n                   \\"lowrev\\": -r1/v20, \\"dispersion\\": -r20/v30}\\n    if len(data) < 10: return\\n    market = data.get(\\"000300.SH\\", data.get(\\"SPX\\"))\\n    if market is None: return\\n    mr = market[\\"r\\"][-20:]\\n    var = max(float(np.var(mr)), 1e-8)\\n    for x in data.values():\\n        ar = x[\\"r\\"][-20:]\\n        beta = float(np.cov(ar, mr, ddof=0)[0, 1] / var)\\n        x[\\"beta\\"] = float(np.mean(ar - beta*mr))/x[\\"v20\\"]\\n    names = [\\"consistency\\", \\"beta\\", \\"relative\\", \\"failure\\", \\"lowrev\\", \\"dispersion\\"]\\n    ranks = {n: percentile({s: x[n] for s, x in data.items()}) for n in names}\\n    score = {s: sum(w*ranks[n].get(s, .5) for n, w in zip(names, FACTOR_WEIGHTS)) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    if _previous is not None:\\n        score = {s: .70*score[s] + .30*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    _previous = score.copy()\\n    medvol = float(np.median([x[\\"v20\\"] for x in data.values()]))\\n    breadth = float(np.mean([x[\\"consistency\\"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))\\n    stressed = medvol > .015 or float(np.prod(1+mr)-1) < -.06 or breadth < .40\\n    invmean = float(np.mean([1/max(x[\\"v20\\"], .006) for x in data.values()]))\\n    raw = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        x = data.get(s); vol = x[\\"v20\\"] if x else medvol\\n        damp = np.clip((1/max(vol,.006))/max(invmean,1e-12), .78, 1.10)\\n        raw[s] = max(score[s], .02) * (.88 + .12*damp)\\n        if stressed:\\n            raw[s] *= 2.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else (.30 if s in RISKY else .75)\\n        else:\\n            raw[s] *= 1.10 if s in DEFENSIVE else (.86 if s in RISKY else 1.0)\\n    target = normalize(raw)\\n    forecast_returns = {s: float(np.clip((score[s]-.5)*.08, -.04, .04)) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    if all(np.isfinite(target[s]) and target[s] >= 0 for s in UNIVERSE) and abs(sum(target.values())-1.0) < 1e-8:\\n        rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast_returns, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)\\n\\n\\n# strategy ensemble synchronized 2031-03-20\\n# factor directions are positive as supplied by Screener\\n","file_path":"strategy.py"}', call_id='call_l0JwA71I34CzXK9mJAeLAiTt', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_0ea85da4cee9111a016a7c39abcc7c819896576d60b49559b1', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

input: ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nDEFENSIVE = {\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\nRISKY = {\\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"COPPER\\"}\\nFACTOR_IDS = [\\n    \\"miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30\\",\\n    \\"miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20\\",\\n    \\"miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20\\",\\n    \\"miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal\\",\\n    \\"miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal\\",\\n    \\"miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d\\",\\n]\\nFACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.25, 0.19, 0.17, 0.16, 0.14, 0.09]\\nCADENCE = 10\\n_day = 0\\n_previous = None\\n\\ndef ranks(values):\\n    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))\\n    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    n = max(1, len(good))\\n    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good): out[s] = (i + 1.0) / n\\n    return out\\n\\ndef bounded_weights(raw):\\n    lo, hi = .035, .17\\n    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, .01)), 1e-12) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    fixed, free = {}, set(UNIVERSE)\\n    for _ in range(40):\\n        if not free: break\\n        rem = 1 - sum(fixed.values()); z = sum(w[s] for s in free)\\n        p = {s: rem*w[s]/z for s in free}\\n        low = [s for s in free if p[s] < lo]; high = [s for s in free if p[s] > hi]\\n        if not low and not high: fixed.update(p); free.clear(); break\\n        for s in low: fixed[s] = lo; free.remove(s)\\n        for s in high: fixed[s] = hi; free.remove(s)\\n    if free:\\n        rem = 1 - sum(fixed.values()); z = sum(w[s] for s in free)\\n        fixed.update({s: rem*w[s]/z for s in free})\\n    z = sum(fixed.values())\\n    return {s: fixed.get(s, 0) / z for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _day, _previous\\n    _day += 1\\n    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE: return\\n    data = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=270)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue\\n        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values(\\"date\\")[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)[:-1]\\n        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue\\n        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1\\n        v20, v30, v60 = max(np.std(r[-20:]), .006), max(np.std(r[-30:]), .006), max(np.std(r[-60:]), .006)\\n        r1, r20 = r[-1], np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1\\n        data[s] = {\\"r\\":r, \\"v20\\":v20, \\"consistency\\":(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)-.5)/v30,\\n                   \\"relative\\":r20/v20, \\"failure\\":-r20/v60, \\"lowrev\\":-r1/v20, \\"dispersion\\":-r20/v30}\\n    if len(data) < 10: return\\n    market = data.get(\\"000300.SH\\", data.get(\\"SPX\\"))\\n    if market is None: return\\n    mr = market[\\"r\\"][-20:]; var = max(np.var(mr), 1e-8)\\n    for x in data.values():\\n        ar = x[\\"r\\"][-20:]; beta = np.cov(ar, mr, ddof=0)[0,1] / var\\n        x[\\"beta\\"] = np.mean(ar - beta*mr) / x[\\"v20\\"]\\n    names = [\\"consistency\\", \\"beta\\", \\"relative\\", \\"failure\\", \\"dispersion\\", \\"lowrev\\"]\\n    rr = {n:ranks({s:x[n] for s,x in data.items()}) for n in names}\\n    score = {s:sum(w*rr[n].get(s,.5) for n,w in zip(names, FACTOR_WEIGHTS)) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    if _previous is not None: score = {s:.70*score[s]+.30*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    _previous = score.copy()\\n    medvol = np.median([x[\\"v20\\"] for x in data.values()])\\n    breadth = np.mean([x[\\"consistency\\"] > 0 for x in data.values()])\\n    stressed = medvol > .015 or np.prod(1+mr)-1 < -.06 or breadth < .40\\n    invmean = np.mean([1/max(x[\\"v20\\"],.006) for x in data.values()])\\n    raw = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        x=data.get(s); vol=x[\\"v20\\"] if x else medvol\\n        damp=np.clip((1/max(vol,.006))/max(invmean,1e-12),.78,1.10)\\n        raw[s]=max(score[s],.02)*(.88+.12*damp)\\n        raw[s]*= (2.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else (.30 if s in RISKY else .75)) if stressed else (1.10 if s in DEFENSIVE else (.86 if s in RISKY else 1))\\n    target=bounded_weights(raw)\\n    forecast_returns={s:float(np.clip((score[s]-.5)*.08,-.04,.04)) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    if all(np.isfinite(target[s]) and target[s]>=0 for s in UNIVERSE) and abs(sum(target.values())-1)<1e-8:\\n        rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast_returns, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)\\n","file_path":"strategy.py"}', call_id='call_h9vrJj8cKXxBn4mHQnLvnigs', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_0ff8155c11d9c82b016a7c3cbb05f88191b9bb0530d3d7dace', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

r20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1); r120 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-120:]) - 1)\\n        data[s] = {\\"ret\\": ret, \\"v20\\": v20, \\"v30\\": v30, \\"v60\\": v60,\\n                   \\"cons\\": (float(np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0)) - .5) / v30,\\n                   \\"beta\\": 0.0, \\"relative\\": r20 / v20, \\"breakout\\": r120 / v60,\\n                   \\"disp\\": -r20 / v30, \\"lowrev\\": -r1 / v20}\\n    if len(data) < 10:\\n        return\\n    market = data.get(\\"000300.SH\\", data.get(\\"SPX\\"))\\n    if market is None:\\n        return\\n    mr = market[\\"ret\\"][-20:]; var = max(float(np.var(mr)), 1e-8)\\n    for x in data.values():\\n        ar = x[\\"ret\\"][-20:]\\n        beta = float(np.cov(ar, mr, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / var\\n        x[\\"beta\\"] = float(np.mean(ar - beta * mr) / x[\\"v20\\"])\\n    names = [\\"cons\\", \\"beta\\", \\"relative\\", \\"breakout\\", \\"disp\\", \\"lowrev\\"]\\n    ranks = {n: cs_rank({s: x[n] for s, x in data.items()}) for n in names}\\n    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[n].get(s, .5) for w, n in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, names)) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    if _previous is not None:\\n        score = {s: .70 * score[s] + .30 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    _previous = score.copy()\\n    medvol = float(np.median([x[\\"v20\\"] for x in data.values()]))\\n    breadth = float(np.mean([x[\\"cons\\"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))\\n    stressed = medvol > .015 or float(np.prod(1 + mr) - 1) < -.06 or breadth < .40\\n    invmean = float(np.mean([1 / max(x[\\"v20\\"], .006) for x in data.values()]))\\n    raw = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        x = data.get(s); import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.22, 0.17, 0.16, 0.14, 0.14, 0.09, 0.08]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def rank(vals):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out

def bounded_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    # Full investment, long-only, and sensible concentration for 15 assets.
    for _ in range(30):
        w /= w.sum()
        w = np.clip(w, 0.035, 0.17)
    w /= w.sum()
    return {s: float(x) for s, x in zip(UNIVERSE, w)}

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v1 = max(float(np.std(ret[-5:])), 0.006)
        v3 = max(float(np.std(ret[-15:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        r1 = float(ret[-1]); r3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        r20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        r60 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-60:]) - 1)
        r120 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-120:]) - 1)
        data[s] = {"v20": v20, "v30": v30, "v60": v60,
                   # Positive values are deliberately consistent with each factor's +1 direction.
                   "volstate": -r3 / v3,
                   "cons": (float(np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0)) - .5) / v30,
                   "relative": r20 / v20,
                   "beta": 0.0,
                   "disp": -r20 / v30,
                   "failure": -max(r120 - r60, -0.20) / v60,
                   "lowrev": -r1 / v1}
    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    market = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))
    if market is None:
        return
    mr = next((data[s]["ret"][-20:] for s in data if s == "000300.SH"), None)
    if mr is None:
        # Reconstruct market returns only when the preferred benchmark is unavailable.
        mdf = get_stock_daily_data(symbol="SPX", days=30)
        mr = np.asarray(mdf.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        mr = mr[1:] / mr[:-1]
    var = max(float(np.var(mr)), 1e-8)
    # beta-residual momentum: recent return after removing market beta.
    for s, x in data.items():
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=30)
        if df is None:
            continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        ar = c[1:] / c[:-1]
        n = min(20, len(ar), len(mr)); ar = ar[-n:]; bm = mr[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(ar, bm, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / var
        x["beta"] = float(np.mean(ar - beta * bm) / x["v20"])
    names = ["volstate", "beta", "disp", "failure", "cons", "lowrev", "relative"]
    ranks = {n: rank({s: x[n] for s, x in data.items()}) for n in names}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[n].get(s, .5) for w, n in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, names)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .70 * score[s] + .30 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()
    medvol = float(np.median([x["v20"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["cons"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = medvol > .015 or float(np.prod(1 + mr[-20:]) - 1) < -.06 or breadth < .40
    invmean = float(np.mean([1 / max(x["v20"], .006) for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s); vol = x["v20"] if x else medvol
        damp = np.clip((1 / max(vol, .006)) / max(invmean, 1e-12), .78, 1.10)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .02) * (.88 + .12 * damp)
        raw[s] *= (2.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else .30 if s in RISKY else .75) if stressed else (1.10 if s in DEFENSIVE else .86 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
    target = bounded_weights(raw)
    forecast_returns = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .08, -.04, .04)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast_returns, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.28, 0.24, 0.18, 0.14, 0.10, 0.06]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_cs(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def full_weights(raw, floor=0.02, ceiling=0.25):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    # Iterative capped simplex projection; preserves a complete, long-only target.
    for _ in range(30):
        w /= w.sum()
        w = np.clip(w, floor, ceiling)
    w /= w.sum()
    return {s: float(x) for s, x in zip(UNIVERSE, w)}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        r = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v15 = max(float(np.std(r[-15:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        ret3 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-3:]) - 1)
        ret20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1)
        ret60 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-60:]) - 1)
        ret120 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-120:]) - 1)
        downside = max(float(np.std(r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0])), 0.006)
        data[s] = {
            "r": r, "v": v20,
            "failure": -(ret120 - ret60) / v60,
            "consistency": (float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)) - .5) / v30,
            "relative": ret20 / v20,
            "downside": ret20 / downside,
            "dispersion": -ret20 / v30,
            "ret3": ret3,
        }
    if len(data) < 10:
        return

    market = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))
    if market is None:
        return
    mr = market["r"][-20:]
    var = max(float(np.var(mr)), 1e-8)
    for s, x in data.items():
        ar = x["r"][-20:]
        n = min(len(ar), len(mr))
        ar, bm = ar[-n:], mr[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(ar, bm, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / var if n > 2 else 0.0
        x["beta"] = float(np.mean(ar - beta * bm) / x["v"])

    names = ["failure", "consistency", "beta", "relative", "downside", "dispersion"]
    ranks = {n: rank_cs({s: x[n] for s, x in data.items()}) for n in names}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[n][s] for w, n in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, names)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .80 * score[s] + .20 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()

    vols = [x["v"] for x in data.values()]
    medvol = float(np.median(vols))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["consistency"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    market20 = float(np.prod(1 + mr) - 1)
    stressed = medvol > .015 or market20 < -.06 or breadth < .40
    invmean = float(np.mean([1 / max(v, .006) for v in vols]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        vol = x["v"] if x else medvol
        damp = np.clip((1 / max(vol, .006)) / max(invmean, 1e-12), .70, 1.15)
        # In the current high-risk regime, defensive tradable benchmarks absorb
        # risk while every asset still receives a valid positive allocation.
        tilt = (2.35 if s in DEFENSIVE else (0.24 if s in RISKY else 0.68)) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else (0.82 if s in RISKY else 1.0))
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * damp) * tilt
    target = full_weights(raw)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.30, 0.25, 0.18, 0.14, 0.09, 0.04]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_cs(values):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    if not good:
        return out
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def full_weights(raw, floor=0.02, ceiling=0.25):
    # Positive capped allocation, normalized over exactly the tradable universe.
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    for _ in range(50):
        w /= w.sum()
        over = w > ceiling
        if not np.any(over):
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - ceiling))
        w[over] = ceiling
        under = ~over
        if np.any(under):
            w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(np.sum(w[under])), 1e-12)
    w = np.maximum(w, floor)
    w /= w.sum()
    return {s: float(x) for s, x in zip(UNIVERSE, w)}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        r = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v15 = max(float(np.std(r[-15:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        ret20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1)
        ret60 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-60:]) - 1)
        ret120 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-120:]) - 1)
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]
        downside = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) > 1 else v20, 0.006)
        data[symbol] = {
            "r": r, "v": v20,
            "failure": -(ret120 - ret60) / v60,
            "consistency": (float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)) - 0.5) / v30,
            "beta": 0.0,
            "relative": ret20 / v20,
            "downside": ret20 / downside,
            "dispersion": -ret20 / v30,
        }
    if len(data) < 10:
        return

    market = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))
    if market is None:
        return
    mr = market["r"][-20:]
    var = max(float(np.var(mr)), 1e-8)
    for x in data.values():
        ar = x["r"][-20:]
        n = min(len(ar), len(mr))
        ar, bm = ar[-n:], mr[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(ar, bm, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / var if n > 2 else 0.0
        x["beta"] = float(np.mean(ar - beta * bm) / x["v"])

    names = ["failure", "consistency", "beta", "relative", "downside", "dispersion"]
    ranks = {name: rank_cs({s: x[name] for s, x in data.items()}) for name in names}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[name][s] for w, name in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, names)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.80 * score[s] + 0.20 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()

    vols = [x["v"] for x in data.values()]
    medvol = float(np.median(vols))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["consistency"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    market20 = float(np.prod(1 + mr) - 1)
    stressed = medvol > 0.015 or market20 < -0.06 or breadth < 0.40
    invmean = float(np.mean([1 / max(v, 0.006) for v in vols]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        vol = x["v"] if x else medvol
        damp = np.clip((1 / max(vol, 0.006)) / max(invmean, 1e-12), 0.70, 1.15)
        tilt = (2.35 if s in DEFENSIVE else (0.24 if s in RISKY else 0.68)) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else (0.82 if s in RISKY else 1.0))
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * damp) * tilt
    target = full_weights(raw)
    forecast_returns = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast_returns, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.28, 0.24, 0.18, 0.14, 0.10, 0.06]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_cs(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def full_weights(raw, floor=0.02, ceiling=0.25):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    # Iterative capped simplex projection; preserves a complete, long-only target.
    for _ in range(30):
        w /= w.sum()
        w = np.clip(w, floor, ceiling)
    w /= w.sum()
    return {s: float(x) for s, x in zip(UNIVERSE, w)}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        r = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v15 = max(float(np.std(r[-15:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        ret3 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-3:]) - 1)
        ret20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1)
        ret60 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-60:]) - 1)
        ret120 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-120:]) - 1)
        downside = max(float(np.std(r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0])), 0.006)
        data[s] = {
            "r": r, "v": v20,
            "failure": -(ret120 - ret60) / v60,
            "consistency": (float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)) - .5) / v30,
            "relative": ret20 / v20,
            "downside": ret20 / downside,
            "dispersion": -ret20 / v30,
            "ret3": ret3,
        }
    if len(data) < 10:
        return

    market = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))
    if market is None:
        return
    mr = market["r"][-20:]
    var = max(float(np.var(mr)), 1e-8)
    for s, x in data.items():
        ar = x["r"][-20:]
        n = min(len(ar), len(mr))
        ar, bm = ar[-n:], mr[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(ar, bm, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / var if n > 2 else 0.0
        x["beta"] = float(np.mean(ar - beta * bm) / x["v"])

    names = ["failure", "consistency", "beta", "relative", "downside", "dispersion"]
    ranks = {n: rank_cs({s: x[n] for s, x in data.items()}) for n in names}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[n][s] for w, n in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, names)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .80 * score[s] + .20 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()

    vols = [x["v"] for x in data.values()]
    medvol = float(np.median(vols))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["consistency"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    market20 = float(np.prod(1 + mr) - 1)
    stressed = medvol > .015 or market20 < -.06 or breadth < .40
    invmean = float(np.mean([1 / max(v, .006) for v in vols]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        vol = x["v"] if x else medvol
        damp = np.clip((1 / max(vol, .006)) / max(invmean, 1e-12), .70, 1.15)
        # In the current high-risk regime, defensive tradable benchmarks absorb
        # risk while every asset still receives a valid positive allocation.
        tilt = (2.35 if s in DEFENSIVE else (0.24 if s in RISKY else 0.68)) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else (0.82 if s in RISKY else 1.0))
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * damp) * tilt
    target = full_weights(raw)
    forecast_returns = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast_returns, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
# Exact current Screener ensemble; all directions are +1.
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.28, 0.18, 0.20, 0.16, 0.12, 0.06]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_cs(values):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    if good:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
            out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def full_weights(raw, floor=0.02, ceiling=0.25):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    for _ in range(50):
        w /= w.sum()
        over = w > ceiling
        if not np.any(over):
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - ceiling))
        w[over] = ceiling
        under = ~over
        if np.any(under):
            w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(np.sum(w[under])), 1e-12)
    w = np.maximum(w, floor)
    w /= w.sum()
    return {s: float(x) for s, x in zip(UNIVERSE, w)}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        r = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v15 = max(float(np.std(r[-15:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        ret20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1)
        ret60 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-60:]) - 1)
        ret120 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-120:]) - 1)
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]
        downside = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) > 1 else v20, 0.006)
        data[symbol] = {
            "r": r, "v": v20,
            "failure": -(ret120 - ret60) / v60,
            "consistency": (float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)) - 0.5) / v30,
            "beta": 0.0,
            "relative": ret20 / v20,
            "downside": ret20 / downside,
            "dispersion": -ret20 / v30,
        }

    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    market = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))
    if market is None:
        return
    mr = market["r"][-20:]
    var = max(float(np.var(mr)), 1e-8)
    for x in data.values():
        ar = x["r"][-20:]
        n = min(len(ar), len(mr))
        ar, bm = ar[-n:], mr[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(ar, bm, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / var if n > 2 else 0.0
        x["beta"] = float(np.mean(ar - beta * bm) / x["v"])

    names = ["failure", "consistency", "beta", "relative", "downside", "dispersion"]
    ranks = {name: rank_cs({s: x[name] for s, x in data.items()}) for name in names}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[name][s] for w, name in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, names)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.80 * score[s] + 0.20 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()

    vols = [x["v"] for x in data.values()]
    medvol = float(np.median(vols))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["consistency"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    market20 = float(np.prod(1 + mr) - 1)
    stressed = medvol > 0.015 or market20 < -0.06 or breadth < 0.40
    invmean = float(np.mean([1 / max(v, 0.006) for v in vols]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        vol = x["v"] if x else medvol
        damp = np.clip((1 / max(vol, 0.006)) / max(invmean, 1e-12), 0.70, 1.15)
        # High-risk regime: stronger defensive absorption, but still 100% invested.
        tilt = (2.60 if s in DEFENSIVE else (0.18 if s in RISKY else 0.60)) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else (0.82 if s in RISKY else 1.0))
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * damp) * tilt
    target = full_weights(raw)
    forecast_returns = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast_returns, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.30, 0.22, 0.18, 0.14, 0.10, 0.06]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_cs(values):
    valid = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(valid)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw):
    # Full investment, with modest diversification and no cash sleeve.
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w = np.maximum(w, 0.02)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, [float(x) for x in w]))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    f = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        ret20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1)
        ret60 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-60:]) - 1)
        ret120 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-120:]) - 1)
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]
        down = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) > 1 else v20, 0.006)
        f[s] = {"r": r, "vol": v20,
                "failure": -(ret120 - ret60) / v60,
                "beta": 0.0, "relative": ret20 / v20,
                "downside": ret20 / down,
                "consistency": (float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)) - 0.5) / v30,
                "dispersion": -ret20 / v30}
    if len(f) < 10:
        return
    market = f.get("000300.SH", f.get("SPX"))
    mr = market["r"][-20:]
    var = max(float(np.var(mr)), 1e-8)
    for x in f.values():
        ar = x["r"][-20:]
        beta = float(np.cov(ar, mr, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / var
        x["beta"] = float(np.mean(ar - beta * mr) / x["vol"])

    names = ["failure", "beta", "relative", "downside", "consistency", "dispersion"]
    ranks = {n: rank_cs({s: x[n] for s, x in f.items()}) for n in names}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[n][s] for w, n in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, names)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()

    medvol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in f.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["consistency"] > 0 for x in f.values()]))
    stressed = medvol > 0.015 or float(np.prod(1 + mr) - 1) < -0.06 or breadth < 0.40
    invmean = float(np.mean([1.0 / max(x["vol"], 0.006) for x in f.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = f.get(s)
        vol = x["vol"] if x else medvol
        damp = np.clip((1.0 / max(vol, 0.006)) / max(invmean, 1e-12), 0.70, 1.15)
        tilt = 2.60 if s in DEFENSIVE else (0.18 if s in RISKY else 0.60) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else (0.82 if s in RISKY else 1.0))
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * damp) * tilt
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    forecast_returns = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast_returns, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.2180, 0.1604, 0.1559, 0.1483, 0.1362, 0.1307, 0.0505]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def ranks(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    n = len(good)
    if n:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good): out[s] = (i + 1.) / n
    return out


def normalize(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    # Cap concentration while retaining a complete, full-investment vector.
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > .25
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - .25).sum()); w[over] = .25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w = np.maximum(w, .02); w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=300)
        if df is None or len(df) < 150: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values('date')['close'], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006); v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)
        ret3 = float(np.prod(1+r[-3:])-1); ret5 = float(np.prod(1+r[-5:])-1)
        ret20 = float(np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1); ret30 = float(np.prod(1+r[-30:])-1)
        ret60 = float(np.prod(1+r[-60:])-1)
        peak20 = max(c[-20:]); peak60 = max(c[-60:])
        atr10 = max(float(np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(c[-11:])) / c[-11:-1])), .006)
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]; down = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg)>1 else v20, .006)
        data[s] = {'r':r, 'vol':v20, 'ret20':ret20, 'ret30':ret30,
          'volstate': -ret3 * (.65 + .70 * v20),
          'failure': ((c[-1]/peak60-1)/atr10 - (c[-1]/peak20-1)/atr10),
          'consistency': ret30 * (.5 + float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0))) / v20,
          'dispersion': -ret5 / v60,
          'relative': ret20, 'downside': ret20 / down}
    if len(data) < 10: return
    bench = data.get('000300.SH', data.get('SPX')); mr = bench['r']
    # Benchmark-residual 20-day momentum, with beta estimated from prior 60 days.
    for s, x in data.items():
        n = min(60, len(x['r']), len(mr)); ar=x['r'][-n:]; br=mr[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(ar, br, ddof=0)[0,1]) / max(float(np.var(br)),1e-8)
        x['betares'] = float(np.sum(ar[-20:] - beta * br[-20:]))
    # Cross-sectional dispersion state multiplier (same observable date for all assets).
    cs5 = np.array([x['ret20'] for x in data.values()]); disp = float(np.std(cs5))
    for x in data.values(): x['dispersion'] *= np.clip(1 + .30 * np.tanh(disp/.03), .70, 1.30)
    names=['volstate','failure','betares','consistency','dispersion','relative','downside']
    rr={n:ranks({s:x[n] for s,x in data.items()}) for n in names}
    score={s:sum(w*rr[n][s] for w,n in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS,names)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score={s:.8*score[s]+.2*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous=score.copy()
    medvol=float(np.median([x['vol'] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth=float(np.mean([x['ret30'] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed=medvol>.015 or float(np.prod(1+mr[-20:])-1)<-.06 or breadth<.40
    invmean=float(np.mean([1/max(x['vol'],.006) for x in data.values()]))
    raw={}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x=data.get(s); vol=x['vol'] if x else medvol
        damp=np.clip((1/max(vol,.006))/max(invmean,1e-12),.70,1.15)
        tilt=(2.60 if s in DEFENSIVE else .18 if s in RISKY else .60) if stressed else (1.20 if s in DEFENSIVE else .82 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s]=max(score[s],.03)*(.85+.15*damp)*tilt
    target=normalize(raw)
    forecast={s:float(np.clip((score[s]-.5)*.06,-.03,.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.2183, 0.1604, 0.1559, 0.1483, 0.1362, 0.1307, 0.0502]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def ranks(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.) / len(good)
    return out

def normalize(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > .25
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - .25).sum()); w[over] = .25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w = np.maximum(w, .02); w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=300)
        if df is None or len(df) < 150: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values('date')['close'], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006); v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)
        ret3 = float(np.prod(1+r[-3:])-1); ret5 = float(np.prod(1+r[-5:])-1)
        ret20 = float(np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1); ret30 = float(np.prod(1+r[-30:])-1)
        peak20 = max(c[-20:]); peak60 = max(c[-60:])
        atr10 = max(float(np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(c[-11:])) / c[-11:-1])), .006)
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]; down = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg)>1 else v20, .006)
        data[s] = {'r':r, 'vol':v20, 'ret20':ret20, 'ret30':ret30,
          'volstate': -ret3 * (.65 + .70 * v20),
          'failure': ((c[-1]/peak60-1)/atr10 - (c[-1]/peak20-1)/atr10),
          'consistency': ret30 * (.5 + float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0))) / v20,
          'dispersion': -ret5 / v60, 'relative': ret20, 'downside': ret20 / down}
    if len(data) < 10: return
    bench = data.get('000300.SH', data.get('SPX')); mr = bench['r']
    for s, x in data.items():
        n = min(60, len(x['r']), len(mr)); ar=x['r'][-n:]; br=mr[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(ar, br, ddof=0)[0,1]) / max(float(np.var(br)),1e-8)
        x['betares'] = float(np.sum(ar[-20:] - beta * br[-20:]))
    disp = float(np.std(np.array([x['ret20'] for x in data.values()])))
    for x in data.values(): x['dispersion'] *= np.clip(1 + .30 * np.tanh(disp/.03), .70, 1.30)
    names=['volstate','failure','betares','consistency','dispersion','relative','downside']
    rr={n:ranks({s:x[n] for s,x in data.items()}) for n in names}
    score={s:sum(w*rr[n][s] for w,n in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS,names)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score={s:.8*score[s]+.2*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous=score.copy()
    medvol=float(np.median([x['vol'] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth=float(np.mean([x['ret30'] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed=medvol>.015 or float(np.prod(1+mr[-20:])-1)<-.06 or breadth<.40
    invmean=float(np.mean([1/max(x['vol'],.006) for x in data.values()]))
    raw={}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x=data.get(s); vol=x['vol'] if x else medvol
        damp=np.clip((1/max(vol,.006))/max(invmean,1e-12),.70,1.15)
        tilt=(2.60 if s in DEFENSIVE else .18 if s in RISKY else .60) if stressed else (1.20 if s in DEFENSIVE else .82 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s]=max(score[s],.03)*(.85+.15*damp)*tilt
    target=normalize(raw)
    forecast={s:float(np.clip((score[s]-.5)*.06,-.03,.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def ranks(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    n = len(good)
    if n:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good): out[s] = (i + 1.) / n

def normalize(raw):

    w /= w.sum()
    # Cap concentration while retaining a complete, full-investment vector.
    for _ in range(20):

        excess = float((w[over] - .25).sum()); w[over] = .25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w = np.maximum(w, .02); w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():

    for s in UNIVERSE:

        peak20 = max(c[-20:]); peak60 = max(c[-60:])
        atr10 = max(float(np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(c[-11:])) / c[-11:-1])), .006)
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]; down = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg)>1 else v20, .006)
        data[s] = {'r':r, 'vol':v20, 'ret20':ret20, 'ret30':ret30,

          'failure': ((c[-1]/peak60-1)/atr10 - (c[-1]/peak20-1)/atr10),
          'consistency': ret30 * (.5 + float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0))) / v20,
          'dispersion': -ret5 / v60,
          'relative': ret20, 'downside': ret20 / down}
    if len(data) < 10: return
    bench = data.get('000300.SH', data.get('SPX')); mr = bench['r']
    # Benchmark-residual 20-day momentum, with beta estimated from prior 60 days.
    for s, x in data.items():
        n = min(60, len(x['r']), len(mr)); ar=x['r'][-n:]; br=mr[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(ar, br, ddof=0)[0,1]) / max(float(np.var(br)),1e-8)
        x['betares'] = float(np.sum(ar[-20:] - beta * br[-20:]))
    # Cross-sectional dispersion state multiplier (same observable date for all assets).
    cs5 = np.array([x['ret20'] for x in data.values()]); disp = float(np.std(cs5))
    for x in data.values(): x['dispersion'] *= np.clip(1 + .30 * np.tanh(disp/.03), .70, 1.30)
    names=['volstate','failure','betares','consistency','dispersion','relative','downside']
    rr={n:ranks({s:x[n] for s,x in data.items()}) for n in names}
    score={s:sum(w*rr[n][s] for w,n in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS,names)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score={s:.8*score[s]+.2*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous=score.copy()
    medvol=float(np.median([x['vol'] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth=float(np.mean([x['ret30'] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed=medvol>.015 or float(np.prod(1+mr[-20:])-1)<-.06 or breadth<.40
    invmean=float(np.mean([1/max(x['vol'],.006) for x in data.values()]))
    raw={}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x=data.get(s); vol=x['vol'] if x else medvol
        damp=np.clip((1/max(vol,.006))/max(invmean,1e-12),.70,1.15)
        tilt=(2.60 if s in DEFENSIVE else .18 if s in RISKY else .60) if stressed else (1.20 if s in DEFENSIVE else .82 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s]=max(score[s],.03)*(.85+.15*damp)*tilt
    target=normalize(raw)
    forecast={s:float(np.clip((score[s]-.5)*.06,-.03,.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.24, 0.18, 0.18, 0.16, 0.12, 0.08, 0.04]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def ranks(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    if not good:
        return out
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out

def normalize(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w = np.maximum(w, 0.02)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=300)
        if df is None or len(df) < 150:
            continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        ret3 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-3:]) - 1)
        ret5 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-5:]) - 1)
        ret20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1)
        ret30 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1)
        peak20, peak60 = max(c[-20:]), max(c[-60:])
        atr10 = max(float(np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(c[-11:])) / c[-11:-1])), 0.006)
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]
        down = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) > 1 else v20, 0.006)
        data[s] = {"r": r, "vol": v20, "ret20": ret20, "ret30": ret30,
                   "volstate": -ret3 * (0.65 + 0.70 * v20),
                   "failure": ((c[-1] / peak60 - 1) - (c[-1] / peak20 - 1)) / atr10,
                   "consistency": ret30 * (0.5 + float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0))) / v20,
                   "dispersion": -ret5 / v60, "relative": ret20,
                   "downside": ret20 / down}
    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    bench = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))
    mr = bench["r"]
    for x in data.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["r"]), len(mr))
        ar, br = x["r"][-n:], mr[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(ar, br, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(br)), 1e-8)
        x["betares"] = float(np.sum(ar[-20:] - beta * br[-20:]))
    disp = float(np.std([x["ret20"] for x in data.values()]))
    for x in data.values():
        x["dispersion"] *= np.clip(1 + 0.30 * np.tanh(disp / 0.03), 0.70, 1.30)
    names = ["volstate", "failure", "consistency", "dispersion", "betares", "relative", "downside"]
    rr = {n: ranks({s: x[n] for s, x in data.items()}) for n in names}
    score = {s: sum(w * rr[n][s] for w, n in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, names)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.2183, 0.1604, 0.1559, 0.1483, 0.1362, 0.1307, 0.0502]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def ranks(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.) / len(good)
    return out

def normalize(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > .25
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - .25).sum()); w[over] = .25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w = np.maximum(w, .02); w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=300)
        if df is None or len(df) < 150: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values('date')['close'], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006); v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)
        ret3 = float(np.prod(1+r[-3:])-1); ret5 = float(np.prod(1+r[-5:])-1)
        ret20 = float(np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1); ret30 = float(np.prod(1+r[-30:])-1)
        peak20 = max(c[-20:]); peak60 = max(c[-60:])
        atr10 = max(float(np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(c[-11:])) / c[-11:-1])), .006)
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]; down = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg)>1 else v20, .006)
        data[s] = {'r':r, 'vol':v20, 'ret20':ret20, 'ret30':ret30,
          'volstate': -ret3 * (.65 + .70 * v20),
          'failure': ((c[-1]/peak60-1)/atr10 - (c[-1]/peak20-1)/atr10),
          'consistency': ret30 * (.5 + float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0))) / v20,
          'dispersion': -ret5 / v60, 'relative': ret20, 'downside': ret20 / down}
    if len(data) < 10: return
    bench = data.get('000300.SH', data.get('SPX')); mr = bench['r']
    for s, x in data.items():
        n = min(60, len(x['r']), len(mr)); ar=x['r'][-n:]; br=mr[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(ar, br, ddof=0)[0,1]) / max(float(np.var(br)),1e-8)
        x['betares'] = float(np.sum(ar[-20:] - beta * br[-20:]))
    disp = float(np.std(np.array([x['ret20'] for x in data.values()])))
    for x in data.values(): x['dispersion'] *= np.clip(1 + .30 * np.tanh(disp/.03), .70, 1.30)
    names=['volstate','failure','betares','consistency','dispersion','relative','downside']
    rr={n:ranks({s:x[n] for s,x in data.items()}) for n in names}
    score={s:sum(w*rr[n][s] for w,n in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS,names)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score={s:.8*score[s]+.2*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous=score.copy()
    medvol=float(np.median([x['vol'] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth=float(np.mean([x['ret30'] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed=medvol>.015 or float(np.prod(1+mr[-20:])-1)<-.06 or breadth<.40
    invmean=float(np.mean([1/max(x['vol'],.006) for x in data.values()]))
    raw={}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x=data.get(s); vol=x['vol'] if x else medvol
        damp=np.clip((1/max(vol,.006))/max(invmean,1e-12),.70,1.15)
        tilt=(2.60 if s in DEFENSIVE else .18 if s in RISKY else .60) if stressed else (1.20 if s in DEFENSIVE else .82 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s]=max(score[s],.03)*(.85+.15*damp)*tilt
    target=normalize(raw)
    forecast={s:float(np.clip((score[s]-.5)*.06,-.03,.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.26, 0.22, 0.17, 0.14, 0.10, 0.07, 0.04]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def rank(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out

def cap_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w = np.maximum(w, 0.02)
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, (w / w.sum()).tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return
    d = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=300)
        if df is None or len(df) < 150: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006); v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        ret3 = float(np.prod(1+r[-3:])-1); ret5 = float(np.prod(1+r[-5:])-1)
        ret20 = float(np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1); ret30 = float(np.prod(1+r[-30:])-1)
        peak20, peak60 = max(c[-20:]), max(c[-60:])
        atr = max(float(np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(c[-11:]))/c[-11:-1])), 0.006)
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]; down = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg)>1 else v20, 0.006)
        d[s] = {"r":r, "vol":v20, "ret20":ret20, "ret30":ret30,
          "volstate":-ret3*(0.65+0.70*v20), "failure":((c[-1]/peak60-1)-(c[-1]/peak20-1))/atr,
          "dispersion":-ret5/v60, "consistency":ret30*(0.5+float(np.mean(r[-30:]>0)))/v20,
          "relative":ret20, "downside":ret20/down}
    if len(d) < 10: return
    bench = d.get("000300.SH", d.get("SPX")); br = bench["r"]
    for x in d.values():
        n=min(60,len(x["r"]),len(br)); ar=x["r"][-n:]; b=br[-n:]
        beta=float(np.cov(ar,b,ddof=0)[0,1])/max(float(np.var(b)),1e-8)
        x["betares"] = float(np.sum(ar[-20:]-beta*b[-20:]))
    disp=float(np.std([x["ret20"] for x in d.values()]))
    for x in d.values(): x["dispersion"] *= np.clip(1+0.30*np.tanh(disp/0.03),0.70,1.30)
    names=["volstate","failure","dispersion","consistency","betares","relative","downside"]
    rr={n:rank({s:x[n] for s,x in d.items()}) for n in names}
    score={s:sum(w*rr[n][s] for w,n in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS,names)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score={s:0.8*score[s]+0.2*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous=score.copy()
    med=float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in d.values()])); breadth=float(np.mean([x["ret30"]>0 for x in d.values()]))
    stressed=med>0.015 or float(np.prod(1+br[-20:])-1)<-0.06 or breadth<0.40
    inv=float(np.mean([1/max(x["vol"],0.006) for x in d.values()])); raw={}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x=d.get(s); vol=x["vol"] if x else med
        damp=np.clip((1/max(vol,0.006))/max(inv,1e-12),0.70,1.15)
        tilt=(2.60 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.18 if s in RISKY else 0.60) if stressed else (1.20 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.82 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s]=max(score[s],0.03)*(0.85+0.15*damp)*tilt
    target=cap_weights(raw)
    forecast={s:float(np.clip((score[s]-0.5)*0.06,-0.03,0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.24, 0.18, 0.18, 0.16, 0.12, 0.08, 0.04]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def ranks(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    if not good:
        return out
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out

def normalize(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w = np.maximum(w, 0.02)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=300)
        if df is None or len(df) < 150:
            continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        ret3 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-3:]) - 1)
        ret5 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-5:]) - 1)
        ret20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1)
        ret30 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1)
        peak20, peak60 = max(c[-20:]), max(c[-60:])
        atr10 = max(float(np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(c[-11:])) / c[-11:-1])), 0.006)
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]
        down = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) > 1 else v20, 0.006)
        data[s] = {"r": r, "vol": v20, "ret20": ret20, "ret30": ret30,
                   "volstate": -ret3 * (0.65 + 0.70 * v20),
                   "failure": ((c[-1] / peak60 - 1) - (c[-1] / peak20 - 1)) / atr10,
                   "consistency": ret30 * (0.5 + float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0))) / v20,
                   "dispersion": -ret5 / v60, "relative": ret20,
                   "downside": ret20 / down}
    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    bench = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))
    mr = bench["r"]
    for x in data.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["r"]), len(mr))
        ar, br = x["r"][-n:], mr[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(ar, br, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(br)), 1e-8)
        x["betares"] = float(np.sum(ar[-20:] - beta * br[-20:]))
    disp = float(np.std([x["ret20"] for x in data.values()]))
    for x in data.values():
        x["dispersion"] *= np.clip(1 + 0.30 * np.tanh(disp / 0.03), 0.70, 1.30)
    names = ["volstate", "failure", "consistency", "dispersion", "betares", "relative", "downside"]
    rr = {n: ranks({s: x[n] for s, x in data.items()}) for n in names}
    score = {s: sum(w * rr[n][s] for w, n in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, names)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()
    medvol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["ret30"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = medvol > 0.015 or float(np.prod(1 + mr[-20:]) - 1) < -0.06 or breadth < 0.40
    invmean = float(np.mean([1 / max(x["vol"], 0.006) for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        vol = x["vol"] if x else medvol
        damp = np.clip((1 / max(vol, 0.006)) / max(invmean, 1e-12), 0.70, 1.15)
        tilt = (2.60 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.18 if s in RISKY else 0.60) if stressed else (1.20 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.82 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * damp) * tilt
    target = normalize(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
# Exact synchronized screener ensemble: IDs, order, weights and directions.
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.30, 0.20, 0.16, 0.14, 0.10, 0.06, 0.04]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def rank(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out

def cap_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)

        beta=float(np.cov(ar,b,ddof=0)[0,1])/max(float(np.var(b)),1e-8)
        x["betares"] = float(np.sum(ar[-20:]-beta*b[-20:]))

    for x in d.values(): x["dispersion"] *= np.clip(1+0.30*np.tanh(disp/0.03),0.70,1.30)

    names=["failure","volstate","dispersion","consistency","relative","betares","downside"]
    rr={n:rank({s:x[n] for s,x in d.items()}) for n in names}
    score={s:sum(w*rr[n] for w,n in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS,names)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score={s:0.8*score[s]+0.2*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous=score.copy()
    med=float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in d.values()])); breadth=float(np.mean([x["ret30"]>0 for x in d.values()]))
    stressed=med>0.015 or float(np.prod(1+br[-20:])-1)<-0.06 or breadth<0.40

    for s in UNIVERSE:

    forecast={s:float(np.clip((score[s]-0.5)*0.06,-0.03,0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)
