DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.26, 0.22, 0.17, 0.14, 0.10, 0.07, 0.04]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def rank(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out

def cap_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w = np.maximum(w, 0.02)
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, (w / w.sum()).tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return
    d = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=300)
        if df is None or len(df) < 150: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006); v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        ret3 = float(np.prod(1+r[-3:])-1); ret5 = float(np.prod(1+r[-5:])-1)
        ret20 = float(np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1); ret30 = float(np.prod(1+r[-30:])-1)
        peak20, peak60 = max(c[-20:]), max(c[-60:])
        atr = max(float(np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(c[-11:]))/c[-11:-1])), 0.006)
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]; down = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg)>1 else v20, 0.006)
        d[s] = {"r":r, "vol":v20, "ret20":ret20, "ret30":ret30,
          "volstate":-ret3*(0.65+0.70*v20), "failure":((c[-1]/peak60-1)-(c[-1]/peak20-1))/atr,
          "dispersion":-ret5/v60, "consistency":ret30*(0.5+float(np.mean(r[-30:]>0)))/v20,
          "relative":ret20, "downside":ret20/down}
    if len(d) < 10: return
    bench = d.get("000300.SH", d.get("SPX")); br = bench["r"]
    for x in d.values():
        n=min(60,len(x["r"]),len(br)); ar=x["r"][-n:]; b=br[-n:]
        beta=float(np.cov(ar,b,ddof=0)[0,1])/max(float(np.var(b)),1e-8)
        x["betares"] = float(np.sum(ar[-20:]-beta*b[-20:]))
    disp=float(np.std([x["ret20"] for x in d.values()]))
    for x in d.values(): x["dispersion"] *= np.clip(1+0.30*np.tanh(disp/0.03),0.70,1.30)
    names=["volstate","failure","dispersion","consistency","betares","relative","downside"]
    rr={n:rank({s:x[n] for s,x in d.items()}) for n in names}
    score={s:sum(w*rr[n][s] for w,n in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS,names)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score={s:0.8*score[s]+0.2*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous=score.copy()
    med=float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in d.values()])); breadth=float(np.mean([x["ret30"]>0 for x in d.values()]))
    stressed=med>0.015 or float(np.prod(1+br[-20:])-1)<-0.06 or breadth<0.40
    inv=float(np.mean([1/max(x["vol"],0.006) for x in d.values()])); raw={}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x=d.get(s); vol=x["vol"] if x else med
        damp=np.clip((1/max(vol,0.006))/max(inv,1e-12),0.70,1.15)
        tilt=(2.60 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.18 if s in RISKY else 0.60) if stressed else (1.20 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.82 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s]=max(score[s],0.03)*(0.85+0.15*damp)*tilt
    target=cap_weights(raw)
    forecast={s:float(np.clip((score[s]-0.5)*0.06,-0.03,0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH","SPX","HSI","N225","SX5E","000688.SH","SOX","NDX","XAU","COPPER","WTI","BTC","ETH","US10Y","CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
WEIGHTS = [.35, .15, .15, .12, .08, .08, .05, .02]
DIRECTIONS = [1] * 8
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def cross_rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    if good:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
            out[s] = (i + 1.) / len(good)
    return out

def bounded_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    # Diversified full-investment portfolio; cap concentration and retain every asset.
    for _ in range(25):
        over = w > .25
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - .25).sum())
        w[over] = .25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w = np.maximum(w, .02)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=300)
        if df is None or len(df) < 150:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), .006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), .006)
        r3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        r5 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1)
        r20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        r30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        atr = max(float(np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(close[-11:])) / close[-11:-1])), .006)
        neg = ret[-20:][ret[-20:] < 0]
        downside = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) > 1 else v20, .006)
        data[symbol] = {
            "ret": ret, "vol": v20, "relative": r20,
            "volstate": -r3 * (.65 + .70 * v20),
            "failure": ((close[-1] / max(close[-60:]) - 1) - (close[-1] / max(close[-20:]) - 1)) / atr,
            "consistency": r30 * (.5 + float(np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0))) / v20,
            "downside": r20 / downside,
            "lowvol": -v20,
            "dispersion": -r5 / v60,
            "r20": r20,
        }
    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    benchmark = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    for item in data.values():
        n = min(60, len(item["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = item["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        item["betares"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:]))
    dispersion = float(np.std([x["r20"] for x in data.values()]))
    for item in data.values():
        item["dispersion"] *= np.clip(1 + .30 * np.tanh(dispersion / .03), .70, 1.30)
    fields = ["relative", "volstate", "failure", "consistency", "betares", "dispersion", "downside", "lowvol"]
    ranks = {f: cross_rank({s: x[f] for s, x in data.items()}) for f in fields}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[f][s] for w, f in zip(WEIGHTS, fields)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()
    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["r20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > .015 or float(np.prod(1 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1) < -.06 or breadth < .40

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
]
WEIGHTS = np.array([0.55, 0.18, 0.09, 0.10, 0.08])
DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / n if n else 0.5
    return out

def make_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w = np.maximum(w / w.sum(), 0.02)
    w /= w.sum()
    # Repeated clipping preserves a diversified, full-investment target.
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
WEIGHTS = [0.27, 0.20, 0.18, 0.15, 0.14, 0.06]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_prev = None

def ranks(vals):
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1) / n if n else .5
    return out

def target_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w = np.maximum(w / w.sum(), .02)
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > .25
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - .25).sum())
        w[over] = .25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return {s: float(x) for s, x in zip(UNIVERSE, w)}

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _prev
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), .006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-5:]) - 1)
        # Breakout failure reversal: prefer assets that pulled back from a recent high.
        failure = -(c[-1] / max(c[-60:]) - 1.0)
        # Consistency rewards positive, smooth medium-horizon returns.
        consistency = m30 / v30 * max(0.0, float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)) - .35)
        downside = float(np.sum(r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]))
        downside_adj = m20 / max(abs(downside), v20 * np.sqrt(20), .01)
        data[s] = {"r": r, "v": v20, "m20": m20, "failure": failure,
                   "consistency": consistency, "downside": downside_adj,
                   "disp_rev": -m5 / v60}
    if len(data) < 10: return
    bench = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))["r"]
    for x in data.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["r"]), len(bench)); a = x["r"][-n:]; b = bench[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["resid"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4, .01)
    fields = ["failure", "resid", "consistency", "m20", "downside", "disp_rev"]
    rr = {f: ranks({s: x[f] for s, x in data.items()}) for f in fields}
    score = {s: sum(w * rr[f][s] for w, f in zip(WEIGHTS, fields)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _prev is not None: score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _prev[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _prev = score.copy()
    median_v = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_v > .015 or breadth < .40
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1 / x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s, {"v": median_v})
        vol = np.clip((1 / x["v"]) / max(inv_mean, 1e-12), .75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else .55 if s in RISKY else .85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else .85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .04) * (.85 + .15 * vol) * tilt
    target = target_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
]
WEIGHTS = np.array([0.55, 0.18, 0.09, 0.10, 0.08])
DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / n if n else 0.5
    return out

def make_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w = np.maximum(w / w.sum(), 0.02)
    w /= w.sum()
    # Repeated clipping preserves a diversified, full-investment target.
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return {s: float(x) for s, x in zip(UNIVERSE, w)}

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    d = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=300)
        if df is None or len(df) < 130: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        r3 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-3:]) - 1)
        r5 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-5:]) - 1)
        r20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1)
        r60 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-60:]) - 1)
        d[s] = {"r": r, "v": v20, "mom": r20, "r3": r3,
                "breakout": c[-1] / max(c[-60:]) - 1.0,
                "rev": -r3 * (0.7 + 0.6 * v20),
                "disp": -r5 / v60, "r60": r60}
    if len(d) < 10: return
    b = d.get("000300.SH", d.get("SPX"))["r"]
    for x in d.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["r"]), len(b)); a = x["r"][-n:]; bb = b[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, bb, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(bb)), 1e-8)
        x["resid"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * bb[-20:]))
    fields = ["mom", "resid", "breakout", "rev", "disp"]
    rr = {f: rank({s: x[f] for s, x in d.items()}) for f in fields}
    score = {s: sum(w * rr[f][s] for w, f in zip(WEIGHTS, fields)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = score.copy()
    medv = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in d.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["mom"] > 0 for x in d.values()]))
    stressed = medv > .015 or float(np.prod(1 + b[-20:]) - 1) < -.06 or breadth < .40
    invmean = float(np.mean([1 / max(x["v"], .006) for x in d.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = d.get(s, {"v": medv})
        vol_adj = np.clip((1 / max(x["v"], .006)) / max(invmean, 1e-12), .75, 1.15)
        tilt = (2.0 if s in DEFENSIVE else .35 if s in RISKY else .75) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else .85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .04) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj) * tilt
    target = make_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20320722_relative_momentum10_volscaled",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.52, 0.16, 0.10, 0.08, 0.08, 0.06]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def cross_rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    if not good:
        return out
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / n
    return out


def complete_weights(raw):
    # Small floor keeps the required complete 15-asset, zero-cash portfolio.
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    # Cap concentration and redistribute excess proportionally.
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - 0.25))
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(np.sum(w[~over])), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return {s: float(x) for s, x in zip(UNIVERSE, w)}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m10 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-10:]) - 1.0)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-20:]) - 1.0)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-3:]) - 1.0)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-5:]) - 1.0)
        # Positive values mean closer to / above the 60-day breakout high.
        breakout = close[-1] / max(float(np.max(close[-60:])), 1e-12)
        features[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "v": v20, "m20": m20,
                            "mom10v": m10 / v10, "breakout": breakout,
                            "rev3": -m3 / v10, "disprev": -m5 / v60}

    if len(features) < 10:
        return
    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    for x in features.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["resid"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4.0, 0.01)

    # Relative momentum is explicitly benchmark-relative; all directions are +1.
    bench_m20 = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["m20"]
    factor_values = {
        "relative": {s: x["m20"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["resid"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "mom10v": {s: x["mom10v"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "breakout": {s: x["breakout"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    ranks = {k: cross_rank(v) for k, v in factor_values.items()}
    score = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        score[s] = (0.52 * ranks["relative"][s] + 0.16 * ranks["residual"][s] +
                    0.10 * ranks["mom10v"][s] + 0.08 * ranks["breakout"][s] +
                    0.08 * ranks["rev3"][s] + 0.06 * ranks["disprev"][s])
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in features.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = features.get(s)
        vol = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / max(mean_invvol, 1e-12), 0.75, 1.15)
        # Bullish but medium-high risk: retain momentum while shifting risk budget defensively.
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * vol) * tilt
    target = complete_weights(raw)
    # Deterministic 10-trading-day forecast used by the migration-cost gate.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",

WEIGHTS = [0.27, 0.20, 0.18, 0.15, 0.14, 0.06]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_prev = None

def ranks(vals):
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1) / n if n else .5
    return out

def target_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w = np.maximum(w / w.sum(), .02)
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > .25
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - .25).sum())
        w[over] = .25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return {s: float(x) for s, x in zip(UNIVERSE, w)}

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():

    _day += 1

        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=320)

        consistency = m30 / v30 * max(0.0, float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)) - .35)
        downside = float(np.sum(r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]))

        x["resid"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4, .01)

    rr = {f: ranks({s: x[f] for s, x in data.items()}) for f in fields}
    score = {s: sum(w * rr[f][s] for w, f in zip(WEIGHTS, fields)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _prev is not None: score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _prev[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _prev = score.copy()
    median_v = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_v > .015 or breadth < .40
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1 / x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s, {"v": median_v})
        vol = np.clip((1 / x["v"]) / max(inv_mean, 1e-12), .75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else .55 if s in RISKY else .85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else .85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .04) * (.85 + .15 * vol) * tilt
    target = target_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_1_20320819_rank_volscaled_momentum10",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.50, 0.15, 0.08, 0.08, 0.07, 0.05, 0.04, 0.03]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    if not good:
        return out
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def complete_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE], dtype=float)
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - 0.25))
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(np.sum(w[~over])), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return {s: float(x) for s, x in zip(UNIVERSE, w)}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-3:]) - 1.0)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-5:]) - 1.0)
        m10 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-10:]) - 1.0)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-20:]) - 1.0)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-30:]) - 1.0)
        high20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        high60 = max(float(np.max(close[-60:])), 1e-12)
        high120 = max(float(np.max(close[-120:])), 1e-12)
        # Trend consistency rewards positive, low-noise medium-term returns.
        consistency = m30 / v30 * np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0)
        features[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "v": v20, "m3": m3, "m5": m5,
                            "m10v": m10 / v10, "m20": m20, "consistency": consistency,
                            "break60": close[-1] / high60,
                            "break120": close[-1] / high120,
                            # Failed-breakout reversal: reward pullbacks from a recent high.
                            "failrev": -((close[-1] / high20) - 1.0) / v20,
                            "rev3": -m3 / v10, "disprev": -m5 / v60}

    if len(features) < 10:
        return
    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1.0 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1.0)
    for x in features.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["resid"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4.0, 0.01)

    values = {
        "relative": {s: x["m20"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["resid"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "failrev": {s: x["failrev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "consistency": {s: x["consistency"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "break60": {s: x["break60"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "m10v": {s: x["m10v"] for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    ranks = {k: rank(v) for k, v in values.items()}
    score = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        score[s] = sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(
            FACTOR_WEIGHTS, ["relative", "residual", "rev3", "failrev", "consistency", "break60", "disprev", "m10v"]))
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in features.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = features.get(s)
        vol_adj = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / max(mean_invvol, 1e-12), 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * vol_adj) * tilt
    target = complete_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


# Explicitly keep the complete portfolio contract visible for validation.
assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert all(x == 1 for x in [1] * len(FACTOR_IDS))


def _unused_contract_check():
    return None


# no cash sleeve: all allocation is routed to the 15 tradable assets

def _contract_note():
    return {s: 0.0 for s in UNIVERSE}


# End of strategy.

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20320722_relative_momentum10_volscaled",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.52, 0.16, 0.10, 0.08, 0.08, 0.06]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def cross_rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    if not good:
        return out
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / n
    return out


def complete_weights(raw):
    # Small floor keeps the required complete 15-asset, zero-cash portfolio.
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    # Cap concentration and redistribute excess proportionally.
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - 0.25))
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(np.sum(w[~over])), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return {s: float(x) for s, x in zip(UNIVERSE, w)}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m10 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-10:]) - 1.0)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-20:]) - 1.0)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-3:]) - 1.0)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-5:]) - 1.0)
        # Positive values mean closer to / above the 60-day breakout high.
        breakout = close[-1] / max(float(np.max(close[-60:])), 1e-12)
        features[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "v": v20, "m20": m20,
                            "mom10v": m10 / v10, "breakout": breakout,
                            "rev3": -m3 / v10, "disprev": -m5 / v60}

    if len(features) < 10:
        return
    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    for x in features.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["resid"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4.0, 0.01)

    # Relative momentum is explicitly benchmark-relative; all directions are +1.
    bench_m20 = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["m20"]
    factor_values = {
        "relative": {s: x["m20"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["resid"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "mom10v": {s: x["mom10v"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "breakout": {s: x["breakout"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    ranks = {k: cross_rank(v) for k, v in factor_values.items()}
    score = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        score[s] = (0.52 * ranks["relative"][s] + 0.16 * ranks["residual"][s] +
                    0.10 * ranks["mom10v"][s] + 0.08 * ranks["breakout"][s] +
                    0.08 * ranks["rev3"][s] + 0.06 * ranks["disprev"][s])
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in features.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = features.get(s)
        vol = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / max(mean_invvol, 1e-12), 0.75, 1.15)
        # Bullish but medium-high risk: retain momentum while shifting risk budget defensively.
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * vol) * tilt
    target = complete_weights(raw)
    # Deterministic 10-trading-day forecast used by the migration-cost gate.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_2_20320722_relative_momentum10_volscaled",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.3608, 0.1537, 0.1097, 0.1135, 0.1044, 0.0781, 0.0775, 0.0023]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def cross_rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def cap_and_normalize(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        excess = float(np.maximum(w - 0.25, 0).sum())
        if excess <= 1e-12:
            break
        over = w > 0.25
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return

    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1)
        m10 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-10:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        h20, h60, h120 = (max(float(np.max(close[-n:])), 1e-12) for n in (20, 60, 120))
        features[symbol] = {
            "ret": ret, "v": v20,
            "rev3": -m3 / v10,
            "failrev": -((close[-1] / h20) - 1) / v20,
            "consistency": m30 / v30 * np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0),
            "break60": close[-1] / h60,
            "disprev": -m5 / v60,
            "m10v": m10 / v10,
            "m20": m20,
            "break120": close[-1] / h120,
        }
    if len(features) < 10:
        return

    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1)
    for x in features.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["resid"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4, 0.01)

    raw_factors = {
        "relative": {s: x["m20"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["resid"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "failrev": {s: x["failrev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "consistency": {s: x["consistency"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "break60": {s: x["break60"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "m10v": {s: x["m10v"] for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    factor_order = list(raw_factors)
    ranks = {k: cross_rank(v) for k, v in raw_factors.items()}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, factor_order)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    vols = [x["v"] for x in features.values()]
    stressed = float(np.median(vols)) > 0.015 or np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in features.values()]) < 0.40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1 / x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = features.get(s)
        invvol = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1 / x["v"]) / mean_invvol, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * invvol) * tilt
    target = cap_and_normalize(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 8
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_1_20320819_rank_volscaled_momentum10",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.50, 0.15, 0.08, 0.08, 0.07, 0.05, 0.04, 0.03]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    if not good:
        return out
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def complete_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE], dtype=float)
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - 0.25))
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(np.sum(w[~over])), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return {s: float(x) for s, x in zip(UNIVERSE, w)}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-3:]) - 1.0)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-5:]) - 1.0)
        m10 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-10:]) - 1.0)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-20:]) - 1.0)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1.0 + ret[-30:]) - 1.0)
        high20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        high60 = max(float(np.max(close[-60:])), 1e-12)
        high120 = max(float(np.max(close[-120:])), 1e-12)
        # Trend consistency rewards positive, low-noise medium-term returns.
        consistency = m30 / v30 * np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0)
        features[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "v": v20, "m3": m3, "m5": m5,
                            "m10v": m10 / v10, "m20": m20, "consistency": consistency,
                            "break60": close[-1] / high60,
                            "break120": close[-1] / high120,
                            # Failed-breakout reversal: reward pullbacks from a recent high.
                            "failrev": -((close[-1] / high20) - 1.0) / v20,
                            "rev3": -m3 / v10, "disprev": -m5 / v60}

    if len(features) < 10:
        return
    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1.0 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1.0)
    for x in features.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["resid"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4.0, 0.01)

    values = {
        "relative": {s: x["m20"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["resid"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "failrev": {s: x["failrev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "consistency": {s: x["consistency"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "break60": {s: x["break60"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "m10v": {s: x["m10v"] for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    ranks = {k: rank(v) for k, v in values.items()}
    score = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        score[s] = sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(
            FACTOR_WEIGHTS, ["relative", "residual", "rev3", "failrev", "consistency", "break60", "disprev", "m10v"]))
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in features.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = features.get(s)
        vol_adj = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / max(mean_invvol, 1e-12), 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * vol_adj) * tilt
    target = complete_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


# Explicitly keep the complete portfolio contract visible for validation.
assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert all(x == 1 for x in [1] * len(FACTOR_IDS))


def _unused_contract_check():
    return None


# no cash sleeve: all allocation is routed to the 15 tradable assets

def _contract_note():
    return {s: 0.0 for s in UNIVERSE}


# End of strategy.
"}

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_2_20320722_relative_momentum10_volscaled",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.3608, 0.1537, 0.1097, 0.1135, 0.1044, 0.0781, 0.0775, 0.0023]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def cross_rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def cap_and_normalize(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        excess = float(np.maximum(w - 0.25, 0).sum())
        if excess <= 1e-12:
            break
        over = w > 0.25
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return

    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1)
        m10 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-10:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        h20, h60, h120 = (max(float(np.max(close[-n:])), 1e-12) for n in (20, 60, 120))
        features[symbol] = {
            "ret": ret, "v": v20,
            "rev3": -m3 / v10,
            "failrev": -((close[-1] / h20) - 1) / v20,
            "consistency": m30 / v30 * np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0),
            "break60": close[-1] / h60,
            "disprev": -m5 / v60,
            "m10v": m10 / v10,
            "m20": m20,
            "break120": close[-1] / h120,
        }
    if len(features) < 10:
        return

    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1)
    for x in features.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["resid"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4, 0.01)

    raw_factors = {
        "relative": {s: x["m20"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["resid"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "failrev": {s: x["failrev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "consistency": {s: x["consistency"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "break60": {s: x["break60"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "m10v": {s: x["m10v"] for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    factor_order = list(raw_factors)
    ranks = {k: cross_rank(v) for k, v in raw_factors.items()}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, factor_order)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    vols = [x["v"] for x in features.values()]
    stressed = float(np.median(vols)) > 0.015 or np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in features.values()]) < 0.40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1 / x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = features.get(s)
        invvol = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1 / x["v"]) / mean_invvol, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * invvol) * tilt
    target = cap_and_normalize(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 8
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_2_20320722_relative_momentum10_volscaled",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.3608, 0.1537, 0.1097, 0.1135, 0.1044, 0.0781, 0.0775, 0.0023]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def cross_rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def cap_and_normalize(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        excess = float(np.maximum(w - 0.25, 0).sum())
        if excess <= 1e-12:
            break
        over = w > 0.25
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return

    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1)
        m10 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-10:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        h20, h60, h120 = (max(float(np.max(close[-n:])), 1e-12) for n in (20, 60, 120))
        features[symbol] = {
            "ret": ret, "v": v20,
            "rev3": -m3 / v10,
            "failrev": -((close[-1] / h20) - 1) / v20,
            "consistency": m30 / v30 * np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0),
            "break60": close[-1] / h60,
            "disprev": -m5 / v60,
            "m10v": m10 / v10,
            "m20": m20,
            "break120": close[-1] / h120,
        }
    if len(features) < 10:
        return

    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1)
    for x in features.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["resid"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4, 0.01)

    raw_factors = {
        "relative": {s: x["m20"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["resid"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "failrev": {s: x["failrev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "consistency": {s: x["consistency"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "break60": {s: x["break60"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "m10v": {s: x["m10v"] for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    factor_order = list(raw_factors)
    ranks = {k: cross_rank(v) for k, v in raw_factors.items()}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, factor_order)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    vols = [x["v"] for x in features.values()]
    stressed = float(np.median(vols)) > 0.015 or np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in features.values()]) < 0.40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1 / x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = features.get(s)
        invvol = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1 / x["v"]) / mean_invvol, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * invvol) * tilt
    target = cap_and_normalize(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.48, 0.12, 0.12, 0.08, 0.08, 0.07, 0.05]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not np.any(over):
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, (float(x) for x in w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return

    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1)
        m10 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-10:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        h20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        h60 = max(float(np.max(close[-60:])), 1e-12)
        features[symbol] = {
            "ret": ret, "v": v20,
            "relative": m20,
            "rev3": -m3 / v10,
            "failrev": -((close[-1] / h20) - 1) / v20,
            "consistency": m30 / v30 * np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0),
            "break60": close[-1] / h60,
            "disprev": -m5 / v60,
        }
    if len(features) < 10:
        return

    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1)
    for x in features.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4, 0.01)

    raw = {
        "relative": {s: x["relative"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["residual"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "consistency": {s: x["consistency"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "break60": {s: x["break60"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "failrev": {s: x["failrev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    order = list(raw)
    ranks = {k: rank(v) for k, v in raw.items()}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, order)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    vols = [x["v"] for x in features.values()]

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_2_20320722_relative_momentum10_volscaled",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.3608, 0.1537, 0.1097, 0.1135, 0.1044, 0.0781, 0.0775, 0.0023]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def cross_rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def cap_and_normalize(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        excess = float(np.maximum(w - 0.25, 0).sum())
        if excess <= 1e-12:
            break
        over = w > 0.25
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return

    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1)
        m10 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-10:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        h20, h60, h120 = (max(float(np.max(close[-n:])), 1e-12) for n in (20, 60, 120))
        features[symbol] = {
            "ret": ret, "v": v20,
            "rev3": -m3 / v10,
            "failrev": -((close[-1] / h20) - 1) / v20,
            "consistency": m30 / v30 * np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0),
            "break60": close[-1] / h60,
            "disprev": -m5 / v60,
            "m10v": m10 / v10,
            "m20": m20,
            "break120": close[-1] / h120,
        }
    if len(features) < 10:
        return

    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1)
    for x in features.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["resid"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4, 0.01)

    raw_factors = {
        "relative": {s: x["m20"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["resid"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "failrev": {s: x["failrev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "consistency": {s: x["consistency"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "break60": {s: x["break60"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "m10v": {s: x["m10v"] for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    factor_order = list(raw_factors)
    ranks = {k: cross_rank(v) for k, v in raw_factors.items()}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, factor_order)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    vols = [x["v"] for x in features.values()]
    stressed = float(np.median(vols)) > 0.015 or np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in features.values()]) < 0.40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1 / x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = features.get(s)
        invvol = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1 / x["v"]) / mean_invvol, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * invvol) * tilt
    target = cap_and_normalize(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.48, 0.12, 0.12, 0.08, 0.08, 0.07, 0.05]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not np.any(over):
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, (float(x) for x in w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return

    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1)
        m10 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-10:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        h20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        h60 = max(float(np.max(close[-60:])), 1e-12)
        features[symbol] = {
            "ret": ret, "v": v20,
            "relative": m20,
            "rev3": -m3 / v10,
            "failrev": -((close[-1] / h20) - 1) / v20,
            "consistency": m30 / v30 * np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0),
            "break60": close[-1] / h60,
            "disprev": -m5 / v60,
        }
    if len(features) < 10:
        return

    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1)
    for x in features.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4, 0.01)

    raw = {
        "relative": {s: x["relative"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["residual"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "consistency": {s: x["consistency"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "break60": {s: x["break60"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "failrev": {s: x["failrev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    order = list(raw)
    ranks = {k: rank(v) for k, v in raw.items()}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, order)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    vols = [x["v"] for x in features.values()]
    stressed = float(np.median(vols)) > 0.015 or np.mean([x["relative"] > 0 for x in features.values()]) < 0.40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    raw_weight = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = features.get(s)
        invvol = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / mean_invvol, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw_weight[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * invvol) * tilt
    target = capped_weights(raw_weight)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 7
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.30, 0.15, 0.15, 0.12, 0.10, 0.10, 0.08]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    if not good:
        return out
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not np.any(over):
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, (float(x) for x in w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return

    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        h20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        h60 = max(float(np.max(close[-60:])), 1e-12)
        features[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "v": v20, "relative": m20,
            "rev3": -m3 / v10, "failrev": -((close[-1] / h20) - 1) / v20,
            "consistency": m30 / v30 * np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0),
            "break60": close[-1] / h60, "disprev": -m5 / v60}
    if len(features) < 10:
        return

    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1)
    for x in features.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4, 0.01)

    raw = {
        "relative": {s: x["relative"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["residual"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "consistency": {s: x["consistency"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "break60": {s: x["break60"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "failrev": {s: x["failrev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    ranks = {k: rank(v) for k, v in raw.items()}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, ranks)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    stressed = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in features.values()])) > 0.015 or np.mean([x["relative"] > 0 for x in features.values()]) < 0.40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    raw_weight = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = features.get(s)
        invvol = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / mean_invvol, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw_weight[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * invvol) * tilt
    target = capped_weights(raw_weight)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 7
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
