from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.48, 0.12, 0.12, 0.08, 0.08, 0.07, 0.05]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not np.any(over):
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, (float(x) for x in w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return

    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1)
        m10 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-10:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        h20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        h60 = max(float(np.max(close[-60:])), 1e-12)
        features[symbol] = {
            "ret": ret, "v": v20,
            "relative": m20,
            "rev3": -m3 / v10,
            "failrev": -((close[-1] / h20) - 1) / v20,
            "consistency": m30 / v30 * np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0),
            "break60": close[-1] / h60,
            "disprev": -m5 / v60,
        }
    if len(features) < 10:
        return

    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1)
    for x in features.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4, 0.01)

    raw = {
        "relative": {s: x["relative"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["residual"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "consistency": {s: x["consistency"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "break60": {s: x["break60"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "failrev": {s: x["failrev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    order = list(raw)
    ranks = {k: rank(v) for k, v in raw.items()}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, order)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    vols = [x["v"] for x in features.values()]
    stressed = float(np.median(vols)) > 0.015 or np.mean([x["relative"] > 0 for x in features.values()]) < 0.40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    raw_weight = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = features.get(s)
        invvol = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / mean_invvol, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw_weight[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * invvol) * tilt
    target = capped_weights(raw_weight)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 7
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.32, 0.14, 0.13, 0.11, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE], dtype=float)
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not np.any(over):
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        under = ~over
        w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(w[under].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, (float(x) for x in w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return

    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        h20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        h60 = max(float(np.max(close[-60:])), 1e-12)
        features[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "v": v20, "relative": m20,
            "rev3": -m3 / v10, "failrev": -((close[-1] / h20) - 1) / v20,
            "consistency": m30 / v30 * np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0),
            "break60": close[-1] / h60, "disprev": -m5 / v60}
    if len(features) < 10:
        return

    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280629_breakout_distance60",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.30, 0.15, 0.15, 0.12, 0.10, 0.10, 0.08]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    if not good:
        return out
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not np.any(over):
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, (float(x) for x in w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return

    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        h20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        h60 = max(float(np.max(close[-60:])), 1e-12)
        features[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "v": v20, "relative": m20,
            "rev3": -m3 / v10, "failrev": -((close[-1] / h20) - 1) / v20,
            "consistency": m30 / v30 * np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0),
            "break60": close[-1] / h60, "disprev": -m5 / v60}
    if len(features) < 10:
        return

    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.22, 0.18, 0.16, 0.16, 0.14, 0.14]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not np.any(over):
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - 0.25))
        w[over] = 0.25
        under = ~over
        w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(w[under].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        h20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        features[symbol] = {
            "ret": ret, "v": v20,
            "relative": m20,
            "rev3": -m3 / v10,
            "failrev": -((close[-1] / h20) - 1.0) / v20,
            "consistency": m30 / v30 * float(np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0)),
            "disprev": -m5 / v60,
        }
    if len(features) < 10:
        return

    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1)
    for x in features.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4.0, 0.01)

    raw = {
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["residual"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "consistency": {s: x["consistency"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "failrev": {s: x["failrev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "relative": {s: x["relative"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    ranks = {k: rank(v) for k, v in raw.items()}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, ["rev3", "residual", "consistency", "failrev", "disprev", "relative"])) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    stressed = (float(np.median([x["v"] for x in features.values()])) > 0.015 or
                float(np.mean([x["relative"] > 0 for x in features.values()])) < 0.40)
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    raw_weight = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = features.get(s)
        invvol = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / mean_invvol, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw_weight[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * invvol) * tilt
    target = capped_weights(raw_weight)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 6
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10
# fractional quantities and complete full-investment targets are handled by the helper.

def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE], dtype=float)
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not np.any(over):
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        under = ~over
        w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(w[under].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, (float(x) for x in w)))


@register_hook

    features = {}

        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]

        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0

        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        h20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        h60 = max(float(np.max(close[-60:])), 1e-12)
        features[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "v": v20, "relative": m20,
            "rev3": -m3 / v10, "failrev": -((close[-1] / h20) - 1) / v20,
            "consistency": m30 / v30 * np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0),
            "break60": close[-1] / h60, "disprev": -m5 / v60}
    if len(features) < 10:
        return

    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1)
    for x in features.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4, 0.01)

    raw = {
        "relative": {s: x["relative"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["residual"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "consistency": {s: x["consistency"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "break60": {s: x["break60"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "failrev": {s: x["failrev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    ranks = {k: rank(v) for k, v in raw.items()}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, ranks)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:

    _previous_score = dict(score)

    stressed = (float(np.median([x["v"] for x in features.values()])) > 0.015 or
                np.mean([x["relative"] > 0 for x in features.values()]) < 0.40)
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    raw_weight = {}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.18, 0.20, 0.18, 0.14, 0.18, 0.12]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not np.any(over):
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - 0.25))
        w[over] = 0.25
        under = ~over
        w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(w[under].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    features = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        h20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        features[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "v": v20, "relative": m20,
            "rev3": -m3 / v10, "failrev": -((close[-1] / h20) - 1.0) / v20,
            "consistency": m30 / v30 * float(np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0)),
            "disprev": -m5 / v60}
    if len(features) < 10:
        return
    benchmark = features.get("000300.SH", features.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1)
    for x in features.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4.0, 0.01)
    raw = {
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["residual"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "consistency": {s: x["consistency"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "failrev": {s: x["failrev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "relative": {s: x["relative"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    keys = ["rev3", "residual", "consistency", "failrev", "relative", "disprev"]
    ranks = {k: rank(raw[k]) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)
    stressed = (float(np.median([x["v"] for x in features.values()])) > 0.015 or
                float(np.mean([x["relative"] > 0 for x in features.values()])) < 0.40)
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    raw_weight = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = features.get(s)
        invvol = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / mean_invvol, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw_weight[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * invvol) * tilt
    target = capped_weights(raw_weight)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 6
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.30, 0.22, 0.18, 0.14, 0.11, 0.05]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def rank(values):
    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(valid), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not np.any(over):
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - 0.25))
        w[over] = 0.25
        under = ~over
        w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(w[under].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Exclude the current, possibly incomplete bar: decisions use completed history only.
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        r = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1.0)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1.0)
        atr10 = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), 0.003)
        max20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        max60 = max(float(np.max(close[-60:])), 1e-12)
        downside = max(float(np.std(r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0])), 0.006) if np.any(r[-20:] < 0) else 0.006
        data[symbol] = {"r": r, "v": v20, "m20": m20,
            # Matches the admitted breakout-failure direction: medium pressure
            # less short pressure, normalized by recent range volatility.
            "breakfail": ((close[-1] / max60 - 1.0) - (close[-1] / max20 - 1.0)) / atr10,
            "consistency": (m30 / v20) * float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)),
            "downmom": m20 / downside,
            "disprev": -m20 / v60}
    if len(data) < 10:
        return

    benchmark_symbol = "000300.SH" if "000300.SH" in data else "SPX"
    benchmark = data[benchmark_symbol]["r"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1.0)
    for x in data.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["r"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["r"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:]))
        x["relative"] = x["m20"] - bench_m20

    raw = {k: {s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()} for k in
           ("breakfail", "consistency", "residual", "relative", "downmom", "disprev")}
    keys = ["breakfail", "consistency", "residual", "relative", "downmom", "disprev"]
    ranks = {k: rank(raw[k]) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw_weight = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)

FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.18, 0.20, 0.18, 0.14, 0.18, 0.12]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)

def capped_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not np.any(over):

        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - 0.25))
        w[over] = 0.25
        under = ~over
        w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(w[under].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:

    features = {}

        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v10 = max(float(np.std(ret[-10:])), 0.006)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m5 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-5:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        h20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        features[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "v": v20, "relative": m20,

    if len(features) < 10:

    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1)

        a, b = x["ret"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:])) / max(x["v"] * 4.0, 0.01)
    raw = {
        "rev3": {s: x["rev3"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "residual": {s: x["residual"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "consistency": {s: x["consistency"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "failrev": {s: x["failrev"] for s, x in features.items()},
        "relative": {s: x["relative"] - bench_m20 for s, x in features.items()},
        "disprev": {s: x["disprev"] for s, x in features.items()},
    }
    keys = ["rev3", "residual", "consistency", "failrev", "relative", "disprev"]
    ranks = {k: rank(raw[k]) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)
    stressed = (float(np.median([x["v"] for x in features.values()])) > 0.015 or
                float(np.mean([x["relative"] > 0 for x in features.values()])) < 0.40)
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in features.values()]))
    raw_weight = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = features.get(s)
        invvol = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / mean_invvol, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw_weight[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * invvol) * tilt
    target = capped_weights(raw_weight)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.20, 0.19, 0.18, 0.18, 0.14, 0.11]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def cross_rank(vals):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        under = ~over
        w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(w[under].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        r = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1.0)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1.0)
        atr10 = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), 0.003)
        max20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        max60 = max(float(np.max(close[-60:])), 1e-12)
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]
        downside = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else 0.006, 0.006)
        data[symbol] = {"r": r, "v": v20, "m20": m20,
            "breakfail": ((close[-1] / max60 - 1.0) - (close[-1] / max20 - 1.0)) / atr10,
            "consistency": (m30 / v20) * float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)),
            "dispersion": -m20 / v60}

    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    bench_sym = "000300.SH" if "000300.SH" in data else "SPX"
    bench = data[bench_sym]["r"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
    for x in data.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["r"]), len(bench))
        a, b = x["r"][-n:], bench[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:]))
        x["relative"] = x["m20"] - bench_m20

    raw = {k: {s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()} for k in
           ("relative", "residual", "consistency", "breakfail", "relative", "dispersion")}
    keys = ["relative", "residual", "consistency", "breakfail", "relative", "dispersion"]
    ranks = {k: cross_rank(raw[k]) for k in set(keys)}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.30, 0.22, 0.18, 0.14, 0.11, 0.05]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def rank(values):
    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(valid), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not np.any(over):
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - 0.25))
        w[over] = 0.25
        under = ~over
        w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(w[under].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Exclude the current, possibly incomplete bar: decisions use completed history only.
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        r = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1.0)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1.0)
        atr10 = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), 0.003)
        max20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        max60 = max(float(np.max(close[-60:])), 1e-12)
        downside = max(float(np.std(r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0])), 0.006) if np.any(r[-20:] < 0) else 0.006
        data[symbol] = {"r": r, "v": v20, "m20": m20,
            # Matches the admitted breakout-failure direction: medium pressure
            # less short pressure, normalized by recent range volatility.
            "breakfail": ((close[-1] / max60 - 1.0) - (close[-1] / max20 - 1.0)) / atr10,
            "consistency": (m30 / v20) * float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)),
            "downmom": m20 / downside,
            "disprev": -m20 / v60}
    if len(data) < 10:
        return

    benchmark_symbol = "000300.SH" if "000300.SH" in data else "SPX"
    benchmark = data[benchmark_symbol]["r"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1.0)
    for x in data.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["r"]), len(benchmark))
        a, b = x["r"][-n:], benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(a[-20:] - beta * b[-20:]))
        x["relative"] = x["m20"] - bench_m20

    raw = {k: {s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()} for k in
           ("breakfail", "consistency", "residual", "relative", "downmom", "disprev")}
    keys = ["breakfail", "consistency", "residual", "relative", "downmom", "disprev"]
    ranks = {k: rank(raw[k]) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw_weight = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        invvol = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / mean_invvol, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw_weight[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * invvol) * tilt
    target = capped_weights(raw_weight)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 6

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280810_short_breakout20",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.22, 0.21, 0.23, 0.16, 0.10, 0.08]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def cap_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.01) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        excess = float(np.maximum(w - 0.25, 0).sum())
        if excess <= 1e-12:
            break
        over = w > 0.25
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    stats = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row may be the current incomplete session; use completed bars only.
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m10 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-10:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        m120 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-120:]) - 1)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), 0.003)
        high20, high60, high120 = [max(float(np.max(close[-n:])), 1e-12) for n in (20, 60, 120)]
        stats[symbol] = {
            "ret": ret, "vol": v20,
            "consistency": (m30 / v20) * float(np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0)),
            "residual": m20,
            # Strong recent breakout followed by failure is rewarded as reversal.
            "failure": ((close[-1] / high60 - 1) - (close[-1] / high20 - 1)) / atr,
            "short_breakout": (close[-1] / high20 - 1) / atr,
            "breakout120": (close[-1] / high120 - 1) / max(atr, 0.005),
            "relative20": m20,
        }
    if len(stats) < 10:
        return

    bench = stats.get("000300.SH", stats.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    bench20 = float(np.prod(1 + bench[-20:]) - 1)
    for x in stats.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(bench))
        beta = float(np.cov(x["ret"][-n:], bench[-n:], ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(bench[-n:])), 1e-8)

]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.20, 0.19, 0.18, 0.18, 0.14, 0.11]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous_score = None


def cross_rank(vals):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > 0.25
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - 0.25).sum())
        w[over] = 0.25
        under = ~over
        w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(w[under].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=320)

            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 130 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):

        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1.0)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1.0)
        atr10 = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), 0.003)
        max20 = max(float(np.max(close[-20:])), 1e-12)
        max60 = max(float(np.max(close[-60:])), 1e-12)
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]
        downside = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else 0.006, 0.006)
        data[symbol] = {"r": r, "v": v20, "m20": m20,
            "breakfail": ((close[-1] / max60 - 1.0) - (close[-1] / max20 - 1.0)) / atr10,
            "consistency": (m30 / v20) * float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)),
            "dispersion": -m20 / v60}

    if len(data) < 10:

    bench_sym = "000300.SH" if "000300.SH" in data else "SPX"
    bench = data[bench_sym]["r"]
    bench_m20 = float(np.prod(1 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
    for x in data.values():

        a, b = x["r"][-n:], bench[-n:]

        x["relative"] = x["m20"] - bench_m20

    raw = {k: {s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()} for k in
           ("relative", "residual", "consistency", "breakfail", "relative", "dispersion")}
    keys = ["relative", "residual", "consistency", "breakfail", "relative", "dispersion"]
    ranks = {k: cross_rank(raw[k]) for k in set(keys)}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k].get(s, 0.5) for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous_score is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous_score = dict(score)

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw_weight = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        invvol = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / mean_invvol, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.45 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.55 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw_weight[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * invvol) * tilt
    target = capped_weights(raw_weight)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.28, 0.22, 0.18, 0.12, 0.10, 0.10]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def ranks(vals):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def capped(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.005) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not np.any(over):
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    stats = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Do not use the current, potentially incomplete bar.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        v3 = max(float(np.std(r[-3:])), 0.004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-3:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1)
        m120 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-120:]) - 1)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-10:] - l[-10:]) / c[-10:])), 0.003)
        hi20, hi60, hi120 = [max(float(np.max(c[-n:])), 1e-12) for n in (20, 60, 120)]
        # Positive values favor failed/overextended winners reverting, while
        # dispersion and volatility-state terms reward short-horizon reversal.
        failure = ((c[-1] / hi60 - 1.0) - (c[-1] / hi20 - 1.0)) / atr
        dispersion = -m3 / v3 * (1.0 + abs(m20) / max(v20, 0.01))
        volstate = -m3 / v3 * (1.0 + min(v20 / v60, 2.0))
        consistency = (m30 / v20) * float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0))
        breakout120 = (c[-1] / hi120 - 1.0) / max(atr, 0.005)
        stats[s] = {"r": r, "vol": v20, "failure": failure,
                    "dispersion": dispersion, "volstate": volstate,
                    "consistency": consistency, "breakout120": breakout120,
                    "momentum": m20}
    if len(stats) < 10:
        return

    bench = stats.get("000300.SH", stats.get("SPX"))["r"]
    nbench = min(60, len(bench))
    for x in stats.values():
        n = min(nbench, len(x["r"]))
        beta = float(np.cov(x["r"][-n:], bench[-n:], ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(bench[-n:])), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["r"][-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))

    keys = ["failure", "dispersion", "volstate", "consistency", "breakout120", "residual"]
    rr = {k: ranks({s: x[k] for s, x in stats.items()}) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * rr[k][s] for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in stats.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["momentum"] > 0 for x in stats.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol"] for x in stats.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = stats.get(s)
        iv = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["vol"]) / inv_mean, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.55 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.50 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * iv) * tilt
    target = capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert set(UNIVERSE).isdisjoint({"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"})

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

    "miner_2_20280810_short_breakout20",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.22, 0.21, 0.23, 0.16, 0.10, 0.08]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def cap_weights(raw):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.01) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(20):
        excess = float(np.maximum(w - 0.25, 0).sum())
        if excess <= 1e-12:
            break
        over = w > 0.25
        w[over] = 0.25
        w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    stats = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row may be the current incomplete session; use completed bars only.
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m10 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-10:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        m120 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-120:]) - 1)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), 0.003)
        high20, high60, high120 = [max(float(np.max(close[-n:])), 1e-12) for n in (20, 60, 120)]
        stats[symbol] = {

            "consistency": (m30 / v20) * float(np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0)),
            "residual": m20,
            # Strong recent breakout followed by failure is rewarded as reversal.
            "failure": ((close[-1] / high60 - 1) - (close[-1] / high20 - 1)) / atr,

    if len(stats) < 10:

    for x in stats.values():

        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["ret"][-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        x["relative20"] = x["relative20"] - bench20

    keys = ["consistency", "residual", "failure", "short_breakout", "breakout120", "relative20"]
    ranks = {k: rank({s: x[k] for s, x in stats.items()}) for k in keys}

    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    invvol_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol"] for x in stats.values()]))

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.32, 0.25, 0.20, 0.08, 0.08, 0.07]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def ranks(vals):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out

def capped(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.005) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not np.any(over): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        if np.any(~over): w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    stats = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        v3, v20, v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-3:])), .004), max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006), max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)
        m3, m20, m30 = float(np.prod(1+r[-3:])-1), float(np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1), float(np.prod(1+r[-30:])-1)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-10:]-l[-10:])/c[-10:])), .003)
        hi20, hi60, hi120 = [max(float(np.max(c[-n:])), 1e-12) for n in (20,60,120)]
        stats[s] = {"r":r, "vol":v20,
          "failure":((c[-1]/hi60-1)-(c[-1]/hi20-1))/atr,
          "dispersion":-m3/v3*(1+abs(m20)/max(v20,.01)),
          "volstate":-m3/v3*(1+min(v20/v60,2)),
          "consistency":(m30/v20)*float(np.mean(r[-30:]>0)),
          "breakout120":(c[-1]/hi120-1)/max(atr,.005), "momentum":m20}
    if len(stats) < 10: return
    bench = stats.get("000300.SH", stats.get("SPX"))["r"]
    for x in stats.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["r"]), len(bench))
        beta = float(np.cov(x["r"][-n:], bench[-n:], ddof=0)[0,1]) / max(float(np.var(bench[-n:])),1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["r"][-20:] - beta*bench[-20:]))
    keys = ["failure","dispersion","volstate","consistency","breakout120","residual"]
    rr = {k:ranks({s:x[k] for s,x in stats.items()}) for k in keys}
    score = {s:sum(w*rr[k][s] for w,k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS,keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s:.8*score[s]+.2*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in stats.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["momentum"] > 0 for x in stats.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > .015 or breadth < .40
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1/x["vol"] for x in stats.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = stats.get(s); iv = 1 if x is None else np.clip((1/x["vol"])/inv_mean,.75,1.15)
        tilt = (1.55 if s in DEFENSIVE else .50 if s in RISKY else .85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else .85 if s in RISKY else 1)
        raw[s] = max(score[s],.04)*(.85+.15*iv)*tilt
    target = capped(raw)
    forecast = {s:float(np.clip((score[s]-.5)*.06,-.03,.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE)==15 and len(FACTOR_IDS)<=10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS)-1)<1e-9
assert set(UNIVERSE).isdisjoint({"DXY","USDCNY","USDJPY","EURUSD","VIX"})

        beta = float(np.cov(x["r"][-n:], bench[-n:], ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(bench[-n:])), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["r"][-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))

    keys = ["failure", "dispersion", "volstate", "consistency", "breakout120", "residual"]
    rr = {k: ranks({s: x[k] for s, x in stats.items()}) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * rr[k][s] for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:

    _previous = dict(score)

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in stats.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["momentum"] > 0 for x in stats.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol"] for x in stats.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:

        iv = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["vol"]) / inv_mean, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.55 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.50 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * iv) * tilt
    target = capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.36, 0.28, 0.22, 0.06, 0.05, 0.03]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def rank_map(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(valid))
    return out

def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.005) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not np.any(over):
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        if np.any(~over):
            w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    stats = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Exclude the current incomplete bar: decisions only use completed history.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        lo = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        v3 = max(float(np.std(r[-3:])), 0.004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-3:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-10:] - lo[-10:]) / c[-10:])), 0.003)
        hi20 = max(float(np.max(c[-20:])), 1e-12)
        hi60 = max(float(np.max(c[-60:])), 1e-12)
        hi120 = max(float(np.max(c[-120:])), 1e-12)
        stats[symbol] = {
            "r": r, "vol": v20, "momentum": m20,
            "failure": ((c[-1] / hi60 - 1) - (c[-1] / hi20 - 1)) / atr,
            "dispersion": -m3 / v3 * (1 + abs(m20) / max(v20, 0.01)),
            "volstate": -m3 / v3 * (1 + min(v20 / v60, 2)),
            "consistency": (m30 / v20) * float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)),
            "breakout120": (c[-1] / hi120 - 1) / max(atr, 0.005),
        }
    if len(stats) < 10:
        return

    benchmark = stats.get("000300.SH", stats.get("SPX"))["r"]
    for x in stats.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["r"]), len(benchmark))
        beta = float(np.cov(x["r"][-n:], benchmark[-n:], ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(benchmark[-n:])), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["r"][-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))

    keys = ["failure", "dispersion", "volstate", "consistency", "breakout120", "residual"]
    ranks = {k: rank_map({s: x[k] for s, x in stats.items()}) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k][s] for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in stats.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["momentum"] > 0 for x in stats.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1 / x["vol"] for x in stats.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = stats.get(s)
        iv = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1 / x["vol"]) / inv_mean, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.55 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.50 if s in RISKY else 0.85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else 0.85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.04) * (0.85 + 0.15 * iv) * tilt
    target = cap_weights(raw)
    # Ten-session, bounded deterministic edge estimate for migration-cost gating.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert set(UNIVERSE).isdisjoint({"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"})

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.36, 0.28, 0.22, 0.06, 0.05, 0.03]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def rank_map(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(valid))
    return out

def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.005) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not np.any(over): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        if np.any(~over): w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return
    stats = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c, h, lo = [np.asarray(df[x], float)[:-1] for x in ("close", "high", "low")]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        v3, v20, v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-3:])), .004), max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006), max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)
        m3, m20, m30 = np.prod(1+r[-3:])-1, np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1, np.prod(1+r[-30:])-1
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-10:]-lo[-10:])/c[-10:])), .003)
        hi20, hi60, hi120 = [max(float(np.max(c[-n:])), 1e-12) for n in (20,60,120)]
        stats[symbol] = {"r":r, "vol":v20, "momentum":m20,
          "failure":((c[-1]/hi60-1)-(c[-1]/hi20-1))/atr,
          "dispersion":-m3/v3*(1+abs(m20)/max(v20,.01)),
          "volstate":-m3/v3*(1+min(v20/v60,2)),
          "consistency":m30/v20*float(np.mean(r[-30:]>0)),
          "breakout120":(c[-1]/hi120-1)/max(atr,.005)}
    if len(stats) < 10: return
    benchmark = stats.get("000300.SH", stats.get("SPX"))["r"]
    for x in stats.values():
        n=min(60,len(x["r"]),len(benchmark)); b=benchmark[-n:]
        beta=float(np.cov(x["r"][-n:],b,ddof=0)[0,1])/max(float(np.var(b)),1e-8)
        x["residual"]=float(np.sum(x["r"][-20:]-beta*benchmark[-20:]))
    keys=["failure","dispersion","volstate","consistency","breakout120","residual"]
    ranks={k:rank_map({s:x[k] for s,x in stats.items()}) for k in keys}
    score={s:sum(w*ranks[k][s] for w,k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS,keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score={s:.8*score[s]+.2*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous=dict(score)
    median_vol=float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in stats.values()])); breadth=float(np.mean([x["momentum"]>0 for x in stats.values()]))
    stressed=median_vol>.015 or breadth<.40; inv_mean=float(np.mean([1/x["vol"] for x in stats.values()])); raw={}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x=stats.get(s); iv=1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1/x["vol"])/inv_mean,.75,1.15)
        tilt=(1.55 if s in DEFENSIVE else .50 if s in RISKY else .85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else .85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s]=max(score[s],.04)*(.85+.15*iv)*tilt
    target=cap_weights(raw)
    forecast={s:float(np.clip((score[s]-.5)*.06,-.03,.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE)==15 and len(FACTOR_IDS)<=10 and abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS)-1)<1e-9
assert set(UNIVERSE).isdisjoint({"DXY","USDCNY","USDJPY","EURUSD","VIX"})

def rank_map(values):

    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):

def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.22):

        beta = float(np.cov(x["r"][-n:], benchmark[-n:], ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(benchmark[-n:])), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["r"][-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))

    ranks = {k: rank_map({s: x[k] for s, x in stats.items()}) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k][s] for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([x["momentum"] > 0 for x in stats.values()]))

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.30, 0.25, 0.20, 0.12, 0.08, 0.05]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def ranks(vals):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out

def capped(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, .01)), .005) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum()); w[over] = cap
        if (~over).any(): w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.25, 0.22, 0.16, 0.15, 0.12, 0.10]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def ranks(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out

def capped(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.005) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        if (~over).any():
            w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        hi = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        lo = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v1 = max(float(np.std(r[-1:])), .004)
        v3 = max(float(np.std(r[-3:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)
        m3 = np.prod(1 + r[-3:]) - 1
        m20 = np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1
        m30 = np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1
        atr = max(float(np.mean((hi[-10:] - lo[-10:]) / c[-10:])), .003)
        h20, h60 = max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12), max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12)
        data[s] = dict(r=r, vol=v20,
            failure=((c[-1] / h60 - 1) - (c[-1] / h20 - 1)) / atr,
            volstate=-m3 / v3 * (1 + min(v20 / v60, 2)),
            consistency=m30 / v20 * float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)),
            dispersion=-m3 / v3 * (1 + abs(m20) / max(v20, .01)),
            lowvol=-m3 / v1 / max(v20, .01))
    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    benchmark = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))["r"]
    for x in data.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["r"]), len(benchmark))
        b = benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(x["r"][-n:], b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["r"][-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))
    keys = ["failure", "volstate", "residual", "consistency", "dispersion", "lowvol"]
    rr = {k: ranks({s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()}) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * rr[k][s] for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    medvol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["r"][-20:].sum() > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = medvol > .015 or breadth < .40
    invmean = float(np.mean([1 / x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        iv = 1 if x is None else np.clip((1 / x["vol"]) / invmean, .75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.55 if s in DEFENSIVE else .50 if s in RISKY else .85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else .85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .04) * (.85 + .15 * iv) * tilt
    target = capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10 and abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1) < 1e-9
assert set(UNIVERSE).isdisjoint({"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"})

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]

RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.30, 0.25, 0.20, 0.12, 0.08, 0.05]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def ranks(vals):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out

def capped(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, .01)), .005) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum()); w[over] = cap
        if (~over).any(): w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        hi = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        lo = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v1 = max(float(np.std(r[-1:])), .004)
        v3 = max(float(np.std(r[-3:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)
        m3 = np.prod(1+r[-3:])-1; m20 = np.prod(1+r[-20:])-1; m30 = np.prod(1+r[-30:])-1
        atr = max(float(np.mean((hi[-10:] - lo[-10:]) / c[-10:])), .003)
