import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.22, 0.20, 0.18, 0.18, 0.13, 0.09]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out

def cap_and_normalize(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.005) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        if (~over).any():
            w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        hi = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        lo = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v1 = max(float(np.std(r[-1:])), .004)
        v3 = max(float(np.std(r[-3:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)
        m3 = np.prod(1 + r[-3:]) - 1
        m20 = np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1
        m30 = np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1
        atr = max(float(np.mean((hi[-10:] - lo[-10:]) / c[-10:])), .003)
        data[s] = dict(r=r, vol=v20,
            failure=((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1) -
                     (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1)) / atr,
            volstate=-m3 / v3 * (1 + min(v20 / v60, 2)),
            consistency=m30 / v20 * float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)),
            dispersion=-m3 / v3 * (1 + abs(m20) / max(v20, .01)),
            lowvol=-m3 / v1 / max(v20, .01))
    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    benchmark = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))["r"]
    for x in data.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["r"]), len(benchmark))
        b = benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(x["r"][-n:], b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["r"][-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))
    keys = ["failure", "volstate", "residual", "consistency", "dispersion", "lowvol"]
    rr = {k: rank({s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()}) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * rr[k][s] for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    medvol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["r"][-20:].sum() > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = medvol > .015 or breadth < .40
    invmean = float(np.mean([1 / x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        iv = 1 if x is None else np.clip((1 / x["vol"]) / invmean, .75, 1.15)
        tilt = ((1.55 if s in DEFENSIVE else .50 if s in RISKY else .85)
                if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else .85 if s in RISKY else 1.0))
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .04) * (.85 + .15 * iv) * tilt
    target = cap_and_normalize(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10 and abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1) < 1e-9
assert set(UNIVERSE).isdisjoint({"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"})

def capped(raw, cap=0.22):

        v3 = max(float(np.std(r[-3:])), .004)

        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)
        m3 = np.prod(1 + r[-3:]) - 1
        m20 = np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1
        m30 = np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1
        atr = max(float(np.mean((hi[-10:] - lo[-10:]) / c[-10:])), .003)
        h20, h60 = max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12), max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12)

            lowvol=-m3 / v1 / max(v20, .01))
    if len(data) < 10:
        return

        b = benchmark[-n:]

        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["r"][-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))
    keys = ["failure", "volstate", "residual", "consistency", "dispersion", "lowvol"]
    rr = {k: ranks({s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()}) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * rr[k][s] for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    medvol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["r"][-20:].sum() > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = medvol > .015 or breadth < .40
    invmean = float(np.mean([1 / x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:

        iv = 1 if x is None else np.clip((1 / x["vol"]) / invmean, .75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.55 if s in DEFENSIVE else .50 if s in RISKY else .85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else .85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .04) * (.85 + .15 * iv) * tilt
    target = capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10 and abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1) < 1e-9

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.22, 0.20, 0.18, 0.18, 0.13, 0.09]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out

def cap_and_normalize(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.005) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        if (~over).any():
            w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        hi = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        lo = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v1 = max(float(np.std(r[-1:])), .004)
        v3 = max(float(np.std(r[-3:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)
        m3 = np.prod(1 + r[-3:]) - 1
        m20 = np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1
        m30 = np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1
        atr = max(float(np.mean((hi[-10:] - lo[-10:]) / c[-10:])), .003)
        data[s] = dict(r=r, vol=v20,
            failure=((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1) -
                     (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1)) / atr,
            volstate=-m3 / v3 * (1 + min(v20 / v60, 2)),
            consistency=m30 / v20 * float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)),
            dispersion=-m3 / v3 * (1 + abs(m20) / max(v20, .01)),
            lowvol=-m3 / v1 / max(v20, .01))
    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    benchmark = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))["r"]
    for x in data.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["r"]), len(benchmark))
        b = benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(x["r"][-n:], b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["r"][-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))
    keys = ["failure", "volstate", "residual", "consistency", "dispersion", "lowvol"]
    rr = {k: rank({s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()}) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * rr[k][s] for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    medvol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["r"][-20:].sum() > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = medvol > .015 or breadth < .40
    invmean = float(np.mean([1 / x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        iv = 1 if x is None else np.clip((1 / x["vol"]) / invmean, .75, 1.15)
        tilt = ((1.55 if s in DEFENSIVE else .50 if s in RISKY else .85)
                if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else .85 if s in RISKY else 1.0))
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .04) * (.85 + .15 * iv) * tilt
    target = cap_and_normalize(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10 and abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1) < 1e-9
assert set(UNIVERSE).isdisjoint({"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"})
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.30, 0.22, 0.18, 0.14, 0.11, 0.05]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def percentile_rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def cap_normalize(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.005) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(40):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - cap))
        w[over] = cap
        under = ~over
        if under.any():
            w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(w[under].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The last row may be today's incomplete bar; decisions use completed data only.
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        downside = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(ret[-20:], 0.0))), 0.004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), 0.003)
        # Failure/reversal is deliberately low weight in the current ensemble.
        failure = ((close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) -
                   (close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr
        data[symbol] = dict(ret=ret, vol=v20, m20=m20,
            failure=failure,
            consistency=m30 / v20 * float(np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0)),
            relstrength=m20 / v20,
            downside=m20 / downside,
            dispersion=-m3 / max(float(np.std(ret[-3:])), 0.004) * (1.0 + abs(m20) / max(v20, .01)))

    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    benchmark = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    for x in data.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        b = benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(x["ret"][-n:], b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["ret"][-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))

    keys = ["failure", "consistency", "residual", "relstrength", "downside", "dispersion"]
    ranks = {key: percentile_rank({s: x[key] for s, x in data.items()}) for key in keys}
    score = {s: sum(weight * ranks[key][s] for weight, key in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["ret"][-20:].sum() > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(symbol)

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}

    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",

    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.22, 0.20, 0.18, 0.18, 0.13, 0.09]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out

def cap_and_normalize(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.005) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        if (~over).any():
            w[~over] += excess * w[~over] / max(float(w[~over].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        hi = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        lo = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0):

        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v1 = max(float(np.std(r[-1:])), .004)
        v3 = max(float(np.std(r[-3:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)
        m3 = np.prod(1 + r[-3:]) - 1
        m20 = np.prod(1 + r[-20:]) - 1
        m30 = np.prod(1 + r[-30:]) - 1
        atr = max(float(np.mean((hi[-10:] - lo[-10:]) / c[-10:])), .003)
        data[s] = dict(r=r, vol=v20,
            failure=((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1) -

            volstate=-m3 / v3 * (1 + min(v20 / v60, 2)),
            consistency=m30 / v20 * float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)),
            dispersion=-m3 / v3 * (1 + abs(m20) / max(v20, .01)),

    if len(data) < 10:

        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["r"][-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))

    rr = {k: rank({s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()}) for k in keys}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.20, 0.18, 0.24, 0.18, 0.10, 0.10]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def normalize_cap(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.005) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - cap))
        w[over] = cap
        under = ~over
        w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(w[under].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v3 = max(float(np.std(ret[-3:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), .006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), .006)
        downside = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(ret[-20:], 0.0))), .004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), .003)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        # Positive values are preferred for every ensemble direction (+1).
        failure = ((close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) -
                   (close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr
        data[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "vol": v20,
            "failure": failure,
            "volstate": -m3 / v3 * np.clip(v20 / v30, .5, 2.0),
            "consistency": m30 / v20 * float(np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0)),
            "dispersion": -m3 / v3 * (1.0 + abs(m20) / max(v20, .01)),
            "lowvol": m20 / v20 - .35 * v20,
            "m20": m20}
    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    benchmark = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    for x in data.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        b = benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(x["ret"][-n:], b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["ret"][-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))
    keys = ["failure", "volstate", "residual", "consistency", "dispersion", "lowvol"]
    ranks = {k: rank({s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()}) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k][s] * d for w, k, d in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys, FACTOR_DIRECTIONS)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["ret"][-20:].sum() > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > .015 or breadth < .40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        iv = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["vol"]) / mean_invvol, .75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.55 if s in DEFENSIVE else .50 if s in RISKY else .85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else .85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .04) * (.85 + .15 * iv) * tilt
    target = normalize_cap(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == len(FACTOR_DIRECTIONS)
assert set(UNIVERSE).isdisjoint({"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"})

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.20, 0.18, 0.24, 0.18, 0.10, 0.10]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def normalize_cap(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.005) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - cap))
        w[over] = cap
        under = ~over
        w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(w[under].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v3 = max(float(np.std(ret[-3:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), .006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), .006)
        downside = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(ret[-20:], 0.0))), .004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), .003)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        # Positive values are preferred for every ensemble direction (+1).
        failure = ((close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) -
                   (close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr
        data[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "vol": v20,
            "failure": failure,
            "volstate": -m3 / v3 * np.clip(v20 / v30, .5, 2.0),
            "consistency": m30 / v20 * float(np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0)),
            "dispersion": -m3 / v3 * (1.0 + abs(m20) / max(v20, .01)),
            "lowvol": m20 / v20 - .35 * v20,

        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["ret"][-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))
    keys = ["failure", "volstate", "residual", "consistency", "dispersion", "lowvol"]
    ranks = {k: rank({s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()}) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k][s] * d for w, k, d in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys, FACTOR_DIRECTIONS)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["ret"][-20:].sum() > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > .015 or breadth < .40

    raw = {}

    target = normalize_cap(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
# Exact active ensemble supplied by Screener (six factors, all positive direction).
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.227, 0.162, 0.167, 0.154, 0.168, 0.122]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def normalize_cap(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.005) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - cap))
        w[over] = cap
        under = ~over
        w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(w[under].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v3 = max(float(np.std(ret[-3:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), .006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), .006)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), .003)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        data[symbol] = {
            "ret": ret, "vol": v20,
            "failure": ((close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) -
                        (close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr,
            "volstate": -m3 / v3 * np.clip(v20 / v30, .5, 2.0),
            "consistency": m30 / v20 * float(np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0)),
            "dispersion": -m3 / v3 * (1.0 + abs(m20) / max(v20, .01)),
            "lowvol": m20 / v20 - .35 * v20,
        }
    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    benchmark = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    for x in data.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        b = benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(x["ret"][-n:], b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["ret"][-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))
    # Key order is identical to FACTOR_IDS/FACTOR_WEIGHTS above.
    keys = ["volstate", "residual", "failure", "consistency", "lowvol", "dispersion"]
    ranks = {k: rank({s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()}) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k][s] * d for w, k, d in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys, FACTOR_DIRECTIONS)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["ret"][-20:].sum() > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > .015 or breadth < .40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        iv = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["vol"]) / mean_invvol, .75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.55 if s in DEFENSIVE else .50 if s in RISKY else .85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else .85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .04) * (.85 + .15 * iv) * tilt
    target = normalize_cap(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == len(FACTOR_DIRECTIONS)
assert set(UNIVERSE).isdisjoint({"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"})
# All online targets are generated for the complete tradable universe and normalized above.
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9

def normalize_cap(raw, cap=0.22):

        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), .003)

    benchmark = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    for x in data.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        b = benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(x["ret"][-n:], b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["ret"][-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))
    keys = ["volstate", "lowvol", "failure", "dispersion", "consistency", "residual"]
    ranks = {k: rank({s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()}) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k][s] * d for w, k, d in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys, FACTOR_DIRECTIONS)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["ret"][-20:].sum() > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > .015 or breadth < .40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        iv = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["vol"]) / mean_invvol, .75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.55 if s in DEFENSIVE else .50 if s in RISKY else .85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else .85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .04) * (.85 + .15 * iv) * tilt
    target = normalize_cap(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.30, 0.22, 0.18, 0.14, 0.11, 0.05]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_prev = None


def pct_rank(vals):
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1) / max(n, 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, .01)), .002) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        under = ~over
        w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(w[under].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _prev
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return
    series = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=340)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row may be the in-progress/current session: use completed rows only.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or not np.all(np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)
        atr10 = max(float(np.mean((h[-10:] - l[-10:]) / c[-10:])), .003)
        m5 = c[-1] / c[-6] - 1
        m20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        m30 = c[-1] / c[-31] - 1
        breakout = ((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1) -
                    (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1)) / atr10
        consistency = m30 * (.5 + float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0))) / v20
        series[s] = {"r": r, "c": c, "v": v20, "breakout": breakout,
                     "consistency": consistency, "m5": m5, "m20": m20}
    if len(series) < 10: return
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x["r"][-60:] for x in series.values()]), axis=0)
    for x in series.values():
        rr = x["r"][-60:]
        beta = float(np.cov(rr, bench, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(bench)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["r"][-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        neg = x["r"][-20:][x["r"][-20:] < 0]
        downside = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else .002, .002) * np.sqrt(252)
        x["downside"] = x["m20"] / downside
    dispersion = float(np.std([x["m20"] for x in series.values()]))
    disp_mult = float(np.clip(1 + .30 * np.tanh(dispersion / .04), .70, 1.30))
    for x in series.values():
        x["reversal"] = np.clip(-x["m5"] / v60(x["r"]) * disp_mult, -8, 8)
    keys = ["breakout", "consistency", "residual", "m20", "downside", "reversal"]
    ranks = {k: pct_rank({s: x[k] for s, x in series.items()}) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k][s] for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _prev is not None: score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _prev[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _prev = dict(score)
    medvol = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in series.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in series.values()]))
    stressed = medvol > .015 or breadth < .40
    invmean = np.mean([1 / x["v"] for x in series.values()])
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = series.get(s)
        iv = 1 if x is None else np.clip((1 / x["v"]) / invmean, .75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.55 if s in defensive else .50 if s in risky else .85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in defensive else .85 if s in risky else 1)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * iv) * tilt
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


def v60(r):
    return max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 6
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1) < 1e-9
assert set(UNIVERSE).isdisjoint({"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"})

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
DEFENSIVE = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
RISKY = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
# Exact active ensemble supplied by Screener (six factors, all positive direction).
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.227, 0.162, 0.167, 0.154, 0.168, 0.122]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def normalize_cap(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.005) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - cap))
        w[over] = cap
        under = ~over
        w[under] += excess * w[under] / max(float(w[under].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=330)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v3 = max(float(np.std(ret[-3:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), .006)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), .006)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), .003)
        m3 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-3:]) - 1)
        m20 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-20:]) - 1)
        m30 = float(np.prod(1 + ret[-30:]) - 1)
        data[symbol] = {
            "ret": ret, "vol": v20,
            "failure": ((close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) -
                        (close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr,
            "volstate": -m3 / v3 * np.clip(v20 / v30, .5, 2.0),
            "consistency": m30 / v20 * float(np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0)),
            "dispersion": -m3 / v3 * (1.0 + abs(m20) / max(v20, .01)),
            "lowvol": m20 / v20 - .35 * v20,
        }
    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    benchmark = data.get("000300.SH", data.get("SPX"))["ret"]
    for x in data.values():
        n = min(60, len(x["ret"]), len(benchmark))
        b = benchmark[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(x["ret"][-n:], b, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(b)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["ret"][-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))
    # Key order is identical to FACTOR_IDS/FACTOR_WEIGHTS above.
    keys = ["volstate", "residual", "failure", "consistency", "lowvol", "dispersion"]
    ranks = {k: rank({s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()}) for k in keys}
    score = {s: sum(w * ranks[k][s] * d for w, k, d in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys, FACTOR_DIRECTIONS)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["ret"][-20:].sum() > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > .015 or breadth < .40
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        iv = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["vol"]) / mean_invvol, .75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.55 if s in DEFENSIVE else .50 if s in RISKY else .85) if stressed else (1.15 if s in DEFENSIVE else .85 if s in RISKY else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .04) * (.85 + .15 * iv) * tilt
    target = normalize_cap(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == len(FACTOR_DIRECTIONS)
assert set(UNIVERSE).isdisjoint({"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"})
# All online targets are generated for the complete tradable universe and normalized above.
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.428, 0.182, 0.134, 0.130, 0.126]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1) / max(n, 1)
    return out


def capped(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.002) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(40):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=340)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final observation is not used: decisions see completed prior sessions only.
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 80 or not np.all(np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = close[-1] / close[-4] - 1.0
        m20 = close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0
        m30 = close[-1] / close[-31] - 1.0
        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), 0.003)
        # Positive when price has failed/receded from a recent high (contrarian).
        failure = np.clip(-(close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / atr, -8, 8)
        consistency = m30 * (0.5 + float(np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0))) / v20
        data[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "v": v20, "m3": m3, "m20": m20,
                        "failure": failure, "consistency": consistency}

    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    benchmark = np.mean(np.array([x["ret"][-60:] for x in data.values()]), axis=0)
    for x in data.values():
        rr = x["ret"][-60:]
        beta = float(np.cov(rr, benchmark, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(benchmark)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["ret"][-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))
        x["vol_reversal"] = np.clip(-x["m3"] / x["v"], -8, 8)

    signals = {
        "m20": rank({s: x["m20"] for s, x in data.items()}),
        "vol_reversal": rank({s: x["vol_reversal"] for s, x in data.items()}),
        "failure": rank({s: x["failure"] for s, x in data.items()}),
        "residual": rank({s: x["residual"] for s, x in data.items()}),
        "consistency": rank({s: x["consistency"] for s, x in data.items()}),
    }
    keys = ["m20", "vol_reversal", "failure", "residual", "consistency"]
    score = {s: sum(w * signals[k][s] for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in data.values()]))

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.428, 0.182, 0.134, 0.130, 0.126]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1) / max(n, 1)
    return out


def capped(raw, cap=0.22):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.002) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(40):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=340)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final observation is not used: decisions see completed prior sessions only.
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 80 or not np.all(np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(ret[-60:])), 0.006)
        m3 = close[-1] / close[-4] - 1.0
        m20 = close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0
        m30 = close[-1] / close[-31] - 1.0
        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), 0.003)
        # Positive when price has failed/receded from a recent high (contrarian).
        failure = np.clip(-(close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / atr, -8, 8)
        consistency = m30 * (0.5 + float(np.mean(ret[-30:] > 0))) / v20
        data[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "v": v20, "m3": m3, "m20": m20,
                        "failure": failure, "consistency": consistency}

    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    benchmark = np.mean(np.array([x["ret"][-60:] for x in data.values()]), axis=0)
    for x in data.values():
        rr = x["ret"][-60:]
        beta = float(np.cov(rr, benchmark, ddof=0)[0, 1]) / max(float(np.var(benchmark)), 1e-8)
        x["residual"] = float(np.sum(x["ret"][-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))
        x["vol_reversal"] = np.clip(-x["m3"] / x["v"], -8, 8)

    signals = {
        "m20": rank({s: x["m20"] for s, x in data.items()}),
        "vol_reversal": rank({s: x["vol_reversal"] for s, x in data.items()}),
        "failure": rank({s: x["failure"] for s, x in data.items()}),
        "residual": rank({s: x["residual"] for s, x in data.items()}),
        "consistency": rank({s: x["consistency"] for s, x in data.items()}),
    }
    keys = ["m20", "vol_reversal", "failure", "residual", "consistency"]
    score = {s: sum(w * signals[k][s] for w, k in zip(FACTOR_WEIGHTS, keys)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in data.values()])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        vol_adj = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / inv_mean, 0.75, 1.15)
        if stressed:
            regime = 1.45 if s in defensive else (0.55 if s in risky else 0.90)
        else:
            regime = 1.10 if s in defensive else (0.88 if s in risky else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * vol_adj) * regime
    target = capped(raw)
    # Deterministic 10-session edge estimate is supplied for every tradable asset.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.32, 0.24, 0.16, 0.16, 0.12]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def _rank(vals):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out

def _cap(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.002) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum()); w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=360)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row is the in-session/current observation; use completed rows only.
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 80 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0): continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        m20 = close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0
        m30 = close[-1] / close[-31] - 1.0
        downside = np.minimum(ret[-20:], 0.0)
        down_dev = max(float(np.std(downside)) * np.sqrt(252), 0.01)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), 0.003)
        data[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "v": v20, "m20": m20, "m30": m30,
                        "downmom": m20 / down_dev, "atr": atr}
    if len(data) < 10: return

    # Cross-sectional factor calculations, all based on completed daily data.
    vols = {s: x["v"] for s, x in data.items()}
    vol_sorted = sorted(vols.values())
    def pct(v): return sum(z <= v for z in vol_sorted) / max(len(vol_sorted), 1)
    market20 = float(np.mean([x["m20"] for x in data.values()]))
    relative = {s: x["m20"] - market20 for s, x in data.items()}
    volstate = {s: -float(np.sum(x["ret"][-3:])) * (0.65 + 0.70 * pct(x["v"])) for s, x in data.items()}
    failure = {}
    consistency = {}
    for s, x in data.items():
        c = np.asarray([*[]])  # placeholder overwritten below
        # Re-fetching is avoided: derive breakout signals from the same series in data.
        # Store required price history lazily in the initial pass is simpler and deterministic.
    # Reconstruct the two price-derived signals from fresh completed data.
    for s in list(data):
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=360).sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]; r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        failure[s] = (c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1.0) / data[s]["atr"] - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1.0) / data[s]["atr"]
        consistency[s] = data[s]["m30"] * (0.5 + float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0))) / data[s]["v"]
    signals = [_rank(relative), _rank({s: x["downmom"] for s, x in data.items()}),
               _rank(failure), _rank(volstate), _rank(consistency)]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * signals[i][s] for i in range(5)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vols.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        vol_adj = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / inv_mean, 0.75, 1.15)
        regime = (1.35 if s in defensive else 0.60 if s in risky else 0.92) if stressed else (1.08 if s in defensive else 0.90 if s in risky else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * vol_adj) * regime
    target = _cap(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10 and abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert all(x >= 0 for x in FACTOR_WEIGHTS)
 significantly = None

# The ensemble contract is intentionally explicit and auditable.
_ = significantly

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.38, 0.18, 0.16, 0.16, 0.12]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def rank(values):
    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1) / max(len(valid), 1)
    return out

def capped(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.002) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(60):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum()); w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if not rest.any(): break
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=360)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 80 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        v = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), 0.006)
        m20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0
        m3 = float(np.sum(r[-3:]))
        downside = np.minimum(r[-20:], 0.0)
        dd = max(float(np.std(downside)), 0.005)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-10:] - l[-10:]) / c[-10:])), 0.003)
        data[s] = dict(c=c, r=r, v=v, m20=m20, m3=m3, down=dd, atr=atr)
    if len(data) < 10: return
    market = data.get("SPX", next(iter(data.values())))
    mr = market["r"][-min(60, len(market["r"])):]
    beta_resid = {}
    relative = {}
    volstate = {}
    failure = {}
    consistency = {}
    market_m20 = float(np.mean([x["m20"] for x in data.values()]))
    for s, x in data.items():
        rr = x["r"][-len(mr):]
        mm = mr[-len(rr):]
        cov = float(np.cov(rr, mm, ddof=1)[0, 1]) if len(rr) > 3 else 0.0
        var = max(float(np.var(mm)), 1e-6)
        beta = np.clip(cov / var, -3.0, 3.0)
        residual = rr - beta * mm
        beta_resid[s] = float(np.mean(residual[-20:])) / x["v"]
        relative[s] = x["m20"] - market_m20
        # Contrarian short-horizon response, conditioned more strongly on volatility.
        vol_rank = sum(z["v"] <= x["v"] for z in data.values()) / len(data)
        volstate[s] = -x["m3"] * (0.65 + 0.70 * vol_rank)
        c = x["c"]
        failure[s] = (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / x["atr"]
        consistency[s] = x["m20"] * (0.5 + float(np.mean(x["r"][-30:] > 0))) / x["v"]
    signals = [rank(relative), rank(beta_resid), rank(volstate), rank(failure), rank(consistency)]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * signals[i].get(s, 0.5) for i in range(5)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    vols = [x["v"] for x in data.values()]
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = float(np.median(vols)) > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        vadj = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / invmean, 0.75, 1.15)
        tilt = ((1.25 if s in defensive else 0.65 if s in risky else 0.92) if stressed
                else (1.06 if s in defensive else 0.92 if s in risky else 1.0))
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * vadj) * tilt
    target = capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert all(x >= 0 for x in FACTOR_WEIGHTS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]

    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.32, 0.24, 0.16, 0.16, 0.12]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def _rank(vals):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out

def _cap(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 0.002) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum()); w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=360)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row is the in-session/current observation; use completed rows only.
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 80 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0): continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        v20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.006)
        m20 = close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0
        m30 = close[-1] / close[-31] - 1.0
        downside = np.minimum(ret[-20:], 0.0)
        down_dev = max(float(np.std(downside)) * np.sqrt(252), 0.01)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), 0.003)
        data[symbol] = {"ret": ret, "v": v20, "m20": m20, "m30": m30,
                        "downmom": m20 / down_dev, "atr": atr}
    if len(data) < 10: return

    # Cross-sectional factor calculations, all based on completed daily data.
    vols = {s: x["v"] for s, x in data.items()}
    vol_sorted = sorted(vols.values())
    def pct(v): return sum(z <= v for z in vol_sorted) / max(len(vol_sorted), 1)
    market20 = float(np.mean([x["m20"] for x in data.values()]))
    relative = {s: x["m20"] - market20 for s, x in data.items()}
    volstate = {s: -float(np.sum(x["ret"][-3:])) * (0.65 + 0.70 * pct(x["v"])) for s, x in data.items()}
    failure = {}
    consistency = {}
    # Reconstruct the two price-derived signals from fresh completed data.
    for s in list(data):
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=360).sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]; r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        failure[s] = (c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1.0) / data[s]["atr"] - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1.0) / data[s]["atr"]
        consistency[s] = data[s]["m30"] * (0.5 + float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0))) / data[s]["v"]
    signals = [_rank(relative), _rank({s: x["downmom"] for s, x in data.items()}),
               _rank(failure), _rank(volstate), _rank(consistency)]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * signals[i][s] for i in range(5)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vols.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        vol_adj = 1.0 if x is None else np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / inv_mean, 0.75, 1.15)
        regime = (1.35 if s in defensive else 0.60 if s in risky else 0.92) if stressed else (1.08 if s in defensive else 0.90 if s in risky else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * vol_adj) * regime
    target = _cap(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.30, 0.22, 0.18, 0.14, 0.11, 0.05]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_prev = None

def ranks(x):
    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in x.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid): out[s] = (i + 1) / max(len(valid), 1)
    return out

def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, .01)), .001) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum()); w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _prev
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=400)
        if df is None or len(df) < 150: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 90 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), .006)
        d = np.minimum(r[-20:], 0)
        down = max(float(np.std(d)), .005)
        data[s] = {"c":c, "r":r, "v":v, "down":down,
                   "m20":c[-1]/c[-21]-1, "m5":c[-1]/c[-6]-1,
                   "atr":max(float(np.mean((h[-10:]-l[-10:])/c[-10:])), .003)}
    if len(data) < 10: return
    # Align the cross-section using the common available trailing window.
    n = min(len(x["r"]) for x in data.values())
    series = {s:x["r"][-n:] for s,x in data.items()}
    market = series.get("SPX", next(iter(series.values())))
    market_m20 = float(np.median([x["m20"] for x in data.values()]))
    beta, resid, relative, consistency, failure, downside, dispersion_rev = ({}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {})
    disp_hist = []
    for t in range(max(60, n-140), n):
        vals = [z[t-5:t].sum() for z in series.values() if t >= 5]
        disp_hist.append(float(np.std(vals)) if vals else 0.)
    disp_now = disp_hist[-1] if disp_hist else 0.
    disp_z = (disp_now - np.mean(disp_hist[-60:])) / max(np.std(disp_hist[-60:]), 1e-6)
    disp_mult = float(np.clip(1 + .30*np.tanh(disp_z), .70, 1.30))
    for s,x in data.items():
        rr = series[s]; mm = market[-len(rr):]
        cov = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], mm[-60:], ddof=1)[0,1]) if len(rr)>60 else 0
        var = max(float(np.var(mm[-60:])), 1e-6)
        b = np.clip(cov/var, -3, 3); beta[s] = b
        resid[s] = float(np.mean((rr[-20:] - b*mm[-20:]))) / x["v"]
        relative[s] = x["m20"] - market_m20
        consistency[s] = x["m20"] * (.5 + float(np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0))) / x["v"]
        failure[s] = (x["c"][-1] / max(np.max(x["c"][-60:]),1e-12) - 1) / x["atr"]
        downside[s] = x["m20"] / (x["down"] * np.sqrt(252))
        dispersion_rev[s] = -x["m5"] / x["v"] * disp_mult
    sig = [ranks(failure), ranks(consistency), ranks(resid), ranks(relative), ranks(downside), ranks(dispersion_rev)]
    score = {s:sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i]*sig[i].get(s,.5) for i in range(6)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _prev is not None: score = {s:.8*score[s]+.2*_prev[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _prev = dict(score)
    breadth = np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()])
    stressed = np.median([x["v"] for x in data.values()]) > .015 or breadth < .40
    defensive, risky = {"XAU","US10Y","CN10Y"}, {"BTC","ETH","WTI","COPPER"}
    invmean = np.mean([1/x["v"] for x in data.values()])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x=data.get(s); vadj=1 if x is None else np.clip((1/x["v"])/invmean,.75,1.15)
        tilt = (1.25 if s in defensive else .65 if s in risky else .92) if stressed else (1.06 if s in defensive else .92 if s in risky else 1.)
        raw[s]=max(score[s],.03)*(.85+.15*vadj)*tilt
    target=cap_weights(raw)
    forecast={s:float(np.clip((score[s]-.5)*.06,-.03,.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS)-1)<1e-9

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20331223_smooth_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.32, 0.05, 0.15, 0.18, 0.18, 0.12]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_prev = None

def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1) / max(1, len(good))
    return out

def capped(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 1e-5) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(100):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - cap)); w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(np.sum(w[rest])), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _prev
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=400)
        if df is None or len(df) < 160: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df.close, float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df.high, float)[:-1]; l = np.asarray(df.low, float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 100 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), .006)
        down = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(r[-20:], 0))), .005)
        data[s] = dict(c=c, r=r, v=v, down=down,
                       m20=c[-1]/c[-21]-1, m3=c[-1]/c[-4]-1,
                       m5=c[-1]/c[-6]-1,
                       atr=max(float(np.mean((h[-10:]-l[-10:])/c[-10:])), .003))
    if len(data) < 10: return
    n = min(len(x['r']) for x in data.values())
    series = {s: x['r'][-n:] for s, x in data.items()}
    market = series.get('SPX', next(iter(series.values())))
    market_m20 = float(np.median([x['m20'] for x in data.values()]))
    rel, smooth_resid, beta_resid, vol_rev, failure, consistency = ({}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {})
    vol_state = float(np.median([x['v'] for x in data.values()]))
    for s, x in data.items():
        rr = series[s]; mm = market[-len(rr):]

    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.30, 0.22, 0.18, 0.14, 0.11, 0.05]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_prev = None

def ranks(x):
    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in x.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid): out[s] = (i + 1) / max(len(valid), 1)
    return out

def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, .01)), .001) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum()); w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _prev
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=400)
        if df is None or len(df) < 150: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 90 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), .006)
        d = np.minimum(r[-20:], 0)
        down = max(float(np.std(d)), .005)
        data[s] = {"c":c, "r":r, "v":v, "down":down,
                   "m20":c[-1]/c[-21]-1, "m5":c[-1]/c[-6]-1,
                   "atr":max(float(np.mean((h[-10:]-l[-10:])/c[-10:])), .003)}
    if len(data) < 10: return
    # Align the cross-section using the common available trailing window.
    n = min(len(x["r"]) for x in data.values())
    series = {s:x["r"][-n:] for s,x in data.items()}
    market = series.get("SPX", next(iter(series.values())))
    market_m20 = float(np.median([x["m20"] for x in data.values()]))
    beta, resid, relative, consistency, failure, downside, dispersion_rev = ({}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {})
    disp_hist = []
    for t in range(max(60, n-140), n):
        vals = [z[t-5:t].sum() for z in series.values() if t >= 5]
        disp_hist.append(float(np.std(vals)) if vals else 0.)
    disp_now = disp_hist[-1] if disp_hist else 0.
    disp_z = (disp_now - np.mean(disp_hist[-60:])) / max(np.std(disp_hist[-60:]), 1e-6)
    disp_mult = float(np.clip(1 + .30*np.tanh(disp_z), .70, 1.30))
    for s,x in data.items():
        rr = series[s]; mm = market[-len(rr):]
        cov = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], mm[-60:], ddof=1)[0,1]) if len(rr)>60 else 0
        var = max(float(np.var(mm[-60:])), 1e-6)
        b = np.clip(cov/var, -3, 3); beta[s] = b

        relative[s] = x["m20"] - market_m20
        consistency[s] = x["m20"] * (.5 + float(np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0))) / x["v"]
        failure[s] = (x["c"][-1] / max(np.max(x["c"][-60:]),1e-12) - 1) / x["atr"]
        downside[s] = x["m20"] / (x["down"] * np.sqrt(252))
        dispersion_rev[s] = -x["m5"] / x["v"] * disp_mult
    sig = [ranks(failure), ranks(consistency), ranks(resid), ranks(relative), ranks(downside), ranks(dispersion_rev)]
    score = {s:sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i]*sig[i].get(s,.5) for i in range(6)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _prev is not None: score = {s:.8*score[s]+.2*_prev[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _prev = dict(score)
    breadth = np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()])
    stressed = np.median([x["v"] for x in data.values()]) > .015 or breadth < .40
    defensive, risky = {"XAU","US10Y","CN10Y"}, {"BTC","ETH","WTI","COPPER"}
    invmean = np.mean([1/x["v"] for x in data.values()])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x=data.get(s); vadj=1 if x is None else np.clip((1/x["v"])/invmean,.75,1.15)
        tilt = (1.25 if s in defensive else .65 if s in risky else .92) if stressed else (1.06 if s in defensive else .92 if s in risky else 1.)
        raw[s]=max(score[s],.03)*(.85+.15*vadj)*tilt
    target=cap_weights(raw)
    forecast={s:float(np.clip((score[s]-.5)*.06,-.03,.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE)==15 and len(FACTOR_IDS)<=10
