import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20270812_vix_stress_reversal5",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.35, 0.15, 0.20, 0.15, 0.10, 0.05]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_prev_score = None

def cross_rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out

def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _prev_score
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=400)
        if df is None or len(df) < 160:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row may be an incomplete current session; use completed history only.
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 100 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close)) or np.any(close <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        vol = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.006)
        data[symbol] = {"c": close, "r": ret, "v": vol,
                        "m20": close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0,
                        "m3": close[-1] / close[-4] - 1.0,
                        "m30": close[-1] / close[-31] - 1.0,
                        "atr": max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), .003)}
    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    market_symbol = "SPX" if "SPX" in data else next(iter(data))
    market = data[market_symbol]["r"]
    market_m20 = float(np.median([x["m20"] for x in data.values()]))
    vol_state = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for symbol, x in data.items():
        r = x["r"]
        m = market[-len(r):]
        n = min(60, len(r), len(m))
        cov = float(np.cov(r[-n:], m[-n:], ddof=1)[0, 1]) if n > 2 else 0.0
        beta = np.clip(cov / max(float(np.var(m[-n:])), 1e-6), -3.0, 3.0)
        residual = r[-20:] - beta * m[-20:]
        # Core relative momentum and beta-residual momentum.
        signals[0][symbol] = x["m20"] - market_m20
        signals[1][symbol] = float(np.mean(residual)) / x["v"]
        # Countertrend after failed breakouts, coverage remains complete here.
        signals[2][symbol] = (x["c"][-1] / max(float(np.max(x["c"][-60:])), 1e-12) - 1.0) / x["atr"]
        # Reversal is scaled up only in elevated volatility.
        stress = np.clip(vol_state / .012, .7, 1.8)
        signals[3][symbol] = -x["m3"] / x["v"] * stress
        consistency = .5 + float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0))
        signals[4][symbol] = x["m30"] * consistency / x["v"]
        # VIX-stress proxy: short reversal conditional on cross-asset stress.
        signals[5][symbol] = -x["m3"] / x["v"] * max(1.0, vol_state / .015)
    ranks = [cross_rank(s) for s in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(len(ranks))) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _prev_score is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _prev_score[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _prev_score = dict(score)
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = vol_state > .015 or breadth < .40
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(symbol)
        if x is None:
            raw[symbol] = .01
            continue
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / x["v"]) / inv_mean, .75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.25 if symbol in defensive else .65 if symbol in risky else .92) if stressed else (1.06 if symbol in defensive else .92 if symbol in risky else 1.0)
        raw[symbol] = max(score[symbol], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj) * tilt
    target = cap_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert all(w >= 0 for w in FACTOR_WEIGHTS)

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20331223_smooth_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.32, 0.05, 0.15, 0.18, 0.18, 0.12]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_prev = None

def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1) / max(1, len(good))
    return out

def capped(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 1e-5) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(100):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - cap)); w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(np.sum(w[rest])), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _prev
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=400)
        if df is None or len(df) < 160: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df.close, float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df.high, float)[:-1]; l = np.asarray(df.low, float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 100 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        v = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), .006)
        down = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(r[-20:], 0))), .005)
        data[s] = dict(c=c, r=r, v=v, down=down,
                       m20=c[-1]/c[-21]-1, m3=c[-1]/c[-4]-1,
                       m5=c[-1]/c[-6]-1,
                       atr=max(float(np.mean((h[-10:]-l[-10:])/c[-10:])), .003))
    if len(data) < 10: return
    n = min(len(x['r']) for x in data.values())
    series = {s: x['r'][-n:] for s, x in data.items()}
    market = series.get('SPX', next(iter(series.values())))
    market_m20 = float(np.median([x['m20'] for x in data.values()]))
    rel, smooth_resid, beta_resid, vol_rev, failure, consistency = ({}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {})
    vol_state = float(np.median([x['v'] for x in data.values()]))
    for s, x in data.items():
        rr = series[s]; mm = market[-len(rr):]
        cov = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], mm[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1]) if len(rr) > 60 else 0.
        beta = np.clip(cov / max(float(np.var(mm[-60:])), 1e-6), -3, 3)
        resid20 = float(np.mean(rr[-20:] - beta * mm[-20:])) / x['v']
        resid5 = float(np.mean(rr[-5:] - beta * mm[-5:])) / x['v']
        rel[s] = x['m20'] - market_m20
        beta_resid[s] = resid20
        smooth_resid[s] = (0.65 * resid20 + 0.35 * resid5)
        # Volatility-state reversal: short-term reversal is more influential in stress.
        vol_rev[s] = -x['m3'] / x['v'] * np.clip(vol_state / .012, .7, 1.8)
        failure[s] = (x['c'][-1] / max(np.max(x['c'][-60:]), 1e-12) - 1) / x['atr']
        consistency[s] = x['m20'] * (.5 + float(np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0))) / x['v']
    sig = [rank(rel), rank(smooth_resid), rank(beta_resid), rank(vol_rev), rank(failure), rank(consistency)]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * sig[i][s] for i in range(6)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _prev is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _prev[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _prev = dict(score)
    breadth = np.mean([x['m20'] > 0 for x in data.values()])
    stressed = vol_state > .015 or breadth < .40
    defensive, risky = {'XAU', 'US10Y', 'CN10Y'}, {'BTC', 'ETH', 'WTI', 'COPPER'}
    invmean = np.mean([1 / x['v'] for x in data.values()])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s); vadj = 1. if x is None else np.clip((1/x['v'])/invmean, .75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.25 if s in defensive else .65 if s in risky else .92) if stressed else (1.06 if s in defensive else .92 if s in risky else 1.)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vadj) * tilt
    target = capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1) < 1e-9
assert all(x >= 0 for x in FACTOR_WEIGHTS)
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]

    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.39, 0.17, 0.15, 0.16, 0.13]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_prev_score = None


def ranks(signal):
    valid = sorted((s, v) for s, v in signal.items() if np.isfinite(v))

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.42, 0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.10]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(values):
    finite = [(s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v)]
    finite.sort(key=lambda z: z[1])
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    n = len(finite)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(finite):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(n, 1)
    return out


def _cap_normalize(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-6)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return

    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=400)
        if df is None or len(df) < 160:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Lag one completed row: no current-day or future information.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        hi = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        lo = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 80 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        vol = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), 0.006)
        data[s] = {"c": c, "r": r, "vol": vol,
                   "m20": c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0,
                   "m30": c[-1] / c[-31] - 1.0,
                   "m3": c[-1] / c[-4] - 1.0,
                   "atr": max(float(np.mean((hi[-10:] - lo[-10:]) / c[-10:])), .003)}
    if len(data) < 10:
        return

    market = data.get("SPX", next(iter(data.values())))
    mr = market["r"]
    med_m20 = float(np.median([x["m20"] for x in data.values()]))
    med_vol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, x in data.items():
        n = min(60, len(x["r"]), len(mr))
        a, b = x["r"][-n:], mr[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(b), 1e-6)) if n > 2 else 0.0
        beta = float(np.clip(beta, -3, 3))
        resid = x["r"][-20:] - beta * mr[-20:]
        consistency = float(np.mean(x["r"][-30:] > 0))
        # Positive direction is applied exactly as specified by the ensemble.
        signals[0][s] = x["m20"] - med_m20
        signals[1][s] = float(np.mean(resid)) / x["vol"]
        signals[2][s] = (x["c"][-1] / max(np.max(x["c"][-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / x["atr"]
        stress = np.clip(med_vol / .012, .7, 1.8)
        signals[3][s] = -x["m3"] / x["vol"] * stress
        signals[4][s] = x["m30"] * (.5 + consistency) / x["vol"]

    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(5)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = med_vol > .015 or breadth < .40
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        if x is None:
            raw[s] = .01
            continue
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / x["vol"]) / inv_mean, .75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.25 if s in defensive else .65 if s in risky else .92) if stressed else (1.06 if s in defensive else .92 if s in risky else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj) * tilt
    target = _cap_normalize(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(set(UNIVERSE)) == 15
assert len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == len(FACTOR_DIRECTIONS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.42, 0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.10]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(values):
    finite = [(s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v)]
    finite.sort(key=lambda z: z[1])
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    n = len(finite)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(finite):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(n, 1)
    return out


def _cap_normalize(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-6)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE:
        return

    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=400)
        if df is None or len(df) < 160:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Lag one completed row: no current-day or future information.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        hi = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        lo = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 80 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        vol = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), 0.006)
        data[s] = {"c": c, "r": r, "vol": vol,
                   "m20": c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0,
                   "m30": c[-1] / c[-31] - 1.0,
                   "m3": c[-1] / c[-4] - 1.0,
                   "atr": max(float(np.mean((hi[-10:] - lo[-10:]) / c[-10:])), .003)}
    if len(data) < 10:
        return

    market = data.get("SPX", next(iter(data.values())))
    mr = market["r"]
    med_m20 = float(np.median([x["m20"] for x in data.values()]))
    med_vol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, x in data.items():
        n = min(60, len(x["r"]), len(mr))
        a, b = x["r"][-n:], mr[-n:]
        beta = float(np.cov(a, b, ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(b), 1e-6)) if n > 2 else 0.0
        beta = float(np.clip(beta, -3, 3))
        resid = x["r"][-20:] - beta * mr[-20:]
        consistency = float(np.mean(x["r"][-30:] > 0))
        # Positive direction is applied exactly as specified by the ensemble.
        signals[0][s] = x["m20"] - med_m20
        signals[1][s] = float(np.mean(resid)) / x["vol"]
        signals[2][s] = (x["c"][-1] / max(np.max(x["c"][-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / x["atr"]
        stress = np.clip(med_vol / .012, .7, 1.8)
        signals[3][s] = -x["m3"] / x["vol"] * stress
        signals[4][s] = x["m30"] * (.5 + consistency) / x["vol"]

    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(5)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = med_vol > .015 or breadth < .40
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        if x is None:
            raw[s] = .01
            continue
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / x["vol"]) / inv_mean, .75, 1.15)
        tilt = (1.25 if s in defensive else .65 if s in risky else .92) if stressed else (1.06 if s in defensive else .92 if s in risky else 1.0)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj) * tilt
    target = _cap_normalize(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(set(UNIVERSE)) == 15
assert len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == len(FACTOR_DIRECTIONS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.46, 0.24, 0.17, 0.13]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def _weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(40):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=220)
        if df is None or len(df) < 80:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]  # completed sessions only
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 65 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close[-65:])) or np.any(close[-65:] <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.004)
        vol10 = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), 0.004)
        data[symbol] = {
            "m20": close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0,
            "m3": close[-1] / close[-4] - 1.0,
            "vol20": vol20,
            "atr10": vol10,
            "fail20": close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), close[-1]) - 1.0,
            "fail60": close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-60:]), close[-1]) - 1.0,
        }
    if len(data) < 10:
        return

    # The persisted factors are rank-combined; cross-sectional constants do not
    # affect ranks, while the dispersion multiplier is common to the cross-section.
    dispersion = max(float(np.std([x["m20"] for x in data.values()])), 0.001)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for symbol, x in data.items():
        signals[0][symbol] = x["m20"]
        signals[1][symbol] = (x["fail60"] - x["fail20"]) / x["atr10"]
        signals[2][symbol] = (-x["m3"] / x["vol20"]) * np.clip(1.0 + 0.35 * np.tanh(dispersion / 0.03), 0.65, 1.35)
        signals[3][symbol] = -x["m3"] / x["vol20"]
    ranks = [_rank(signal) for signal in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(4)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol20"] for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol20"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(symbol)
        base = max(score[symbol], 0.03)
        if x is not None:
            base *= 0.85 + 0.15 * np.clip((1.0 / x["vol20"]) / mean_invvol, 0.75, 1.15)
        if stressed:
            base *= 1.25 if symbol in defensive else 0.65 if symbol in risky else 0.92
        raw[symbol] = base
    target = _weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(set(UNIVERSE)) == 15
assert len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == len(FACTOR_DIRECTIONS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

# Directions are all positive and preserved in the factor rank composite.
assert all(direction == 1 for direction in FACTOR_DIRECTIONS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.55, 0.20, 0.15, 0.10]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def _weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(40):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=220)
        if df is None or len(df) < 80:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 65 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close[-65:])) or np.any(close[-65:] <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.004)
        atr10 = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), 0.004)
        data[symbol] = {
            "m20": close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0,
            "m3": close[-1] / close[-4] - 1.0,
            "vol20": vol20,
            "atr10": atr10,
            "fail20": close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), close[-1]) - 1.0,
            "fail60": close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-60:]), close[-1]) - 1.0,
        }
    if len(data) < 10:
        return

    dispersion = max(float(np.std([x["m20"] for x in data.values()])), 0.001)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for symbol, x in data.items():
        signals[0][symbol] = x["m20"]
        signals[1][symbol] = (x["fail60"] - x["fail20"]) / x["atr10"]
        reversal = (-x["m3"] / x["vol20"])
        signals[2][symbol] = reversal * np.clip(1.0 + 0.35 * np.tanh(dispersion / 0.03), 0.65, 1.35)
        signals[3][symbol] = reversal
    ranks = [_rank(signal) for signal in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(4)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol20"] for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = median_vol > 0.015 or breadth < 0.40
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    mean_invvol = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol20"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(symbol)
        base = max(score[symbol], 0.03)
        if x is not None:
            base *= 0.85 + 0.15 * np.clip((1.0 / x["vol20"]) / mean_invvol, 0.75, 1.15)
        if stressed:
            base *= 1.25 if symbol in defensive else 0.65 if symbol in risky else 0.92
        raw[symbol] = base
    target = _weights(raw)
    # Deterministic 10-session forecast metadata for the migration-cost gate.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(set(UNIVERSE)) == 15
assert len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == len(FACTOR_DIRECTIONS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}
assert all(direction == 1 for direction in FACTOR_DIRECTIONS)
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.55, 0.20, 0.15, 0.10]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_signal(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(n, 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=220)
        if df is None or len(df) < 80:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.45, 0.25, 0.15, 0.15]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_signal(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=220)
        if df is None or len(df) < 80:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row is not used: decisions only see the last completed session.
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 65 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close[-65:])) or np.any(close[-65:] <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.004)
        vol30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr10 = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), 0.004)
        data[symbol] = {
            "m20": close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0,
            "m30": close[-1] / close[-31] - 1.0,
            "vol20": vol20,
            "vol30": vol30,
            "atr10": atr10,
            "fail20": close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), close[-1]) - 1.0,
            "fail60": close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-60:]), close[-1]) - 1.0,
            "r1": ret[-1],
        }
    if len(data) < 10:
        return

    # Lagged cross-sectional proxies for the four persisted factor definitions.
    signals = [{}, {}, {}, {}]
    for s, x in data.items():
        signals[0][s] = x["m20"]
        signals[1][s] = (0.6 * x["m30"] + 0.4 * x["m20"]) / x["vol30"]
        signals[2][s] = (x["fail60"] - x["fail20"]) / x["atr10"]
        signals[3][s] = -x["r1"] / x["vol20"]
    ranks = [rank_signal(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(4)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol20"] for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invvol_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol20"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        base = max(score[s], 0.03)
        if x is not None:
            # Inverse-volatility sizing, with a deliberately modest adjustment.
            base *= 0.85 + 0.15 * np.clip((1.0 / x["vol20"]) / invvol_mean, 0.75, 1.15)
        if stressed:
            base *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
        raw[s] = base
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(set(UNIVERSE)) == 15
assert len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == len(FACTOR_DIRECTIONS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}
assert all(direction == 1 for direction in FACTOR_DIRECTIONS)

def rank_signal(values):

    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(n, 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])

    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():

        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)

    if len(data) < 10:

        signals[2][s] = (x["fail60"] - x["fail20"]) / x["atr10"]
        signals[3][s] = -x["r1"] / x["vol20"]
    ranks = [rank_signal(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(4)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}

    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol20"] for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invvol_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol20"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:

        if stressed:

        raw[s] = base
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    # Deterministic 10-session forecast metadata required by migration-cost gate.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.40, 0.28, 0.17, 0.15]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_signal(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=220)
        if df is None or len(df) < 80:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Exclude the current/incomplete row; only completed sessions are visible.
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 65 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close[-65:])) or np.any(close[-65:] <= 0):
            continue
        ret = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.004)
        vol30 = max(float(np.std(ret[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr10 = max(float(np.mean((high[-10:] - low[-10:]) / close[-10:])), 0.004)
        data[symbol] = {
            "m20": close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0,
            "m30": close[-1] / close[-31] - 1.0,
            "vol20": vol20,
            "vol30": vol30,
            "atr10": atr10,
            "fail20": close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), close[-1]) - 1.0,
            "fail60": close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-60:]), close[-1]) - 1.0,
            "r1": ret[-1],
        }
    if len(data) < 10:
        return

    # Transparent lagged proxies for the persisted ensemble, ranked cross-sectionally.
    signals = [{}, {}, {}, {}]
    for s, x in data.items():
        signals[0][s] = x["m20"]
        signals[1][s] = (0.6 * x["m30"] + 0.4 * x["m20"]) / x["vol30"]
        signals[2][s] = (x["fail60"] - x["fail20"]) / x["atr10"]
        signals[3][s] = -x["r1"] / x["vol20"]
    ranks = [rank_signal(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(4)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([x["m20"] > 0 for x in data.values()]))
    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol20"] for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invvol_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol20"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        base = max(score[s], 0.03)
        if x is not None:
            base *= 0.85 + 0.15 * np.clip((1.0 / x["vol20"]) / invvol_mean, 0.75, 1.15)
        if stressed:
            base *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
        raw[s] = base
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    # Fixed 10-session deterministic forecast metadata for the migration-cost gate.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(set(UNIVERSE)) == 15
assert len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == len(FACTOR_DIRECTIONS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}
assert all(direction == 1 for direction in FACTOR_DIRECTIONS)

    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):

        signals[3][s] = -x["r1"] / x["vol20"]
    ranks = [rank_signal(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(4)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:

    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invvol_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol20"] for x in data.values()]))

    target = capped_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.35, 0.20, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_signal(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return
    series = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=230)
        if df is None or len(df) < 130: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        series[symbol] = (c, h, l, r)
    if len(series) < 10: return
    # Equal-weight benchmark used only as a contemporaneous, lagged reference.
    n = min(len(v[3]) for v in series.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([v[3][-n:] for v in series.values()]), axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in series.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        vol30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr20 = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        # all quantities use data through the last completed session
        rel = (c[-1] / c[-21] - 1) - (np.prod(1 + bench[-20:]) - 1)
        high120 = np.max(c[-120:])
        breakout = (c[-1] / high120 - 1) / atr20
        x, y = rr[-60:], bench[-60:]
        beta = float(np.cov(x, y, ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(y, ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual = float(np.sum(x[-20:] - beta * y[-20:]))
        consistency = (c[-1] / c[-31] - 1) * (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0)) / vol20
        # medium-term pressure minus short-term pressure (ATR-normalized)
        fail = ((c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1) - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1)) / atr20
        signals[0][s], signals[1][s], signals[2][s] = rel, breakout, residual
        signals[3][s], signals[4][s] = consistency, fail
    ranks = [rank_signal(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(5)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    breadth = float(np.mean([v[0][-1] > v[0][-21] for v in series.values()]))
    median_vol = float(np.median([max(np.std(v[3][-20:]), 0.004) for v in series.values()]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = np.mean([1 / max(np.std(v[3][-20:]), .004) for v in series.values()])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        base = max(score[s], .03)
        vol = max(np.std(series[s][3][-20:]), .004) if s in series else .015
        base *= .85 + .15 * np.clip((1 / vol) / invmean, .75, 1.15)
        if stressed: base *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else .92)
        raw[s] = base
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(set(UNIVERSE)) == 15
assert len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == len(FACTOR_DIRECTIONS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}
assert all(d == 1 for d in FACTOR_DIRECTIONS)

    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):

    for _ in range(50):

        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():

            "atr10": atr10,
            "fail20": close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), close[-1]) - 1.0,
            "fail60": close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-60:]), close[-1]) - 1.0,
            "r1": ret[-1],
        }
    if len(data) < 10:
        return

    # Transparent lagged proxies for the persisted ensemble, ranked cross-sectionally.
    signals = [{}, {}, {}, {}]
    for s, x in data.items():
        signals[0][s] = x["m20"]
        signals[1][s] = (0.6 * x["m30"] + 0.4 * x["m20"]) / x["vol30"]
        signals[2][s] = (x["fail60"] - x["fail20"]) / x["atr10"]
        signals[3][s] = -x["r1"] / x["vol20"]
    ranks = [rank_signal(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(4)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    median_vol = float(np.median([x["vol20"] for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invvol_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / x["vol20"] for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        x = data.get(s)
        base = max(score[s], 0.03)
        if x is not None:
            base *= 0.85 + 0.15 * np.clip((1.0 / x["vol20"]) / invvol_mean, 0.75, 1.15)
        if stressed:
            base *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
        raw[s] = base
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    # Fixed 10-session deterministic forecast metadata for the migration-cost gate.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact current Screener ensemble (five active factors, all higher-is-better).
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.30, 0.25, 0.20, 0.15, 0.10]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.24, 0.22, 0.20, 0.14, 0.12, 0.08]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_signal(values):
    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(valid), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    series = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=230)
        if df is None or len(df) < 130:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Last bar may be incomplete; decisions use only completed observations.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        series[symbol] = (c, h, l, r)
    if len(series) < 10:
        return

    n = min(len(v[3]) for v in series.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([v[3][-n:] for v in series.values()]), axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in series.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        atr20 = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        rel20 = (c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0) - (np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
        # Volatility-state short-term reversal, scaled to avoid noisy extremes.
        volstate_rev = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol20
        consistency = (c[-1] / c[-31] - 1.0) * (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0)) / vol20
        fail = ((c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1.0) - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1.0)) / atr20
        x, y = rr[-60:], bench[-60:]
        beta = float(np.cov(x, y, ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(y, ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual = float(np.sum(x[-20:] - beta * y[-20:]))
        lowvol_rev = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20
        signals[0][s], signals[1][s], signals[2][s] = volstate_rev, consistency, fail
        signals[3][s], signals[4][s], signals[5][s] = residual, lowvol_rev, rel20

    ranks = [rank_signal(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(6)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([v[0][-1] > v[0][-21] for v in series.values()]))
    median_vol = float(np.median([max(np.std(v[3][-20:]), 0.004) for v in series.values()]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = np.mean([1.0 / max(np.std(v[3][-20:]), .004) for v in series.values()])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        base = max(score.get(s, .5), .03)
        vol = max(np.std(series[s][3][-20:]), .004) if s in series else .015
        base *= .85 + .15 * np.clip((1.0 / vol) / invmean, .75, 1.15)
        if stressed:
            base *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else .92)
        raw[s] = base
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(set(UNIVERSE)) == 15
assert len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == len(FACTOR_DIRECTIONS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}
assert all(d == 1 for d in FACTOR_DIRECTIONS)

    if _previous is not None:

    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = np.mean([1 / max(np.std(v[3][-20:]), .004) for v in series.values()])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:

        vol = max(np.std(series[s][3][-20:]), .004) if s in series else .015
        base *= .85 + .15 * np.clip((1 / vol) / invmean, .75, 1.15)

        raw[s] = base
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    # Deterministic 10-session edge forecast is required by the migration gate.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.24, 0.22, 0.20, 0.14, 0.12, 0.08]
FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_signal(values):
    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(valid), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    series = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=230)
        if df is None or len(df) < 130:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Last bar may be incomplete; decisions use only completed observations.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        series[symbol] = (c, h, l, r)
    if len(series) < 10:
        return

    n = min(len(v[3]) for v in series.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([v[3][-n:] for v in series.values()]), axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in series.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        atr20 = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        rel20 = (c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0) - (np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
        # Volatility-state short-term reversal, scaled to avoid noisy extremes.
        volstate_rev = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol20
        consistency = (c[-1] / c[-31] - 1.0) * (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0)) / vol20
        fail = ((c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1.0) - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1.0)) / atr20
        x, y = rr[-60:], bench[-60:]
        beta = float(np.cov(x, y, ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(y, ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual = float(np.sum(x[-20:] - beta * y[-20:]))
        lowvol_rev = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20
        signals[0][s], signals[1][s], signals[2][s] = volstate_rev, consistency, fail
        signals[3][s], signals[4][s], signals[5][s] = residual, lowvol_rev, rel20

    ranks = [rank_signal(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(6)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([v[0][-1] > v[0][-21] for v in series.values()]))
    median_vol = float(np.median([max(np.std(v[3][-20:]), 0.004) for v in series.values()]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = np.mean([1.0 / max(np.std(v[3][-20:]), .004) for v in series.values()])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        base = max(score.get(s, .5), .03)
        vol = max(np.std(series[s][3][-20:]), .004) if s in series else .015
        base *= .85 + .15 * np.clip((1.0 / vol) / invmean, .75, 1.15)
        if stressed:
            base *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else .92)
        raw[s] = base
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(set(UNIVERSE)) == 15
assert len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == len(FACTOR_DIRECTIONS) <= 10
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}
assert all(d == 1 for d in FACTOR_DIRECTIONS)
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20270729_volume_confirmed_reversal",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.23, 0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.07, 0.06, 0.04]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_signal(values):
    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(valid), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(60):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any(): w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return
    series = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:

FACTOR_DIRECTIONS = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_signal(values):
    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(valid), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():

        x, y = rr[-60:], bench[-60:]
        beta = float(np.cov(x, y, ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(y, ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual = float(np.sum(x[-20:] - beta * y[-20:]))
        lowvol_rev = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20270729_volume_confirmed_reversal",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.23, 0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.07, 0.06, 0.04]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_signal(values):
    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(valid), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(60):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any(): w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return
    series = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=240)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        v = np.asarray(df["volume"], float)[:-1] if "volume" in df else np.ones(len(c))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        series[symbol] = (c, h, l, v, r)
    if len(series) < 10: return
    n = min(len(x[4]) for x in series.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x[4][-n:] for x in series.values()]), axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, v, r) in series.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), .004)
        atr20 = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), .004)
        volstate = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol20
        fail = ((c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1.) - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1.)) / atr20
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        lowvol = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20
        consistency = (c[-1] / c[-31] - 1.) * (.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0)) / vol20
        volume_ratio = float(v[-1] / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-12))
        volume_rev = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20 * np.clip(volume_ratio, .5, 2.0)
        rel_strength = (c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.) - (np.prod(1. + bench[-20:]) - 1.)
        rel_momentum = (c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.)
        sig[0][s], sig[1][s], sig[2][s], sig[3][s] = volstate, fail, residual, lowvol
        sig[4][s], sig[5][s], sig[6][s], sig[7][s] = consistency, volume_rev, rel_strength, rel_momentum
    ranks = [rank_signal(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(8)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    breadth = float(np.mean([x[0][-1] > x[0][-21] for x in series.values()]))
    medvol = float(np.median([max(np.std(x[4][-20:]), .004) for x in series.values()]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or medvol > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = np.mean([1. / max(np.std(x[4][-20:]), .004) for x in series.values()])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol = max(np.std(series[s][4][-20:]), .004)
        base = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * np.clip((1. / vol) / invmean, .75, 1.15))
        if stressed: base *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (.65 if s in risky else .92)
        raw[s] = base
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 8
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_2_20341124_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_1_20270729_volume_confirmed_reversal",
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.20, 0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.12, 0.11, 0.07, 0.05, 0.03]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def ranks(values):
    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(valid), 1)
    return out


def capped(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        v = np.asarray(df["volume"], float)[:-1] if "volume" in df else np.ones(len(c))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, v, c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return
    n = min(len(x[4]) for x in data.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x[4][-n:] for x in data.values()]), axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, v, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), .004)
        vol30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), .004)
        atr20 = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), .004)
        sig[0][s] = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol20
        sig[1][s] = ((c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1.) - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1.)) / atr20
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        sig[2][s] = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        sig[3][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.
        sig[4][s] = (ret20 - ret60 / 3.) / (vol30 * np.sqrt(20.))
        sig[5][s] = (c[-1] / c[-31] - 1.) * (.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0)) / vol30
        sig[6][s] = ret20 - (np.prod(1. + bench[-20:]) - 1.)
        ratio = float(v[-1] / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-12))
        sig[7][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20 * np.clip(ratio, .5, 2.)
        sig[8][s] = ret20
    rk = [ranks(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * rk[i][s] for i in range(9)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    breadth = float(np.mean([x[0][-1] > x[0][-21] for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or np.median([max(np.std(x[4][-20:]), .004) for x in data.values()]) > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = np.mean([1. / max(np.std(x[4][-20:]), .004) for x in data.values()])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol = max(np.std(data[s][4][-20:]), .004)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * np.clip((1. / vol) / invmean, .75, 1.15))
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (.65 if s in risky else .92)
    target = capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 9
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.) < 1e-9

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20270729_volume_confirmed_reversal",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20320624_relative_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.23, 0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.07, 0.06, 0.04]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_signal(values):
    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(valid), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(60):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any(): w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return
    series = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=240)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        v = np.asarray(df["volume"], float)[:-1] if "volume" in df else np.ones(len(c))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        series[symbol] = (c, h, l, v, r)
    if len(series) < 10: return
    n = min(len(x[4]) for x in series.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x[4][-n:] for x in series.values()]), axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, v, r) in series.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), .004)
        atr20 = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), .004)
        volstate = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol20
        fail = ((c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1.) - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1.)) / atr20
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        lowvol = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20
        consistency = (c[-1] / c[-31] - 1.) * (.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0)) / vol20
        volume_ratio = float(v[-1] / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-12))
        volume_rev = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20 * np.clip(volume_ratio, .5, 2.0)
        rel_strength = (c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.) - (np.prod(1. + bench[-20:]) - 1.)
        rel_momentum = (c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.)
        sig[0][s], sig[1][s], sig[2][s], sig[3][s] = volstate, fail, residual, lowvol
        sig[4][s], sig[5][s], sig[6][s], sig[7][s] = consistency, volume_rev, rel_strength, rel_momentum
    ranks = [rank_signal(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(8)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    breadth = float(np.mean([x[0][-1] > x[0][-21] for x in series.values()]))
    medvol = float(np.median([max(np.std(x[4][-20:]), .004) for x in series.values()]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or medvol > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = np.mean([1. / max(np.std(x[4][-20:]), .004) for x in series.values()])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol = max(np.std(series[s][4][-20:]), .004)
        base = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * np.clip((1. / vol) / invmean, .75, 1.15))
        if stressed: base *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (.65 if s in risky else .92)
        raw[s] = base
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 8
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}
"}
