import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20341124_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_1_20270729_volume_confirmed_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.14, 0.10, 0.08, 0.05, 0.03]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw[s]), 1e-10) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row is the current, not-yet-completed session.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        v = np.asarray(df["volume"], float)[:-1] if "volume" in df else np.ones(len(c))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        data[symbol] = (c, h, l, v, r)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(x[4]) for x in data.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x[4][-n:] for x in data.values()]), axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, v, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        vol30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr20 = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret20, ret60 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0, c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        # Signals correspond in order to the persisted Screener ensemble.
        accel = (ret20 - ret60 / 3.0) / (vol30 * np.sqrt(20.0))
        sig[0][s] = accel
        sig[1][s] = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        sig[2][s] = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol20
        sig[3][s] = (ret20 * (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0))) / vol30
        sig[4][s] = accel
        sig[5][s] = ((c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1.0) - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1.0)) / atr20
        sig[6][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20
        sig[7][s] = ret20 - (np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
        volume_ratio = float(v[-1] / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-12))
        sig[8][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20 * np.clip(volume_ratio, 0.5, 2.0)

    ranks = [rank(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(9)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([x[0][-1] > x[0][-21] for x in data.values()]))
    median_vol = float(np.median([max(np.std(x[4][-20:]), 0.004) for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = float(np.mean([1.0 / max(np.std(x[4][-20:]), 0.004) for x in data.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol = max(float(np.std(data[s][4][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else median_vol
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * np.clip((1.0 / vol) / invmean, 0.75, 1.15))
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
    target = cap_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 9
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

        sig[6][s] = ret20 - (np.prod(1. + bench[-20:]) - 1.)
        ratio = float(v[-1] / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-12))
        sig[7][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20 * np.clip(ratio, .5, 2.)
        sig[8][s] = ret20
    rk = [ranks(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * rk[i][s] for i in range(9)) for s in UNIVERSE}

    _previous = dict(score)

    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = np.mean([1. / max(np.std(x[4][-20:]), .004) for x in data.values()])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:

    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import json
import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact current Screener ensemble (all directions positive).
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20341124_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_1_20270729_volume_confirmed_reversal",
    "miner_1_20341222_range_weighted_candle_reversal3",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.20, 0.16, 0.14, 0.13, 0.12, 0.10, 0.06, 0.05, 0.02, 0.02]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1.0)), 1e-10) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(40):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum()); w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        v = np.asarray(df["volume"], float)[:-1] if "volume" in df else np.ones(len(c))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0): continue
        data[symbol] = (c, h, l, v, c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8: return
    n = min(len(x[4]) for x in data.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x[4][-n:] for x in data.values()]), axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, v, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]; vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        vol30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr20 = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret20, ret60 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0, c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        accel = (ret20 - ret60 / 3.0) / (vol30 * np.sqrt(20.0))
        sig[0][s] = accel
        sig[1][s] = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        sig[2][s] = (ret20 - ret60 / 3.0) / (vol30 * np.sqrt(20.0))
        sig[3][s] = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol20
        sig[4][s] = (ret20 * (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0))) / vol30

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20341124_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",

    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_1_20270729_volume_confirmed_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.14, 0.10, 0.08, 0.05, 0.03]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw[s]), 1e-10) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row is the current, not-yet-completed session.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        v = np.asarray(df["volume"], float)[:-1] if "volume" in df else np.ones(len(c))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        data[symbol] = (c, h, l, v, r)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(x[4]) for x in data.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x[4][-n:] for x in data.values()]), axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, v, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        vol30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr20 = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret20, ret60 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0, c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        # Signals correspond in order to the persisted Screener ensemble.
        accel = (ret20 - ret60 / 3.0) / (vol30 * np.sqrt(20.0))
        sig[0][s] = accel
        sig[1][s] = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        sig[2][s] = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol20
        sig[3][s] = (ret20 * (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0))) / vol30
        sig[4][s] = accel
        sig[5][s] = ((c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1.0) - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1.0)) / atr20
        sig[6][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20
        sig[7][s] = ret20 - (np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
        volume_ratio = float(v[-1] / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-12))
        sig[8][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20 * np.clip(volume_ratio, 0.5, 2.0)

    ranks = [rank(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(9)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20341124_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_1_20270729_volume_confirmed_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.20408163, 0.16326531, 0.13265306, 0.12244898, 0.14285714, 0.10204082, 0.06122449, 0.05102041, 0.02040816]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1.0)), 1e-10) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        v = np.asarray(df["volume"], float)[:-1] if "volume" in df else np.ones(len(c))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[symbol] = (c, h, l, v, c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return
    n = min(len(x[4]) for x in data.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x[4][-n:] for x in data.values()]), axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, v, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        vol30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr20 = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret20, ret60 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0, c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        accel = (ret20 - ret60 / 3.0) / (vol30 * np.sqrt(20.0))
        sig[0][s] = accel
        sig[1][s] = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        sig[2][s] = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol20
        sig[3][s] = (ret20 * (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0))) / vol30
        sig[4][s] = accel
        sig[5][s] = ((c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1.0) - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1.0)) / atr20
        sig[6][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20
        sig[7][s] = ret20 - (np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
        volume_ratio = float(v[-1] / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-12))
        sig[8][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20 * np.clip(volume_ratio, 0.5, 2.0)
    ranks = [rank(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(len(FACTOR_IDS))) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    breadth = float(np.mean([x[0][-1] > x[0][-21] for x in data.values()]))

]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.20, 0.16, 0.14, 0.13, 0.12, 0.10, 0.06, 0.05, 0.02, 0.02]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1.0)), 1e-10) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(40):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum()); w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        v = np.asarray(df["volume"], float)[:-1] if "volume" in df else np.ones(len(c))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0): continue
        data[symbol] = (c, h, l, v, c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8: return
    n = min(len(x[4]) for x in data.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x[4][-n:] for x in data.values()]), axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]

        vol30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr20 = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret20, ret60 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0, c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        accel = (ret20 - ret60 / 3.0) / (vol30 * np.sqrt(20.0))
        sig[0][s] = accel
        sig[1][s] = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        sig[2][s] = (ret20 - ret60 / 3.0) / (vol30 * np.sqrt(20.0))
        sig[3][s] = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol20
        sig[4][s] = (ret20 * (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0))) / vol30
        sig[5][s] = ((c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1.0) - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1.0)) / atr20
        sig[6][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20
        sig[7][s] = ret20 - (np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
        vr = float(v[-1] / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-12))
        sig[8][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20 * np.clip(vr, 0.5, 2.0)
        # Range-weighted candle pressure: close location, scaled by recent range.
        candle = (2.0 * c[-1] - h[-1] - l[-1]) / max(h[-1] - l[-1], 1e-12)
        sig[9][s] = candle / atr20
    ranks = [rank(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(10)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    breadth = float(np.mean([x[0][-1] > x[0][-21] for x in data.values()]))

    invmean = float(np.mean([1.0 / z for z in vols])); raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:

        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * np.clip((1.0 / vol) / invmean, 0.75, 1.15))
        if stressed: raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
    target = cap_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20341124_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_1_20270729_volume_confirmed_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.20, 0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.13, 0.10, 0.05, 0.04]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def cross_rank(values):
    finite = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(finite):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(finite), 1)
    return out


def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1.0)), 1e-10) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        v = np.asarray(df["volume"], float)[:-1] if "volume" in df else np.ones(len(c))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[symbol] = (c, h, l, v, c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(x[4]) for x in data.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x[4][-n:] for x in data.values()]), axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, v, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        vol30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr20 = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        accel = (ret20 - ret60 / 3.0) / (vol30 * np.sqrt(20.0))
        signals[0][s] = accel
        # Smoothed confirmation avoids making the second acceleration factor identical.
        accel10 = (c[-1] / c[-11] - 1.0 - (c[-1] / c[-31] - 1.0) / 3.0) / (vol20 * np.sqrt(10.0))
        signals[1][s] = 0.6 * accel + 0.4 * accel10
        signals[2][s] = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        signals[3][s] = (ret20 * (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0))) / vol30
        signals[4][s] = ((c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1.0) - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1.0)) / atr20
        signals[5][s] = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol20
        bench20 = np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0
        signals[6][s] = ret20 - bench20
        volume_ratio = float(v[-1] / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-12))
        signals[7][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20 * np.clip(volume_ratio, 0.5, 2.0)

    ranks = [cross_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(len(FACTOR_IDS))) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([x[0][-1] > x[0][-21] for x in data.values()]))
    vols = [max(float(np.std(x[4][-20:])), 0.004) for x in data.values()]
    median_vol = float(np.median(vols))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = float(np.mean([1.0 / z for z in vols]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol = max(float(np.std(data[s][4][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else median_vol
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * np.clip((1.0 / vol) / invmean, 0.75, 1.15))
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
    target = cap_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 8
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-6
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20341124_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_1_20270729_volume_confirmed_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.20408163, 0.16326531, 0.13265306, 0.12244898, 0.14285714, 0.10204082, 0.06122449, 0.05102041, 0.02040816]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1.0)), 1e-10) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        v = np.asarray(df["volume"], float)[:-1] if "volume" in df else np.ones(len(c))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[symbol] = (c, h, l, v, c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return
    n = min(len(x[4]) for x in data.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x[4][-n:] for x in data.values()]), axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, v, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        vol30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr20 = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret20, ret60 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0, c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        accel = (ret20 - ret60 / 3.0) / (vol30 * np.sqrt(20.0))
        sig[0][s] = accel
        sig[1][s] = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        sig[2][s] = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol20
        sig[3][s] = (ret20 * (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0))) / vol30
        sig[4][s] = accel
        sig[5][s] = ((c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1.0) - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1.0)) / atr20
        sig[6][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20
        sig[7][s] = ret20 - (np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
        volume_ratio = float(v[-1] / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-12))
        sig[8][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20 * np.clip(volume_ratio, 0.5, 2.0)
    ranks = [rank(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(len(FACTOR_IDS))) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    breadth = float(np.mean([x[0][-1] > x[0][-21] for x in data.values()]))
    vols = [max(np.std(x[4][-20:]), 0.004) for x in data.values()]
    median_vol = float(np.median(vols))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = float(np.mean([1.0 / z for z in vols]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol = max(float(np.std(data[s][4][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else median_vol
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * np.clip((1.0 / vol) / invmean, 0.75, 1.15))
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 9
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-6
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20350202_volscaled_trend_accel10_40",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20341124_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_1_20270729_volume_confirmed_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.22, 0.16, 0.15, 0.13, 0.10, 0.10, 0.06, 0.05, 0.03]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank_cross(x):
    vals = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in x.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(vals):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(vals), 1)
    return out


def capped(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        v = np.asarray(df["volume"], float)[:-1] if "volume" in df else np.ones(len(c))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, v, c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(x[4]) for x in data.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x[4][-n:] for x in data.values()]), axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, v, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        vol10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), 0.004)
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        vol30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr20 = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret10 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1.0
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0
        ret40 = c[-1] / c[-41] - 1.0
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        # Exact ensemble ordering: trend, residual momentum, consistency, acceleration, smooth acceleration.
        sig[0][s] = (ret10 - ret40 / 4.0) / (vol20 * np.sqrt(10.0))
        sig[1][s] = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        sig[2][s] = (ret20 * (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0))) / vol30
        accel = (ret20 - ret60 / 3.0) / (vol30 * np.sqrt(20.0))
        sig[3][s] = accel
        accel10 = (ret10 - (c[-1] / c[-31] - 1.0) / 3.0) / (vol10 * np.sqrt(10.0))
        sig[4][s] = 0.6 * accel + 0.4 * accel10
        sig[5][s] = ((c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1.0) - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1.0)) / atr20
        sig[6][s] = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol10
        bench20 = np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0
        sig[7][s] = ret20 - bench20
        vr = float(v[-1] / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-12))
        sig[8][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20 * np.clip(vr, 0.5, 2.0)

    ranks = [rank_cross(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(len(FACTOR_IDS))) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([x[0][-1] > x[0][-21] for x in data.values()]))
    vols = [max(float(np.std(x[4][-20:])), 0.004) for x in data.values()]
    medvol = float(np.median(vols))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or medvol > 0.015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = float(np.mean([1.0 / z for z in vols]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol = max(float(np.std(data[s][4][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else medvol
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * np.clip((1.0 / vol) / invmean, 0.75, 1.15))
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
    target = capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 9
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-6
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20341124_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_1_20270729_volume_confirmed_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.20, 0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.13, 0.10, 0.05, 0.04]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def cross_rank(values):
    finite = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(finite):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(finite), 1)
    return out


def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1.0)), 1e-10) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w.tolist()))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        v = np.asarray(df["volume"], float)[:-1] if "volume" in df else np.ones(len(c))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[symbol] = (c, h, l, v, c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(x[4]) for x in data.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x[4][-n:] for x in data.values()]), axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, v, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        vol30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr20 = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        accel = (ret20 - ret60 / 3.0) / (vol30 * np.sqrt(20.0))
        signals[0][s] = accel
        # Smoothed confirmation avoids making the second acceleration factor identical.
        accel10 = (c[-1] / c[-11] - 1.0 - (c[-1] / c[-31] - 1.0) / 3.0) / (vol20 * np.sqrt(10.0))
        signals[1][s] = 0.6 * accel + 0.4 * accel10
        signals[2][s] = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        signals[3][s] = (ret20 * (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0))) / vol30
        signals[4][s] = ((c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1.0) - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1.0)) / atr20
        signals[5][s] = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol20
        bench20 = np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0
        signals[6][s] = ret20 - bench20
        volume_ratio = float(v[-1] / max(np.mean(v[-20:]), 1e-12))
        signals[7][s] = -float(rr[-1]) / vol20 * np.clip(volume_ratio, 0.5, 2.0)

    ranks = [cross_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(len(FACTOR_IDS))) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([x[0][-1] > x[0][-21] for x in data.values()]))
    vols = [max(float(np.std(x[4][-20:])), 0.004) for x in data.values()]
    median_vol = float(np.median(vols))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = float(np.mean([1.0 / z for z in vols]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol = max(float(np.std(data[s][4][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else median_vol
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * np.clip((1.0 / vol) / invmean, 0.75, 1.15))
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
    target = cap_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 8

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20350202_volscaled_trend_accel10_40",
    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.22, 0.18, 0.16, 0.12, 0.10, 0.09, 0.08, 0.05]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None

def ranks(x):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in x.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(len(good), 1)
    return out

def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w))

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        v = np.asarray(df["volume"], float)[:-1] if "volume" in df else np.ones(len(c))
        if len(c) >= 125 and np.all(np.isfinite(c[-125:])) and np.all(c[-125:] > 0):
            data[s] = (c, h, l, v, c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8: return
    n = min(len(x[4]) for x in data.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x[4][-n:] for x in data.values()]), axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, v, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        vol10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), 0.004)
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        vol30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret10, ret20 = c[-1]/c[-11]-1, c[-1]/c[-21]-1
        ret40, ret60 = c[-1]/c[-41]-1, c[-1]/c[-61]-1
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0,1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        # The formulas are lagged: the current incomplete bar is excluded above.
        sig[0][s] = (ret20 * (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0))) / vol30
        sig[1][s] = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        sig[2][s] = ((c[-1]/np.max(c[-60:])-1) - (c[-1]/np.max(c[-20:])-1)) / atr
        sig[3][s] = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol10
        sig[4][s] = ret20 - float(np.prod(1 + bench[-20:]) - 1)
        sig[5][s] = (c[-1]/np.max(c[-120:])-1) / atr
        sig[6][s] = (ret10 - ret40/4) / (vol20 * np.sqrt(10))
        sig[7][s] = 0.6*(ret20-ret60/3)/(vol30*np.sqrt(20)) + 0.4*(ret10-(c[-1]/c[-31]-1)/3)/(vol10*np.sqrt(10))
    rranks = [ranks(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i]*rranks[i][s] for i in range(8)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s: 0.8*score[s] + 0.2*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    breadth = np.mean([x[0][-1] > x[0][-21] for x in data.values()])
    vols = [max(float(np.std(x[4][-20:])), 0.004) for x in data.values()]
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or np.median(vols) > 0.015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = np.mean([1/z for z in vols])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol = max(float(np.std(data[s][4][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else float(np.median(vols))
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15*np.clip((1/vol)/invmean, 0.75, 1.15))
        if stressed: raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
    target = cap_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s]-0.5)*0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 8
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS)-1) < 1e-6
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20270211_volstate_reversal_3d",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.22, 0.20, 0.14, 0.14, 0.10, 0.08, 0.07, 0.05]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def ranks(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def capped(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, w))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or not np.all(np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or not np.all(c[-125:] > 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        data[s] = (c, h, l, r)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return
    n = min(len(x[3]) for x in data.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x[3][-n:] for x in data.values()]), axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        vol10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), 0.004)
        vol20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        vol30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret10, ret20 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1, c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret40, ret60 = c[-1] / c[-41] - 1, c[-1] / c[-61] - 1
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        # All observations end at the last completed bar; each signal is ranked cross-sectionally.
        sig[0][s] = ret20 * (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0)) / vol30
        sig[1][s] = (c[-1] / np.max(c[-60:]) - 1 - (c[-1] / np.max(c[-20:]) - 1)) / atr
        sig[2][s] = -float(np.sum(rr[-3:])) / vol10
        sig[3][s] = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        sig[4][s] = ret20 - float(np.prod(1 + bench[-20:]) - 1)
        sig[5][s] = (c[-1] / np.max(c[-120:]) - 1) / atr
        sig[6][s] = (ret10 - ret40 / 4) / (vol20 * np.sqrt(10))
        sig[7][s] = 0.6 * (ret20 - ret60 / 3) / (vol30 * np.sqrt(20)) + 0.4 * (ret10 - (c[-1] / c[-31] - 1) / 3) / (vol10 * np.sqrt(10))
    rranks = [ranks(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * rranks[i][s] for i in range(8)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    breadth = np.mean([x[0][-1] > x[0][-21] for x in data.values()])
    vols = [max(float(np.std(x[3][-20:])), 0.004) for x in data.values()]
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or np.median(vols) > 0.015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = np.mean([1 / z for z in vols])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol = max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else float(np.median(vols))
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * np.clip((1 / vol) / invmean, 0.75, 1.15))
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
    target = capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 8
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1) < 1e-6
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20350202_volscaled_trend_accel10_40",
    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.25, 0.16, 0.16, 0.14, 0.13, 0.08, 0.08]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def cross_rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def capped(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(40):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, [float(x) for x in w]))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or not np.all(np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        data[s] = (c, h, l, r)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(v[3]) for v in data.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([v[3][-n:] for v in data.values()]), axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), 0.004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret10 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1.0
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0
        ret40 = c[-1] / c[-41] - 1.0
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        # Lagged, cross-sectional proxies for the persisted seven-factor ensemble.
        sig[0][s] = (ret10 / v10 - ret40 / max(v30, 0.004))
        sig[1][s] = 0.6 * (ret20 / v20 - ret60 / max(v30, 0.004)) + 0.4 * (ret10 / v10 - ret20 / max(v20, 0.004))
        sig[2][s] = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        sig[3][s] = ret20 - float(np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
        sig[4][s] = (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-120:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / atr
        sig[5][s] = (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0 - (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr
        sig[6][s] = (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0)) * ret20 / v30

    ranks = [cross_rank(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i].get(s, 0.5) for i in range(len(FACTOR_IDS))) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous.get(s, 0.5) for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([v[0][-1] > v[0][-21] for v in data.values()]))
    vols = [max(float(np.std(v[3][-20:])), 0.004) for v in data.values()]
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or np.median(vols) > 0.015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = float(np.mean([1.0 / z for z in vols]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol = max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else float(np.median(vols))

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20350202_volscaled_trend_accel10_40",
    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.24, 0.18, 0.16, 0.14, 0.14, 0.08, 0.06]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(v):
    good = sorted((s, float(x)) for s, x in v.items() if np.isfinite(x))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 1e-9) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any(): w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or not np.all(np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0): continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8: return
    n = min(len(x[3]) for x in data.values())
    bench = np.mean(np.array([x[3][-n:] for x in data.values()]), axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10, v20, v30 = [max(float(np.std(rr[-z:])), 0.004) for z in (10, 20, 30)]
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret10, ret20, ret40, ret60 = (c[-1] / c[-z-1] - 1.0 for z in (10, 20, 40, 60))
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        sig[0][s] = ret10 / v10 - ret40 / v30
        sig[1][s] = 0.6 * (ret20 / v20 - ret60 / v30) + 0.4 * (ret10 / v10 - ret20 / v20)
        sig[2][s] = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        sig[3][s] = ret20 - float(np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
        sig[4][s] = (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-120:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / atr
        sig[5][s] = (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0 - (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr
        sig[6][s] = (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0)) * ret20 / v30
    ranks = [rank(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(len(FACTOR_IDS))) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    vols = [max(float(np.std(x[3][-20:])), 0.004) for x in data.values()]
    breadth = float(np.mean([x[0][-1] > x[0][-21] for x in data.values()]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or np.median(vols) > 0.015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vols]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol = max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else float(np.median(vols))
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * np.clip((1.0 / vol) / invmean, 0.75, 1.15))
        if stressed: raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
    target = cap_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 7
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-6
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.25, 0.16, 0.16, 0.14, 0.13, 0.08, 0.08]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def cross_rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def capped(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(40):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)

    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, [float(x) for x in w]))


@register_hook

        data[s] = (c, h, l, r)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    bench = np.mean(np.array([v[3][-n:] for v in data.values()]), axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():

        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), 0.004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret10 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1.0
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0
        ret40 = c[-1] / c[-41] - 1.0
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        # Lagged, cross-sectional proxies for the persisted seven-factor ensemble.
        sig[0][s] = (ret10 / v10 - ret40 / max(v30, 0.004))
        sig[1][s] = 0.6 * (ret20 / v20 - ret60 / max(v30, 0.004)) + 0.4 * (ret10 / v10 - ret20 / max(v20, 0.004))
        sig[2][s] = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        sig[3][s] = ret20 - float(np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
        sig[4][s] = (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-120:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / atr
        sig[5][s] = (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0 - (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr
        sig[6][s] = (0.5 + np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0)) * ret20 / v30

    ranks = [cross_rank(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i].get(s, 0.5) for i in range(len(FACTOR_IDS))) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous.get(s, 0.5) for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([v[0][-1] > v[0][-21] for v in data.values()]))
    vols = [max(float(np.std(v[3][-20:])), 0.004) for v in data.values()]
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or np.median(vols) > 0.015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = float(np.mean([1.0 / z for z in vols]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol = max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else float(np.median(vols))
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * np.clip((1.0 / vol) / invmean, 0.75, 1.15))
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
    target = capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20350202_volscaled_trend_accel10_40",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.20, 0.18, 0.16, 0.15, 0.14, 0.10, 0.07]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-6)), 1e-6) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Exclude the current incomplete bar: decisions use completed data only.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(v[3]) for v in data.values())
    returns = np.array([v[3][-n:] for v in data.values()])
    bench = np.mean(returns, axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), 0.004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret10 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1.0
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0
        ret40 = c[-1] / c[-41] - 1.0
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        dispersion = float(np.std(returns[:, -20:], axis=0).mean())
        # Positive reversal scores favor assets that failed recently relative to
        # their prior highs, while the consistency signal rewards stable returns.
        failure = ((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) -
                   (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr
        reversal = -ret10 / v10 if dispersion > 0.008 else -0.5 * ret10 / v10
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - 0.5) / v30 - 0.5 * v30
        trend = 0.6 * ret10 / v10 + 0.4 * (ret40 - ret60) / v30
        signals[0][s] = failure
        signals[1][s] = residual20
        signals[2][s] = reversal
        signals[3][s] = ret20 - float(np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
        signals[4][s] = consistency
        signals[5][s] = trend
        signals[6][s] = (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-120:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / atr

    ranks = [rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(7)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else 0.02 for s in UNIVERSE}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact active screener ensemble (all directions are +1), capped at seven factors.
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20350202_volscaled_trend_accel10_40",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.200, 0.195, 0.185, 0.163, 0.147, 0.065, 0.045]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-6)), 1e-6) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row is conservatively treated as potentially incomplete.
        c, h, l = (np.asarray(df[x], float)[:-1] for x in ("close", "high", "low"))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(v[3]) for v in data.values())
    returns = np.array([v[3][-n:] for v in data.values()])
    bench = np.mean(returns, axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    dispersion = float(np.std(returns[:, -20:], axis=0).mean())
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), 0.004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret10 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1.0
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0
        ret40 = c[-1] / c[-41] - 1.0
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        failure = ((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) -
                   (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr
        reversal = -ret10 / v10 if dispersion > 0.008 else -0.5 * ret10 / v10
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - 0.5) / v30 - 0.5 * v30
        relative = ret20 - float(np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
        breakout = (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-120:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / atr
        trend = 0.6 * ret10 / v10 + 0.4 * (ret40 - ret60) / v30
        signals[0][s], signals[1][s] = failure, residual20
        signals[2][s], signals[3][s] = consistency, relative
        signals[4][s], signals[5][s], signals[6][s] = reversal, breakout, trend

    ranks = [rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(7)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else 0.02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vol.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        risk_scale = np.clip((1.0 / vol[s]) / inv_mean, 0.70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * risk_scale)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
    target = cap_weights(raw)
    # Deterministic 10-session forecast is supplied for the migration-cost gate.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 7
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-6
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)

        signals[0][s] = failure

        signals[4][s] = consistency
        signals[5][s] = trend

    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact active screener ensemble (all directions are +1), capped at seven factors.
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20350202_volscaled_trend_accel10_40",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.200, 0.195, 0.185, 0.163, 0.147, 0.065, 0.045]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-6)), 1e-6) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row is conservatively treated as potentially incomplete.
        c, h, l = (np.asarray(df[x], float)[:-1] for x in ("close", "high", "low"))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(v[3]) for v in data.values())
    returns = np.array([v[3][-n:] for v in data.values()])
    bench = np.mean(returns, axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    dispersion = float(np.std(returns[:, -20:], axis=0).mean())
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), 0.004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret10 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1.0
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0
        ret40 = c[-1] / c[-41] - 1.0
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        failure = ((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) -
                   (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr
        reversal = -ret10 / v10 if dispersion > 0.008 else -0.5 * ret10 / v10
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - 0.5) / v30 - 0.5 * v30
        relative = ret20 - float(np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
        breakout = (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-120:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / atr
        trend = 0.6 * ret10 / v10 + 0.4 * (ret40 - ret60) / v30
        signals[0][s], signals[1][s] = failure, residual20
        signals[2][s], signals[3][s] = consistency, relative
        signals[4][s], signals[5][s], signals[6][s] = reversal, breakout, trend

    ranks = [rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(7)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else 0.02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vol.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        risk_scale = np.clip((1.0 / vol[s]) / inv_mean, 0.70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * risk_scale)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
    target = cap_weights(raw)
    # Deterministic 10-session forecast is supplied for the migration-cost gate.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 7
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-6
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}
"}
