{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact active screener ensemble (all directions are +1), capped at seven factors.
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20350202_volscaled_trend_accel10_40",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.200, 0.195, 0.185, 0.163, 0.147, 0.065, 0.045]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-6)), 1e-6) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row is conservatively treated as potentially incomplete.
        c, h, l = (np.asarray(df[x], float)[:-1] for x in ("close", "high", "low"))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(v[3]) for v in data.values())
    returns = np.array([v[3][-n:] for v in data.values()])
    bench = np.mean(returns, axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    dispersion = float(np.std(returns[:, -20:], axis=0).mean())
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), 0.004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret10 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1.0
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0
        ret40 = c[-1] / c[-41] - 1.0
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        failure = ((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) -
                   (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr
        reversal = -ret10 / v10 if dispersion > 0.008 else -0.5 * ret10 / v10
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - 0.5) / v30 - 0.5 * v30
        relative = ret20 - float(np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
        breakout = (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-120:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / atr
        trend = 0.6 * ret10 / v10 + 0.4 * (ret40 - ret60) / v30
        signals[0][s], signals[1][s] = failure, residual20
        signals[2][s], signals[3][s] = consistency, relative
        signals[4][s], signals[5][s], signals[6][s] = reversal, breakout, trend

    ranks = [rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(7)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else 0.02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vol.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        risk_scale = np.clip((1.0 / vol[s]) / inv_mean, 0.70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * risk_scale)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
    target = cap_weights(raw)
    # Deterministic 10-session forecast is supplied for the migration-cost gate.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20350202_volscaled_trend_accel10_40",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.2004, 0.1946, 0.1852, 0.1632, 0.1466, 0.0656, 0.0444]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def cross_rank(values):
    finite = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(finite):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(finite))
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-6)), 1e-6) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close[-125:])) or np.any(close[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[symbol] = (close, high, low, close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(v[3]) for v in data.values())
    returns = np.array([v[3][-n:] for v in data.values()])
    benchmark = np.mean(returns, axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    dispersion = float(np.std(returns[:, -20:], axis=0).mean())
    for symbol, (close, high, low, ret) in data.items():
        rr = ret[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), 0.004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-20:] - low[-20:]) / close[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret10 = close[-1] / close[-11] - 1.0
        ret20 = close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0
        ret40 = close[-1] / close[-41] - 1.0
        ret60 = close[-1] / close[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], benchmark[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(benchmark[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))
        failure = ((close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) -
                   (close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr
        reversal = -ret10 / v10 if dispersion > 0.008 else -0.5 * ret10 / v10
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - 0.5) / v30 - 0.5 * v30
        relative = ret20 - float(np.prod(1.0 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1.0)
        breakout = (close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-120:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / atr
        trend = 0.6 * ret10 / v10 + 0.4 * (ret40 - ret60) / v30
        signals[0][symbol] = failure
        signals[1][symbol] = residual20
        signals[2][symbol] = consistency
        signals[3][symbol] = relative
        signals[4][symbol] = reversal
        signals[5][symbol] = breakout
        signals[6][symbol] = trend

    ranks = [cross_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(7)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else 0.02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vol.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inverse_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        risk_scale = np.clip((1.0 / vol[symbol]) / inverse_mean, 0.70, 1.20)
        raw[symbol] = max(score[symbol], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * risk_scale)
        if stressed:
            raw[symbol] *= 1.25 if symbol in defensive else (0.65 if symbol in risky else 0.92)
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 7
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact active screener ensemble (all directions are +1), capped at seven factors.
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20350202_volscaled_trend_accel10_40",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.200, 0.195, 0.185, 0.163, 0.147, 0.065, 0.045]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-6)), 1e-6) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row is conservatively treated as potentially incomplete.
        c, h, l = (np.asarray(df[x], float)[:-1] for x in ("close", "high", "low"))
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(v[3]) for v in data.values())
    returns = np.array([v[3][-n:] for v in data.values()])
    bench = np.mean(returns, axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    dispersion = float(np.std(returns[:, -20:], axis=0).mean())
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), 0.004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret10 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1.0
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0
        ret40 = c[-1] / c[-41] - 1.0
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]))
        failure = ((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) -
                   (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr
        reversal = -ret10 / v10 if dispersion > 0.008 else -0.5 * ret10 / v10
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - 0.5) / v30 - 0.5 * v30
        relative = ret20 - float(np.prod(1.0 + bench[-20:]) - 1.0)
        breakout = (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-120:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / atr
        trend = 0.6 * ret10 / v10 + 0.4 * (ret40 - ret60) / v30
        signals[0][s], signals[1][s] = failure, residual20
        signals[2][s], signals[3][s] = consistency, relative
        signals[4][s], signals[5][s], signals[6][s] = reversal, breakout, trend

    ranks = [rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(7)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else 0.02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vol.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        risk_scale = np.clip((1.0 / vol[s]) / inv_mean, 0.70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * risk_scale)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (0.65 if s in risky else 0.92)
    target = cap_weights(raw)
    # Deterministic 10-session forecast is supplied for the migration-cost gate.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20350202_volscaled_trend_accel10_40",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.2004, 0.1946, 0.1852, 0.1632, 0.1466, 0.0656, 0.0444]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def cross_rank(values):
    finite = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(finite):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(finite))
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-6)), 1e-6) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close[-125:])) or np.any(close[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[symbol] = (close, high, low, close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(v[3]) for v in data.values())
    returns = np.array([v[3][-n:] for v in data.values()])
    benchmark = np.mean(returns, axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    dispersion = float(np.std(returns[:, -20:], axis=0).mean())
    for symbol, (close, high, low, ret) in data.items():
        rr = ret[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), 0.004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-20:] - low[-20:]) / close[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret10 = close[-1] / close[-11] - 1.0
        ret20 = close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0
        ret40 = close[-1] / close[-41] - 1.0
        ret60 = close[-1] / close[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], benchmark[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(benchmark[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))
        failure = ((close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) -
                   (close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr
        reversal = -ret10 / v10 if dispersion > 0.008 else -0.5 * ret10 / v10
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - 0.5) / v30 - 0.5 * v30
        relative = ret20 - float(np.prod(1.0 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1.0)
        breakout = (close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-120:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / atr
        trend = 0.6 * ret10 / v10 + 0.4 * (ret40 - ret60) / v30
        signals[0][symbol] = failure
        signals[1][symbol] = residual20
        signals[2][symbol] = consistency
        signals[3][symbol] = relative
        signals[4][symbol] = reversal
        signals[5][symbol] = breakout
        signals[6][symbol] = trend

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.2004, 0.1946, 0.1852, 0.1632, 0.1466, 0.0656, 0.0444]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def cross_rank(values):
    finite = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(finite):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(finite))
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-6)), 1e-6) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1

        trend = 0.6 * ret10 / v10 + 0.4 * (ret40 - ret60) / v30

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20350202_volscaled_trend_accel10_40",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.2004, 0.1946, 0.1852, 0.1632, 0.1466, 0.0656, 0.0444]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def cross_rank(values):
    finite = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(finite):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(finite))
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-6)), 1e-6) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close[-125:])) or np.any(close[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[symbol] = (close, high, low, close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(v[3]) for v in data.values())
    returns = np.array([v[3][-n:] for v in data.values()])
    benchmark = np.mean(returns, axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    dispersion = float(np.std(returns[:, -20:], axis=0).mean())
    for symbol, (close, high, low, ret) in data.items():
        rr = ret[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), 0.004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-20:] - low[-20:]) / close[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret10 = close[-1] / close[-11] - 1.0
        ret20 = close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0
        ret40 = close[-1] / close[-41] - 1.0
        ret60 = close[-1] / close[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], benchmark[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(benchmark[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))
        failure = ((close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) -
                   (close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr
        reversal = -ret10 / v10 if dispersion > 0.008 else -0.5 * ret10 / v10
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - 0.5) / v30 - 0.5 * v30
        relative = ret20 - float(np.prod(1.0 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1.0)
        breakout = (close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-120:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / atr
        trend = 0.6 * ret10 / v10 + 0.4 * (ret40 - ret60) / v30
        signals[0][symbol] = failure
        signals[1][symbol] = residual20
        signals[2][symbol] = consistency
        signals[3][symbol] = relative
        signals[4][symbol] = reversal
        signals[5][symbol] = breakout
        signals[6][symbol] = trend

    ranks = [cross_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(7)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else 0.02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vol.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inverse_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        risk_scale = np.clip((1.0 / vol[symbol]) / inverse_mean, 0.70, 1.20)
        raw[symbol] = max(score[symbol], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * risk_scale)
        if stressed:
            raw[symbol] *= 1.25 if symbol in defensive else (0.65 if symbol in risky else 0.92)
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 7

"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.205, 0.189, 0.199, 0.167, 0.066, 0.174]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def rank(x):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in x.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def capped(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-5)), 1e-5) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - cap)); w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        data[s] = (c, h, l, r)
    if len(data) < 8: return
    n = min(len(v[3]) for v in data.values())
    mat = np.array([v[3][-n:] for v in data.values()])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    cross_disp = float(np.mean(np.std(mat[:, -20:], axis=1)))
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), .004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), .004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), .004)
        ret10 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret40 = c[-1] / c[-41] - 1
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual = np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20
        failure = ((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1) - (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1)) / atr
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        relative = (ret20 - (np.prod(1 + bench[-20:]) - 1)) / v20
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(rr[-20:][rr[-20:] < 0])) if np.any(rr[-20:] < 0) else v20, .004)
        reversal = -ret10 / v10
        sig[0][s], sig[1][s], sig[2][s] = failure, consistency, residual
        sig[3][s], sig[4][s], sig[5][s] = relative, downside, reversal * (1.2 if cross_disp > .01 else .7)
    ranks = [rank(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(6)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), .004) if s in data else .02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    med = float(np.median(list(vol.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or med > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv = np.mean([1 / v for v in vol.values()])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        rs = np.clip((1 / vol[s]) / inv, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * rs)
        if stressed: raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (.65 if s in risky else .92)
    target = capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 6

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20280601_relative_strength20",
    "miner_2_20270520_dispersion_conditioned_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20350202_volscaled_trend_accel10_40",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.2004, 0.1946, 0.1852, 0.1632, 0.1466, 0.0656, 0.0444]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def cross_rank(values):
    finite = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(finite):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(finite))
    return out


def capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-6)), 1e-6) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any():
            w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        close = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        high = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        low = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close[-125:])) or np.any(close[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[symbol] = (close, high, low, close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.0)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(v[3]) for v in data.values())
    returns = np.array([v[3][-n:] for v in data.values()])
    benchmark = np.mean(returns, axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    dispersion = float(np.std(returns[:, -20:], axis=0).mean())
    for symbol, (close, high, low, ret) in data.items():
        rr = ret[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), 0.004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), 0.004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), 0.004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((high[-20:] - low[-20:]) / close[-20:])), 0.004)
        ret10 = close[-1] / close[-11] - 1.0
        ret20 = close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0
        ret40 = close[-1] / close[-41] - 1.0
        ret60 = close[-1] / close[-61] - 1.0
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], benchmark[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(benchmark[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]))
        failure = ((close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) -
                   (close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1.0)) / atr
        reversal = -ret10 / v10 if dispersion > 0.008 else -0.5 * ret10 / v10
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - 0.5) / v30 - 0.5 * v30
        relative = ret20 - float(np.prod(1.0 + benchmark[-20:]) - 1.0)
        breakout = (close[-1] / max(np.max(close[-120:]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / atr
        trend = 0.6 * ret10 / v10 + 0.4 * (ret40 - ret60) / v30
        signals[0][symbol] = failure
        signals[1][symbol] = residual20
        signals[2][symbol] = consistency
        signals[3][symbol] = relative
        signals[4][symbol] = reversal
        signals[5][symbol] = breakout
        signals[6][symbol] = trend

    ranks = [cross_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(7)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), 0.004) if s in data else 0.02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vol.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inverse_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        risk_scale = np.clip((1.0 / vol[symbol]) / inverse_mean, 0.70, 1.20)
        raw[symbol] = max(score[symbol], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * risk_scale)
        if stressed:
            raw[symbol] *= 1.25 if symbol in defensive else (0.65 if symbol in risky else 0.92)
    target = capped_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.245, 0.225, 0.205, 0.135, 0.105, 0.085]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def _cap(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-6)), 1e-6) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(40):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - cap)); w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any(): w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, [float(x) for x in w]))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, np.diff(c) / c[:-1])
    if len(data) < 8:
        return
    n = min(len(x[3]) for x in data.values())
    mat = np.array([x[3][-n:] for x in data.values()])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), .004); v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), .004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), .004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), .004)
        ret10 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1; ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1; ret120 = c[-1] / c[-121] - 1
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual = np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20
        # Breakout failure: reward pullbacks from a recent high, while retaining cross-sectional ranking.
        failure = ((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1) - (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1)) / atr
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        dispersion = np.std(mat[:, -20:], axis=1).mean()
        reversal = -ret10 / v10 * (1.2 if dispersion > .01 else .8)
        distance = (ret60 - ret120) / max(v30, .004)
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(rr[-20:][rr[-20:] < 0])) if np.any(rr[-20:] < 0) else v20, .004)
        signals[0][s] = failure; signals[1][s] = residual; signals[2][s] = consistency
        signals[3][s] = reversal; signals[4][s] = distance; signals[5][s] = downside
    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(6)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), .004) if s in data else .02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vol.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or median_vol > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / vol[s]) / inv_mean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (.65 if s in risky else .92)
    target = _cap(raw)
    # Deterministic 10-session forecast is required by the migration-cost gate.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 6
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):

        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0): continue

        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        relative = (ret20 - (np.prod(1 + bench[-20:]) - 1)) / v20
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(rr[-20:][rr[-20:] < 0])) if np.any(rr[-20:] < 0) else v20, .004)
        reversal = -ret10 / v10
        sig[0][s], sig[1][s], sig[2][s] = failure, consistency, residual
        sig[3][s], sig[4][s], sig[5][s] = relative, downside, reversal * (1.2 if cross_disp > .01 else .7)
    ranks = [rank(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(6)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.24, 0.22, 0.18, 0.14, 0.12, 0.10]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(vals):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def _cap_and_normalize(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Exclude the currently forming day: decisions use completed data only.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, np.diff(c) / c[:-1])
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(x[3]) for x in data.values())
    mat = np.array([x[3][-n:] for x in data.values()])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), .004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), .004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), .004)
        ret10, ret20 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1, c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret60, ret120 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1, c[-1] / c[-121] - 1
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual = np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20
        # Pullback from a failed 60-day breakout; positive values favor recovery.
        failure = ((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1) - (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1)) / atr
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        distance = (ret60 - ret120) / v30
        neg = rr[-20:][rr[-20:] < 0]
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else v20, .004)
        dispersion = float(np.std(mat[:, -20:], axis=1).mean())
        reversal = -ret10 / v10 * (1.2 if dispersion > .01 else .8)
        signals[0][s] = residual
        signals[1][s] = failure
        signals[2][s] = consistency
        signals[3][s] = distance
        signals[4][s] = downside
        signals[5][s] = reversal

    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(6)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), .004) if s in data else .02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vol.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or median_vol > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / vol[s]) / inv_mean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (.65 if s in risky else .92)
    target = _cap_and_normalize(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 6
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.245, 0.225, 0.205, 0.135, 0.105, 0.085]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(values):
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(1, len(good))
    return out


def _cap(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-6)), 1e-6) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(40):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float(np.sum(w[over] - cap)); w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        if rest.any(): w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, [float(x) for x in w]))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, np.diff(c) / c[:-1])
    if len(data) < 8:
        return
    n = min(len(x[3]) for x in data.values())
    mat = np.array([x[3][-n:] for x in data.values()])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), .004); v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), .004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), .004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), .004)
        ret10 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1; ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1; ret120 = c[-1] / c[-121] - 1
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual = np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20
        # Breakout failure: reward pullbacks from a recent high, while retaining cross-sectional ranking.
        failure = ((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1) - (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1)) / atr
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        dispersion = np.std(mat[:, -20:], axis=1).mean()
        reversal = -ret10 / v10 * (1.2 if dispersion > .01 else .8)
        distance = (ret60 - ret120) / max(v30, .004)
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(rr[-20:][rr[-20:] < 0])) if np.any(rr[-20:] < 0) else v20, .004)
        signals[0][s] = failure; signals[1][s] = residual; signals[2][s] = consistency
        signals[3][s] = reversal; signals[4][s] = distance; signals[5][s] = downside
    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(6)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), .004) if s in data else .02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vol.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or median_vol > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / vol[s]) / inv_mean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.25 if s in defensive else (.65 if s in risky else .92)
    target = _cap(raw)
    # Deterministic 10-session forecast is required by the migration-cost gate.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 6
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.25, 0.20, 0.18, 0.15, 0.12, 0.10]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def _cap_normalize(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(100):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, np.diff(c) / c[:-1])
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(x[3]) for x in data.values())
    mat = np.array([x[3][-n:] for x in data.values()])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), .004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), .004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), .004)
        ret10, ret20 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1, c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret60, ret120 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1, c[-1] / c[-121] - 1
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual = np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20
        failure = ((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1) - (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1)) / atr
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        distance = (ret60 - ret120) / v30
        neg = rr[-20:][rr[-20:] < 0]
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else v20, .004)
        dispersion = float(np.std(mat[:, -20:], axis=1).mean())
        reversal = -ret10 / v10 * (1.2 if dispersion > .01 else .8)
        signals[0][s], signals[1][s] = residual, failure
        signals[2][s], signals[3][s] = consistency, distance
        signals[4][s], signals[5][s] = downside, reversal

    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(6)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), .004) if s in data else .02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vol.values())))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or median_vol > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / vol[s]) / inv_mean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.30 if s in defensive else (.60 if s in risky else .90)
    target = _cap_normalize(raw)
    # Deterministic 10-session expected return proxy, supplied for every tradable asset.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 6
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = np.array([0.30, 0.22, 0.18, 0.15, 0.10, 0.05])
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    if not good:
        return out
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def _normalize_cap(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(100):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row can be an incomplete current session; decisions use completed data only.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0): continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, np.diff(c) / c[:-1])
    if len(data) < 8: return
    n = min(len(x[3]) for x in data.values())
    mat = np.array([x[3][-n:] for x in data.values()])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), .004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), .004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), .004)
        ret1 = c[-1] / c[-2] - 1
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1
        ret120 = c[-1] / c[-121] - 1
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        # Proxies follow the persisted factor definitions and are all lagged by using c[-1].
        residual_mom = np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        neg = rr[-20:][rr[-20:] < 0]
        downside_mom = ret20 / max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else v20, .004)
        breakout_distance = (ret60 - ret120) / v30
        lowvol_reversal = (-ret1 / v10) / v20
        failure = ((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1) - (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1)) / atr
        sig[0][s], sig[1][s], sig[2][s] = residual_mom, consistency, downside_mom
        sig[3][s], sig[4][s], sig[5][s] = breakout_distance, lowvol_reversal, failure
    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: float(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(6))) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), .004) if s in data else .02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or float(np.median(list(vol.values()))) > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / vol[s]) / inv_mean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed: raw[s] *= 1.30 if s in defensive else (.60 if s in risky else .90)
    target = _normalize_cap(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 6 and abs(float(FACTOR_WEIGHTS.sum()) - 1) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]

    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",

    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = [0.25, 0.20, 0.18, 0.15, 0.12, 0.10]
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def _cap_normalize(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(100):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, np.diff(c) / c[:-1])
    if len(data) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(x[3]) for x in data.values())
    mat = np.array([x[3][-n:] for x in data.values()])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), .004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), .004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), .004)
        ret10, ret20 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1, c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret60, ret120 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1, c[-1] / c[-121] - 1
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual = np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20
        failure = ((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1) - (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1)) / atr
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        distance = (ret60 - ret120) / v30
        neg = rr[-20:][rr[-20:] < 0]
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else v20, .004)
        dispersion = float(np.std(mat[:, -20:], axis=1).mean())
        reversal = -ret10 / v10 * (1.2 if dispersion > .01 else .8)
        signals[0][s], signals[1][s] = residual, failure
        signals[2][s], signals[3][s] = consistency, distance
        signals[4][s], signals[5][s] = downside, reversal

    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(6)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), .004) if s in data else .02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vol.values())))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or median_vol > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / vol[s]) / inv_mean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.30 if s in defensive else (.60 if s in risky else .90)
    target = _cap_normalize(raw)
    # Deterministic 10-session expected return proxy, supplied for every tradable asset.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == len(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) == 6
assert abs(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_1_20350928_inverted_residual_momentum60_vol",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = np.array([0.26, 0.22, 0.18, 0.15, 0.11, 0.08])
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def _cap_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, np.diff(c) / c[:-1])
    if len(data) < 8:
        return
    n = min(len(x[3]) for x in data.values())
    mat = np.array([x[3][-n:] for x in data.values()])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), .004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), .004)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(rr[-60:])), .004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), .004)
        ret1 = c[-1] / c[-2] - 1
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1
        ret120 = c[-1] / c[-121] - 1
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20)
        consistency = (float(np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0)) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        neg = rr[-20:][rr[-20:] < 0]
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else v20, .004)
        breakout = (ret60 - ret120) / v30
        # Positive direction means favor residual underperformance (controlled reversal).
        inverted_residual = -float(np.sum(rr[-60:] - beta * bench[-60:]) / v60)
        lowvol_reversal = (-ret1 / v10) / v20
        signals[0][s], signals[1][s], signals[2][s] = residual20, consistency, downside
        signals[3][s], signals[4][s], signals[5][s] = breakout, inverted_residual, lowvol_reversal
    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(6)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), .004) if s in data else .02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or float(np.median(list(vol.values()))) > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / vol[s]) / inv_mean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.30 if s in defensive else (.60 if s in risky else .90)
    target = _cap_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 6
assert abs(float(FACTOR_WEIGHTS.sum()) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = np.array([0.30, 0.22, 0.18, 0.15, 0.10, 0.05])
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    if not good:
        return out
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def _normalize_cap(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 1e-8)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(100):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row can be an incomplete current session; decisions use completed data only.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0): continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, np.diff(c) / c[:-1])
    if len(data) < 8: return
    n = min(len(x[3]) for x in data.values())
    mat = np.array([x[3][-n:] for x in data.values()])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    sig = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), .004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), .004)
        atr = max(float(np.mean((h[-20:] - l[-20:]) / c[-20:])), .004)
        ret1 = c[-1] / c[-2] - 1
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1
        ret120 = c[-1] / c[-121] - 1
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        # Proxies follow the persisted factor definitions and are all lagged by using c[-1].
        residual_mom = np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20
        consistency = (np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        neg = rr[-20:][rr[-20:] < 0]
        downside_mom = ret20 / max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else v20, .004)
        breakout_distance = (ret60 - ret120) / v30
        lowvol_reversal = (-ret1 / v10) / v20
        failure = ((c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-60:]), 1e-12) - 1) - (c[-1] / max(np.max(c[-20:]), 1e-12) - 1)) / atr
        sig[0][s], sig[1][s], sig[2][s] = residual_mom, consistency, downside_mom
        sig[3][s], sig[4][s], sig[5][s] = breakout_distance, lowvol_reversal, failure
    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in sig]
    score = {s: float(sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(6))) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), .004) if s in data else .02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or float(np.median(list(vol.values()))) > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / vol[s]) / inv_mean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed: raw[s] *= 1.30 if s in defensive else (.60 if s in risky else .90)
    target = _normalize_cap(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 6 and abs(float(FACTOR_WEIGHTS.sum()) - 1) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20350928_inverted_residual_momentum60_vol",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = np.array([.22, .18, .18, .16, .12, .10, .04])
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    if good:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
            out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def _cap_weights(raw, cap=.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, .01)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, [float(x) for x in w]))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Last row is the current/incomplete session; decisions use completed data only.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0): continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, np.diff(c) / c[:-1])
    if len(data) < 8: return
    n = min(len(x[3]) for x in data.values())
    mat = np.array([x[3][-n:] for x in data.values()])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), .004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), .004)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(rr[-60:])), .004)
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20)
        residual60 = float(np.sum(rr[-60:] - beta * bench[-60:]) / v60)
        ret1 = c[-1] / c[-2] - 1
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1
        ret120 = c[-1] / c[-121] - 1
        consistency = (float(np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0)) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        neg = rr[-20:][rr[-20:] < 0]
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else v20, .004)
        # Smooth acceleration and long-window breakout/trend distance.
        smooth_accel = (ret20 / v20) - (ret60 / v60)
        breakout = (ret60 - ret120) / v30
        inverted = -residual60
        lowvol_reversal = (-ret1 / v10) / v20
        vals = [smooth_accel, breakout, residual20, consistency, inverted, downside, lowvol_reversal]
        for i, val in enumerate(vals): signals[i][s] = val
    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(7)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), .004) if s in data else .02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or float(np.median(list(vol.values()))) > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / vol[s]) / inv_mean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed: raw[s] *= 1.30 if s in defensive else (.60 if s in risky else .90)
    target = _cap_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 7
assert abs(float(FACTOR_WEIGHTS.sum()) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}
