import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_1_20350928_inverted_residual_momentum60_vol",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20341124_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = np.array([.22, .20, .18, .15, .13, .08, .04])
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def _capped(raw, cap=.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, .01)), 1e-9) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(40):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Exclude the currently forming session from the decision.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        r = np.diff(c) / c[:-1]
        data[s] = (c, r)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return
    n = min(len(x[1]) for x in data.values())
    mat = np.array([x[1][-n:] for x in data.values()])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    vols = {}
    for s, (c, r0) in data.items():
        r = r0[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(r[-10:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), .004)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .004)
        vols[s] = v20
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(r[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20)
        residual60 = float(np.sum(r[-60:] - beta * bench[-60:]) / v60)
        ret1 = c[-1] / c[-2] - 1
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1
        ret120 = c[-1] / c[-121] - 1
        consistency = (float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else v20, .004)
        acceleration = ret20 / v20 - ret60 / v60
        breakout = (ret60 - ret120) / v30
        lowvol_reversal = (-ret1 / v10) / v20
        vals = [residual20, consistency, breakout, -residual60, downside, acceleration, lowvol_reversal]
        for i, value in enumerate(vals):
            signals[i][s] = value
    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(7)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vols.values()))) if vols else .02
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or median_vol > .015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / max(vols.get(s, .02), .004) for s in UNIVERSE]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / max(vols.get(s, .02), .004)) / inv_mean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.30 if s in defensive else (.60 if s in risky else .90)
    target = _capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 7
assert abs(float(FACTOR_WEIGHTS.sum()) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_1_20350928_inverted_residual_momentum60_vol",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = np.array([.22, .18, .18, .16, .12, .10, .04])
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    if good:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
            out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def _cap_weights(raw, cap=.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, .01)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, [float(x) for x in w]))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Last row is the current/incomplete session; decisions use completed data only.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        h = np.asarray(df["high"], float)[:-1]
        l = np.asarray(df["low"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0): continue
        data[s] = (c, h, l, np.diff(c) / c[:-1])
    if len(data) < 8: return
    n = min(len(x[3]) for x in data.values())
    mat = np.array([x[3][-n:] for x in data.values()])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for s, (c, h, l, r) in data.items():
        rr = r[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(rr[-10:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), .004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(rr[-30:])), .004)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(rr[-60:])), .004)
        beta = float(np.cov(rr[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(rr[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20)
        residual60 = float(np.sum(rr[-60:] - beta * bench[-60:]) / v60)
        ret1 = c[-1] / c[-2] - 1
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1
        ret120 = c[-1] / c[-121] - 1
        consistency = (float(np.mean(rr[-30:] > 0)) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        neg = rr[-20:][rr[-20:] < 0]
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else v20, .004)
        # Smooth acceleration and long-window breakout/trend distance.
        smooth_accel = (ret20 / v20) - (ret60 / v60)
        breakout = (ret60 - ret120) / v30
        inverted = -residual60
        lowvol_reversal = (-ret1 / v10) / v20
        vals = [smooth_accel, breakout, residual20, consistency, inverted, downside, lowvol_reversal]
        for i, val in enumerate(vals): signals[i][s] = val
    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(7)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    vol = {s: max(float(np.std(data[s][3][-20:])), .004) if s in data else .02 for s in UNIVERSE}
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or float(np.median(list(vol.values()))) > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / v for v in vol.values()]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / vol[s]) / inv_mean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed: raw[s] *= 1.30 if s in defensive else (.60 if s in risky else .90)
    target = _cap_weights(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 7
assert abs(float(FACTOR_WEIGHTS.sum()) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact current Screener ensemble (all directions are +1).
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20350928_inverted_residual_momentum60_vol",
    "miner_2_20341124_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = np.array([.23, .20, .18, .14, .12, .09, .04])
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    if good:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
            out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def _capped(raw, cap=.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, .01)), 1e-9) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(40):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Signals use only completed sessions (the final row may be forming).
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[s] = (c, np.diff(c) / c[:-1])
    if len(data) < 8:
        return
    n = min(len(x[1]) for x in data.values())
    mat = np.array([x[1][-n:] for x in data.values()])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    vols = {}
    for s, (c, r0) in data.items():
        r = r0[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(r[-10:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), .004)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .004)
        vols[s] = v20
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(r[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20)
        residual60 = float(np.sum(r[-60:] - beta * bench[-60:]) / v60)
        ret1 = c[-1] / c[-2] - 1
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1
        ret120 = c[-1] / c[-121] - 1
        consistency = (float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else v20, .004)
        acceleration = ret20 / v20 - ret60 / v60
        breakout = (ret60 - ret120) / v30
        lowvol_reversal = (-ret1 / v10) / v20
        # Order exactly matches FACTOR_IDS / factor_ensemble.json.
        vals = [residual20, consistency, breakout, downside, -residual60, acceleration, lowvol_reversal]
        for i, value in enumerate(vals):
            signals[i][s] = value
    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(7)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vols.values()))) if vols else .02
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or median_vol > .015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / max(vols.get(s, .02), .004) for s in UNIVERSE]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / max(vols.get(s, .02), .004)) / inv_mean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.30 if s in defensive else (.60 if s in risky else .90)
    target = _capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    # Complete 15-asset target and deterministic 10-session forecasts are mandatory.
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 7
assert abs(float(FACTOR_WEIGHTS.sum()) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(vals):

    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)

def _capped(raw, cap=.20):

    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(40):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():

            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Exclude the currently forming session from the decision.
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):

        v10 = max(float(np.std(r[-10:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), .004)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .004)
        vols[s] = v20
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(r[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20)
        residual60 = float(np.sum(r[-60:] - beta * bench[-60:]) / v60)
        ret1 = c[-1] / c[-2] - 1
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1
        ret120 = c[-1] / c[-121] - 1
        consistency = (float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else v20, .004)
        acceleration = ret20 / v20 - ret60 / v60
        breakout = (ret60 - ret120) / v30
        lowvol_reversal = (-ret1 / v10) / v20
        vals = [residual20, consistency, breakout, -residual60, downside, acceleration, lowvol_reversal]
        for i, value in enumerate(vals):
            signals[i][s] = value
    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(7)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vols.values()))) if vols else .02
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or median_vol > .015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / max(vols.get(s, .02), .004) for s in UNIVERSE]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / max(vols.get(s, .02), .004)) / inv_mean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.30 if s in defensive else (.60 if s in risky else .90)
    target = _capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 7
assert abs(float(FACTOR_WEIGHTS.sum()) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_1_20350928_inverted_residual_momentum60_vol",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20341124_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = np.array([.20, .20, .19, .16, .10, .10, .05])
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def _capped(raw, cap=.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, .01)), 1e-9) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, (float(x) for x in w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        r = np.diff(c) / c[:-1]
        data[s] = (c, r)
    if len(data) < 8:
        return
    n = min(len(v[1]) for v in data.values())
    mat = np.array([v[1][-n:] for v in data.values()])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    vols = {}
    for s, (c, r0) in data.items():
        r = r0[-n:]
        v10, v20, v30, v60 = [max(float(np.std(r[-k:])), .004) for k in (10, 20, 30, 60)]
        vols[s] = v20
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(r[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20)
        residual60 = float(np.sum(r[-60:] - beta * bench[-60:]) / v60)
        ret1 = c[-1] / c[-2] - 1
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1
        ret120 = c[-1] / c[-121] - 1
        consistency = (float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else v20, .004)
        acceleration = ret20 / v20 - ret60 / v60
        breakout = (ret60 - ret120) / v30
        reversal = (-ret1 / v10) / v20
        # The inverted residual factor intentionally preserves its +1 direction.
        vals = [-residual60, residual20, consistency, breakout, acceleration, downside, reversal]
        for i, value in enumerate(vals):
            signals[i][s] = value
    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(7)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vols.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or median_vol > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / max(vols.get(s, .02), .004) for s in UNIVERSE]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / max(vols.get(s, .02), .004)) / inv_mean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.30 if s in defensive else (.60 if s in risky else .90)
    target = _capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 7
assert abs(float(FACTOR_WEIGHTS.sum()) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

def _contract_check():

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact current Screener ensemble (all directions are +1).
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280615_volmanaged_consistency30",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
    "miner_1_20350928_inverted_residual_momentum60_vol",
    "miner_2_20341124_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_1_20260730_lowvol_scaled_reversal_1d",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = np.array([.23, .20, .18, .14, .12, .09, .04])
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    if good:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
            out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def _capped(raw, cap=.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, .01)), 1e-9) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(40):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 140:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # Signals use only completed sessions (the final row may be forming).
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        data[s] = (c, np.diff(c) / c[:-1])
    if len(data) < 8:
        return
    n = min(len(x[1]) for x in data.values())
    mat = np.array([x[1][-n:] for x in data.values()])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    vols = {}
    for s, (c, r0) in data.items():
        r = r0[-n:]
        v10 = max(float(np.std(r[-10:])), .004)
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .004)
        v30 = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), .004)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .004)
        vols[s] = v20
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        residual20 = float(np.sum(r[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20)
        residual60 = float(np.sum(r[-60:] - beta * bench[-60:]) / v60)
        ret1 = c[-1] / c[-2] - 1
        ret20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1
        ret60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1
        ret120 = c[-1] / c[-121] - 1
        consistency = (float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)) - .5) / v30 - .5 * v30
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) else v20, .004)
        acceleration = ret20 / v20 - ret60 / v60
        breakout = (ret60 - ret120) / v30
        lowvol_reversal = (-ret1 / v10) / v20
        # Order exactly matches FACTOR_IDS / factor_ensemble.json.
        vals = [residual20, consistency, breakout, downside, -residual60, acceleration, lowvol_reversal]
        for i, value in enumerate(vals):
            signals[i][s] = value
    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(7)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: .8 * score[s] + .2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vols.values()))) if vols else .02
    breadth = float(np.mean([data[s][0][-1] > data[s][0][-21] for s in data]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or median_vol > .015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = float(np.mean([1.0 / max(vols.get(s, .02), .004) for s in UNIVERSE]))
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / max(vols.get(s, .02), .004)) / inv_mean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.30 if s in defensive else (.60 if s in risky else .90)
    target = _capped(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - .5) * .06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    # Complete 15-asset target and deterministic 10-session forecasts are mandatory.
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and len(FACTOR_IDS) == 7
assert abs(float(FACTOR_WEIGHTS.sum()) - 1.0) < 1e-9

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",
    "miner_2_20280810_short_breakout20",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = np.array([0.28, 0.22, 0.18, 0.17, 0.15])
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    if good:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
            out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def _cap(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 1e-10) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    prices, returns = {}, {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=285)
        if df is None or len(df) < 145: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0): continue
        prices[s], returns[s] = c, np.diff(c) / c[:-1]
    if len(prices) < 8: return
    n = min(len(x) for x in returns.values())
    mat = np.array([returns[s][-n:] for s in returns])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    vols = {}
    for s, c in prices.items():
        r = returns[s][-n:]
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .004); v30 = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), .004)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .004); vols[s] = v20
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0,1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        ret20, ret60, ret120 = c[-1]/c[-21]-1, c[-1]/c[-61]-1, c[-1]/c[-121]-1
        residual20 = np.sum(r[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20
        # long-horizon breakout distance and smooth acceleration
        breakout120 = (c[-1] / np.max(c[-121:-1]) - 1.0) / v30
        smooth_accel = (ret20 / v20) - (ret60 / v60)
        short_breakout = (c[-1] / np.max(c[-21:-1]) - 1.0) / v20
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0])) if np.any(r[-20:] < 0) else v20, .004)
        vals = [breakout120, smooth_accel, short_breakout, residual20, downside]
        for i, x in enumerate(vals): signals[i][s] = float(x)
    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(5)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s: .8*score[s] + .2*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vols.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([prices[s][-1] > prices[s][-21] for s in prices]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or median_vol > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = np.mean([1/max(vols.get(s,.02),.004) for s in UNIVERSE])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1/max(vols.get(s,.02),.004))/invmean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15*vol_adj)
        if stressed: raw[s] *= 1.35 if s in defensive else (.60 if s in risky else .90)
    target = _cap(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s]-.5)*.06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and abs(float(FACTOR_WEIGHTS.sum()) - 1) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [
    "miner_2_20280907_breakout_failure_reversal",
    "miner_2_20270603_medium_dispersion_reversal",
    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120",
    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = np.array([0.32, 0.22, 0.18, 0.15, 0.13])
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def _capped_weights(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(50):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any():
            break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return

    prices, returns, vols = {}, {}, {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=285)
        if df is None or len(df) < 145:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(close) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(close[-125:])) or np.any(close[-125:] <= 0):
            continue
        prices[symbol] = close
        returns[symbol] = np.diff(close) / close[:-1]
        vols[symbol] = max(float(np.std(returns[symbol][-30:])), 0.004)
    if len(prices) < 8:
        return

    n = min(len(x) for x in returns.values())
    matrix = np.array([returns[s][-n:] for s in prices])
    benchmark = matrix.mean(axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    for symbol, close in prices.items():
        r = returns[symbol][-n:]
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.004)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), 0.004)
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], benchmark[-60:], ddof=1)[0, 1] /
                     max(np.var(benchmark[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        ret20 = close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0
        ret60 = close[-1] / close[-61] - 1.0
        ret120 = close[-1] / close[-121] - 1.0
        # Reversal signals: failed/extended breakouts and medium-horizon dispersion.
        failure = -(close[-1] / max(close[-21:-1]) - 1.0) / v20
        dispersion = -(ret60 - float(np.median([prices[x][-1] / prices[x][-61] - 1.0 for x in prices]))) / v60
        residual = np.sum(r[-20:] - beta * benchmark[-20:]) / v20
        breakout = (close[-1] / max(close[-121:-1]) - 1.0) / max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), 0.004)
        acceleration = ret20 / v20 - ret60 / v60
        for i, value in enumerate([failure, dispersion, residual, breakout, acceleration]):
            signals[i][symbol] = float(value)

    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(float(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i]) * ranks[i][s] for i in range(5)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None:
        score = {s: 0.8 * score[s] + 0.2 * _previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)

    breadth = float(np.mean([prices[s][-1] > prices[s][-21] for s in prices]))
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vols.values())))
    stressed = breadth < 0.40 or median_vol > 0.015
    defensive = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}
    risky = {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    inv_mean = np.mean([1.0 / vols.get(s, 0.02) for s in UNIVERSE])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1.0 / vols.get(s, 0.02)) / inv_mean, 0.70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], 0.03) * (0.85 + 0.15 * vol_adj)
        if stressed:
            raw[s] *= 1.35 if s in defensive else (0.60 if s in risky else 0.90)
    target = _capped_weights(raw)
    # Deterministic, bounded 10-day forecast required by the migration-cost gate.
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s] - 0.5) * 0.06, -0.03, 0.03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)


assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and abs(float(FACTOR_WEIGHTS.sum()) - 1.0) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}

   Provides medium-horizon mean-reversion exposure and diversifies the trend sleeve, though dispersion may weaken during correlation spikes.
3. **`miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20` — 18%**  
   Retains relative-strength exposure while reducing common-market beta dependence.
4. **`miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120` — 15%**  
   Low-turnover longer-horizon trend factor; reduced weight because broad trend exposure has recently underperformed.

   Smooth and low-turnover, but capped due to sparse coverage and high overlap with other trend factors.

|---|---:|---:|---|

| `miner_2_20280727_breakout_distance120` | 0.15 | 1 | Smooth rank, low-turnover weighting |
| `miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60` | 0.13 | 1 | Winsorize and cap sparse observations |

- The ensemble deliberately reduces concentration in unconditional momentum and short breakouts.
- Breakout-failure reversal and medium-dispersion reversal may become correlated during broad market selloffs.
- Trend factors remain a correlated secondary sleeve and are kept at a combined 28%.
- High-turnover reversal factors were excluded because they are poorly matched to the 10-trading-day rebalance cadence and incur greater friction.
- Defensive exposure should continue to be expressed through tradable assets such as XAU, US10Y, and CN10Y, not cash.

- The prior five-factor trend-heavy ensemble lost approximately **1.24%** in the latest live block.
- Earlier seven-factor ensembles also recorded losses of approximately **1.27%** and **1.36%**.
- Recent 120-day backtests remained nearly flat, with Sharpe around **0.08–0.10** and drawdowns around **11–13%**.

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
FACTOR_IDS = [

    "miner_2_20341208_smooth_trend_acceleration20_60",

    "miner_3_20280601_beta_residual_momentum20",
    "miner_3_20280504_downside_adjusted_momentum20",
]
FACTOR_WEIGHTS = np.array([0.28, 0.22, 0.18, 0.17, 0.15])
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0
_previous = None


def _rank(vals):
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    if good:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
            out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(good)
    return out


def _cap(raw, cap=0.20):
    w = np.array([max(float(raw.get(s, 0.01)), 1e-10) for s in UNIVERSE])
    w /= w.sum()
    for _ in range(30):
        over = w > cap
        if not over.any(): break
        excess = float((w[over] - cap).sum())
        w[over] = cap
        rest = ~over
        w[rest] += excess * w[rest] / max(float(w[rest].sum()), 1e-12)
    w /= w.sum()
    return dict(zip(UNIVERSE, map(float, w)))


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day, _previous
    _day += 1
    if _day != 1 and (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    prices, returns = {}, {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=285)
        if df is None or len(df) < 145: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 125 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-125:])) or np.any(c[-125:] <= 0): continue
        prices[s], returns[s] = c, np.diff(c) / c[:-1]
    if len(prices) < 8: return
    n = min(len(x) for x in returns.values())
    mat = np.array([returns[s][-n:] for s in returns])
    bench = mat.mean(axis=0)
    signals = [dict() for _ in FACTOR_IDS]
    vols = {}
    for s, c in prices.items():
        r = returns[s][-n:]
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .004); v30 = max(float(np.std(r[-30:])), .004)
        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .004); vols[s] = v20
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], bench[-60:], ddof=1)[0,1] / max(np.var(bench[-60:], ddof=1), 1e-8))
        ret20, ret60, ret120 = c[-1]/c[-21]-1, c[-1]/c[-61]-1, c[-1]/c[-121]-1
        residual20 = np.sum(r[-20:] - beta * bench[-20:]) / v20
        # long-horizon breakout distance and smooth acceleration
        breakout120 = (c[-1] / np.max(c[-121:-1]) - 1.0) / v30
        smooth_accel = (ret20 / v20) - (ret60 / v60)
        short_breakout = (c[-1] / np.max(c[-21:-1]) - 1.0) / v20
        downside = ret20 / max(float(np.std(r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0])) if np.any(r[-20:] < 0) else v20, .004)
        vals = [breakout120, smooth_accel, short_breakout, residual20, downside]
        for i, x in enumerate(vals): signals[i][s] = float(x)
    ranks = [_rank(x) for x in signals]
    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[i] * ranks[i][s] for i in range(5)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    if _previous is not None: score = {s: .8*score[s] + .2*_previous[s] for s in UNIVERSE}
    _previous = dict(score)
    median_vol = float(np.median(list(vols.values())))
    breadth = float(np.mean([prices[s][-1] > prices[s][-21] for s in prices]))
    stressed = breadth < .40 or median_vol > .015
    defensive, risky = {"XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"}, {"BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "COPPER"}
    invmean = np.mean([1/max(vols.get(s,.02),.004) for s in UNIVERSE])
    raw = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        vol_adj = np.clip((1/max(vols.get(s,.02),.004))/invmean, .70, 1.20)
        raw[s] = max(score[s], .03) * (.85 + .15*vol_adj)
        if stressed: raw[s] *= 1.35 if s in defensive else (.60 if s in risky else .90)
    target = _cap(raw)
    forecast = {s: float(np.clip((score[s]-.5)*.06, -.03, .03)) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=FACTOR_IDS)

assert len(UNIVERSE) == 15 and abs(float(FACTOR_WEIGHTS.sum()) - 1) < 1e-9
assert not set(UNIVERSE) & {"DXY", "USDCNY", "USDJPY", "EURUSD", "VIX"}
